programme.title: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son Nicholas were abducted during a carjacking and the crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of Christmas Eve, a college co-ed was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment.

programme.title: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold.

programme.title: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others.

programme.title: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim has been stabbed more than thirty times, and the crime scene is awash with her blood. Near her head, police discover a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services... then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: Volunteers and police spend weeks searching for a missing girl. A psychic later leads them to a field where the body was found.

programme.title: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera video shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction, leading to murder.

programme.title: Smiley Face
programme.desc: When DNA proves that a man who practically admits to a brutal attack is innocent, police wonder why he is willing to take the blame.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client.

programme.title: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family break turns into a nightmare when the wife is found face-down in a lake; with no idea whether it was murder, an accident or suicide, police turn to a new forensic technique.

programme.title: As Fault
programme.desc: The woman in the back of the truck was flailing her arms, screaming. They thought she was doing something dangerous for the fun of it.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to his work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim.

programme.title: Holy Terror
programme.desc: Detectives search for the bombers of two churches in Illinois, hoping that the materials used in the remnants of the handmade bombs will offer the clues to catch the culprits.

programme.title: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery.

programme.title: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: Police are able to create a composite sketch of a man burnt beyond recognition. But tracking the killer is more challenging.

programme.title: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a scientist is gravely ill. When tests reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: A bullet-riddled car, a missing driver, and no witnesses, an ambush or a random attack; the clue was something so tiny, it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she'd always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered.

programme.title: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college co-ed vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Cold Feet
programme.desc: James Kenneth Elmen Jr. abducted Julie Estes, then 21, from the Southside convenience store where she worked in 1985.

programme.title: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death, and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: A killer made great effort to obscure the shoe impressions left when he tracked blood on the floor, but he ended up creating new incriminating evidence...

programme.title: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: Police don't have a basis for comparison to match shoe impressions, blood drops and DNA evidence from a murder scene.

programme.title: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was found guilty of murder in the 1994 slaying at Perry's home.

programme.title: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother and then packing her bloodied corpse in a box.

programme.title: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: The brutal murder of a state park employee over $2,000 rattles her co-workers and tourists while leaving police to sift through hundreds of leads.

programme.title: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery.

programme.title: Lights Out
programme.desc: Fifteen years later, DNA technology leads to justice for a murdered woman and her savagely beaten 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by his odd behavior toward TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappeared from the strip club she worked at in East Hartford, CT. Police look at various customers of the strip club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids home after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: In 2000, Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class and her husband Ken found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home.

programme.title: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. Her husband Jeff became the prime suspect, until he was cleared by police.

programme.title: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: In 2008, Illinois emergency response came upon a garage fire and a man was found crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire and Michael heroically rescues his family.

programme.title: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife Stacey maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the Last Call Killer because he targeted men in gay bars.

programme.title: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé Keyon Pittman.

programme.title: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, when teenager Tara Munsey goes missing after work, it is unknown if she ran away or was murdered.

programme.title: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in their affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment and petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail in the middle of the day while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found shot to death at home by his wife Miriam.

programme.title: Seeing Red
programme.desc: A body is found stuffed into a suitcase forcing the police to search though the landfill for another missing victim.

programme.title: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car and they find an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: Series premiere. A flight attendant went missing and was never seen again. Police proved her husband guilty of murder without finding the body.

programme.title: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A boy is mysteriously shot in his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, scale models and animation reveal the bullet's amazing path and who was responsible.

programme.title: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappeared and her husband became the prime suspect especially after police found a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. Complex DNA testing proved it was the wife's blood. Now all they had to do was find her body.

programme.title: The Footpath Murders
programme.desc: British detectives worked with a pioneering scientist to solve crimes of sexual assault and serial murder. This 1986 case marked the first time DNA was used as evidence in a court of law.

programme.title: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: Early one morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovered the body of a young woman.

programme.title: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia convention, 180 legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die.

programme.title: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home and walked up the stairs to the bedroom. She discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered...but how? And by whom? Even the experts couldn't agree.

programme.title: Insect Clues
programme.desc: From 1985 to 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California.

programme.title: Outbreak
programme.desc: In 1985, 121 people in South Dakota and Minnesota were struck by a mysterious illness. There had been only one outbreak like it, and when it happened again no one could figure out why.

programme.title: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his family members in his mansion before he disappeared.

programme.title: Raw Terror
programme.desc: An 11-year-old Boy Scout comes down with a fever and diarrhea after eating an undercooked burger. When his condition worsens, his mother drives him to a hospital and doctors discover E. coli destroying his body.

programme.title: The Common Thread
programme.desc: Ten bodies had been found between May and November 1984 in Florida. A 17-year-old female named Lisa McVey was abducted but released, leading police to the perpetrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: Eileen and Derrick Severs disappeared from their home in the small village of Hambleton in Great Britain.

programme.title: Killer Fog
programme.desc: Almost a hundred vehicles were involved in the single most deadly automobile accident in American history.

programme.title: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While Earl Morris was vacationing in California, he learned his wife Ruby Morris had gone missing from their home in Arizona. The results of the investigation surprised everyone...especially Earl Morris.

programme.title: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: The flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children proved to be something more serious: thallium poisoning.

programme.title: The Blood Trail
programme.desc: In a quiet village in Great Britain, a farmer came upon a chilling sight. Impaled on his fence post was a severed lamb's head along with a note which read, "You next."

programme.title: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant was rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there were more than 30 cases. Doctors searched frantically for the cause and a cure.

programme.title: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak in Vancouver, British Columbia, a fire was set in a dumpster. No one saw either the arsonist or the fire, and it burned for hours in the deserted parking lot.

programme.title: Something's Fishy
programme.desc: Two people in Seattle, Washington died after taking an over-the-counter pain reliever. Lab analysis of the pills showed they were tainted with a lethal concentration of cyanide.

programme.title: Sealed with a Kiss
programme.desc: For more than a year, hateful letters were sent to a school teacher in Pennsylvania. DNA analysis would eventually help seal the perpetrator's fate.

programme.title: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day. This time, the victim was injured but survived.

programme.title: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a small, quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy did not return home as planned. The investigation revealed some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Deadly Parasites
programme.desc: Heavy rains and snow run-off carried manure into Milwaukee's water supply in 1993, leading to an epidemic of gastrointestinal illness affecting 400,000 people.

programme.title: Without a Trace
programme.desc: Eleven-month-old Chad Shelton was admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding and later died. Investigators and scientists frantically searched for a cause when others from the same house fell ill.

programme.title: Knot for Everyone
programme.desc: In the mid-1980s, bodies of nude women were found on a remote hill of California. The police got a break when a known prostitute escaped an attacker and was able to identify him and his automobile.

programme.title: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a boy scout camp near Farmington, Missouri. A facial reconstruction aided the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: A serial bomber was waging a vendetta against the legal profession. A judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse had been targeted. Employing a range of forensic techniques, investigators used evidence from the bombs to lead them to the perpetrator.

programme.title: Sim'ilar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returned home after working the night shift and found his wife, Paula, unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their two-year-old son, Randy, was asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, was missing.

programme.title: Grave Evidence
programme.desc: Stephen Scher and Martin Dillon went skeet shooting on a beautiful spring day and Martin was shot dead.

programme.title: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan died under suspicious circumstances, his mother was convicted of his murder.

programme.title: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Laura's bedroom was searched and forensic science was used to direct them a to prime suspect.

programme.title: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was sentenced to three life terms in prison, but he steadfastly maintained his innocence.

programme.title: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Broken Bond
programme.desc: A two-year-old boy was rushed to the hospital suffering from brain seizures and breathing difficulties.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. A tiny clue found years later revealed a tragic tale of drugs, romance and revenge.

programme.title: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: A mother claims that an intruder murdered her two sons, but lacking a motive, police use blood-spatter analysis and behavioral profiling to reconstruct a different scenario.

programme.title: The Killing Room
programme.desc: Scott Dunn was missing and when the police sprayed his bedroom with Luminol, a scene of horrific violence emerged. Now investigators faced a daunting task.

programme.title: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: A 1995 fire razes the mansion of a Kansas doctor, killing two of her three children; disturbing accounts from an ex-husband lead investigators to believe the doctor set the blaze herself.

programme.title: Cement the Case
programme.desc: A husband confesses to his wife's murder, only to be found not guilty a year later when a phone tip and forensic evidence point to another.

programme.title: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: When a Pennsylvania man checks into a hospital for leg pain and later dies of thallium poisoning, police investigate his wife and find her in the process of collecting an insurance payment for her previous husband's death.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Police exhume the body of Karla Brown, murdered in her home in 1978, to study bite wounds, which eventually lead to the killer.

programme.title: Accident or Murder?
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Core Evidence
programme.desc: A beverage company pleads guilty to violating federal safety laws when a baby dies from E. coli after drinking apple juice.

programme.title: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: A woman who survived a deadly childhood fire sends police a letter charging that her father killed her mother 30 years ago.

programme.title: With Every Breath
programme.desc: After more than 20 people on a Native American reservation die suddenly from a flu-like disease, Navajo medicine men provide a clue that leads to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: While at a real estate conference in St. Louis, a man finds his wife drowned in the bathtub in their hotel room.

programme.title: Badge of Deceit
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool.

programme.title: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open.

programme.title: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her son, the obvious suspect is her husband. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story.

programme.title: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Burning Ambition
programme.desc: When a policeman's house goes up in flames, experts suspect arson. The officer whose home was torched arrests a low-level drug dealer, who confesses. But then the suspect vanishes.

programme.title: Memories
programme.desc: Dianna Green was brutally attacked in her own home and her unborn child was killed. After coming out of a coma and regaining her memory, she is able to identify her husband as the perpetrator.

programme.title: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence.

programme.title: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of an 11-year-old, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: Police charge a mentally unstable man with his wife's murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: What I Saw
programme.desc: A spate of robberies comes to light after a firehouse lockbox key goes missing; Sgt. Hank Voight suspects a firefighter may be involved, and with Boden's support, he recruits Cruz to go undercover to help sniff out any suspicious activity.

programme.title: Fault in Him
programme.desc: Casey struggles after experiencing a narrow miss on a call; Otis wins a unique sporting opportunity in a raffle; Grissom turns to Severide for assistance when the mayor's office sends a task force to Firehouse 51.

programme.title: Move a Wall
programme.desc: Tensions run high between Casey and Herrmann after the firehouse responds to an apartment complex fire; after discovering something extremely suspicious during the call, Kidd and Severide do some investigating and get CPD on the case.

programme.title: No Such Thing as Bad Luck
programme.desc: Severide gets angry at Cruz when he feels his orders were disobeyed in the field; Boden reconnects with an old high school friend during a call to a house fire. Herrmann has issues when one of his favorite knick-knacks from Molly's goes missing.

programme.title: Until the Weather Breaks
programme.desc: A horrible storm wreaks havoc on Chicago and impacts Firehouse 51 when the power goes off; when a little boy mysteriously shows up at the station, everyone works together to uncover who he belongs to; Foster and Kidd argue about Severide.

programme.title: Try Like Hell
programme.desc: Severide and Boden search to uncover whether arson was the cause of a fire at a hair salon; Mouch, Herrmann, Otis and Kidd make a startling discovery while tracking down the missing piercing nozzle from Engine 27.

programme.title: Faith
programme.desc: Torres investigates the conspiracy surrounding the Morgan case, leading Intelligence into a tangled web of secrets.

programme.title: On the Way
programme.desc: Atwater pushes his personal life aside as he goes undercover in the flashy high-stakes world of carjacking.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: Details about Imani's past emerge as the Intelligence Unit seeks the truth behind the sudden resurfacing of a decades-old missing child case.

programme.title: Proof of Burden
programme.desc: After a shocking discovery, the team begins closing in on Sean O'Neal with every shred of evidence they can find; determined to keep his son out of prison, Chief O'Neal hires a lawyer.

programme.title: This Job
programme.desc: A series of brutal home invasion robberies finds the team paired with Detective Borkowski, an old friend of Ruzek's, to work the case; things get complicated for Torres when it becomes clear Borkowski has a vastly different policing style.

programme.title: Long Lost
programme.desc: A shocking ambush at a funeral leads the team into a heated investigation to find the shooters; much to Atwater's surprise, he must rely on someone from his past to help in the investigation, dredging up old memories and revealing new truths.

programme.title: I Can Let You Go
programme.desc: Sean O'Neal surprises Upton with a call from prison, revealing sensitive information; while Upton grapples with how to keep O'Neal at a distance, the team quickly mobilizes to stop a crime in progress before it's too late.

programme.title: The Ghost in You
programme.desc: Voight and the team help ASA Nina Chapman pursue a drug runner who dodged prison years ago after Chapman's informant mysteriously disappeared; the investigation takes a turn when Voight uncovers a damaging secret from Chapman's past.

programme.title: Are We Considered Famous?
programme.desc: Debating if we are considered famous or not, finding out what British people say differently, debriefing Taco Bell's new menu, Disney's biggest expansion ever, the crazy stats behind the new Minecraft movie, and more!

programme.title: Ronaldo's Most Expensive Things!
programme.desc: Revealing the most expensive things Ronaldo owns; recapping one of the greatest sports weekends ever; comparing Coachella lineups; how rich Jeff Bezos actually is; debating an East vs. West world soccer match and more.

programme.title: 100 Men vs. 1 Gorilla, Who Wins?!
programme.desc: Debating who would win in a fight, 100 men or 1 gorilla, reacting to Bad Bunny's leaked real vocals, discussing Burger King paying for the greatest wedding of all time, deciding if the Trump's are time travelers, talking golf hypotheticals, and more!

programme.title: December Solstice
programme.desc: A feud between a famous author (Robert Vaughn) and his sixth wife, Charmaine (Marcia Cross), turns into a criminal case when Charmaine is faced with allegations of abuse; Barba winds up dealing with family drama of his own.

programme.title: Parole Violations
programme.desc: When Carisi's sister's fiancé falls back into bad habits and accuses his parole officer of rape, Carisi must investigate.

programme.title: Devastating Story
programme.desc: During an interview on a popular TV show, a college student claims she was gang raped in a fraternity, bringing national attention to rape on campus; Benson and Barba investigate multiple suspects.

programme.title: Granting Immunity
programme.desc: Barba's efforts to make an arrest in a case involving pornographic photos are stalled when several suspects come down with the measles; Amaro receives distressing news about his son.

programme.title: Daydream Believer
programme.desc: Voight and members of the Chicago PD travel to New York to help SVU pursue Yates, their prime suspect in a rape/murder case.

programme.title: The White Whale
programme.desc: A serial arsonist cold case is reopened when Lt. Severide finds a connection to a recent salon fire; Firehouse 51 celebrates a retirement party.

programme.title: I'm Not Leaving You
programme.desc: Severide and Kidd continue to investigate Benny's old arson case; unexpected news leads Brett to ponder a big decision; all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: Sacred Ground
programme.desc: The mattress factory fire spirals out of control; truck and squad lay it on the line in hopes of getting the trapped victims out alive.

programme.title: A Real Shot in the Arm
programme.desc: Casey struggles to get Boden to sign off on an energetic new recruit; Foster extends an olive branch to her irritating new medic; Otis inspires Herrmann to seek new partners at Molly's; Brett realizes life in Fowlerton will take some getting used to.

programme.title: Badlands
programme.desc: Brett and Foster question the suspicious circumstances surrounding an attack at a juvenile detention center; a convoluted new technology at Firehouse 51 tests everybody's patience; Kidd is chosen to represent the district at a leadership conference.

programme.title: Infection, Part I
programme.desc: A rare but deadly bacteria takes its toll on numerous victims around the city, leaving Chicago's finest first responders to work together alongside the CDC to resolve the dangerous situation; Severide suspects something bigger is happening.

programme.title: Buckle Up
programme.desc: Kidd must prove herself at the National Firefighter Leadership Conference, while the rest of Firehouse 51 is called to two eerily similar car wrecks; Mouch tries to keep the firehouse informed by starting a newsletter; Cruz deals with a heartbreak.

programme.title: What Went Wrong
programme.desc: Cruz and Severide suspect foul play when a fire started by an elderly woman turns deadly. Kidd, Foster and Brett create women's-only lounge. Firehouse 51 celebrates some good news.

programme.title: Crime of Passion
programme.desc: A member of the Firehouse 51 family remains in peril; Cruz lends a hand to Severide in the ongoing investigation.

programme.title: I'm an Adult Now
programme.desc: Toby rescues a woman who has been in a car accident and uses his abilities to solve a kidnapping.

programme.title: Emotional Rescue
programme.desc: Toby tracks down an arsonist after saving a childhood friend from a burning building.

programme.title: Carry a Torch
programme.desc: Novak explores a new romantic connection; Vasquez deals with the aftermath of his father's recent release.

programme.title: Frostbite Blue
programme.desc: Herrmann grows uneasy when a local accident attorney inserts himself into a routine call; Firehouse 51 gets a visitor.

programme.title: Welcome to Crazytown
programme.desc: Severide must make a tough decision about the future of his career at Firehouse 51; Herrmann deals with the consequences of his temper; Cruz is excited to demonstrate the Slamigan at the Firefighting Expo; Commissioner Grissom returns.

programme.title: Seeing Is Believing
programme.desc: Severide starts off on the wrong foot at his Office of Fire Investigation assignment when, despite orders, he reopens an old case; Herrmann is on a mission to discover what caused an apartment fire; Kidd finds herself burning the candle at both ends.

programme.title: Best Friend Magic
programme.desc: An unexpected visit throws Casey for a loop; Severide sets out to exonerate a wrongly convicted arsonist; Kidd pays the price for burning the candle at both ends; Cruz goes on a mission to fix one of Otis's old toys.

programme.title: Buckle Up
programme.desc: Toby goes undercover to find a group of thieves posing as police officers.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: Toby and Michelle investigate a potential conspiracy linked to a mob murder trial.

programme.title: Caged In
programme.desc: After witnessing the death of an MMA fighter, Toby looks into the business dealings of two rival leagues.

programme.title: Perverted Justice
programme.desc: A woman wants to recant her testimony and free her father, who was incarcerated for incest and rape when she was a child; Capt. Cragen, who remembers the original investigation, tries to help the team.

programme.title: Parents' Nightmare
programme.desc: Efforts to find an 8-year-old boy kidnapped for ransom are hindered by tension between the child's estranged parents; Sgt. Benson is asked to take the lieutenant's exam and officially become the leader of the squad.

programme.title: Surrendering Noah
programme.desc: When Johnny D (Charles Halford) is on trial for sex trafficking, rape, assault and kidnapping, Noah's adoption becomes involved with the case, causing Benson to fear for the child's future; a threat could permanently change the squad.

programme.title: Devil's Dissections
programme.desc: Detective Rollins hopes to elicit a confession from serial killer Gregory Yates (Dallas Roberts) when a body washes up on the beach where he buried victims, but the information he provides sends shock waves through the police department.

programme.title: Criminal Pathology
programme.desc: Detectives continue to investigate a woman's murder and dismemberment by following a lead provided by serial killer Gregory Yates.

programme.title: The Thin Blue Line
programme.desc: A Mexican drug cartel targets Danny when he intercepts a shipment of several million dollars; Jamie goes after a serial killer who preys on the elderly; Mayor Poole confides in Frank that he plans to retire.

programme.title: Cutting Losses
programme.desc: Danny considers retiring until Erin asks for his help with a case involving her ex-husband; Jamie and Eddie pose as a couple; Frank clashes with the new mayor.

programme.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
programme.desc: Erin's trial against a human trafficker is jeopardized when the presiding judge is found dead; Mayor Dutton opposes Frank's public safety initiative, but a plan is devised to bypass the mayor's veto.

programme.title: Ghosts of the Past
programme.desc: Frank is ordered to attend a parade honoring a man who conspired in a bombing against the police; Danny investigates the return of a teen who suspiciously disappeared 13 years ago; Jamie and Eddie try to help a woman they believe is being exploited.

programme.title: Out of the Blue
programme.desc: Danny and Baez investigate a case of a detective who was gunned down prior to testifying against a career criminal; Frank personally investigates when Garrett is attacked by a SWAT team outside his home; Erin brings in a confidential informant.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a single mother whose ex-husband has a history of violence; Mayor Dutton eliminates solitary confinement in prisons; Jamie's efforts to save a young woman who overdosed on drugs has unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Brushed Off
programme.desc: A famous basketball player is found dead of an apparent drug overdose; Danny looks into possible ties to a local drug gang; Erin revisits the case of a man she may have wrongfully convicted years ago; Frank is approached by Archbishop Kearns.

programme.title: Common Ground
programme.desc: A case turns personal when Danny works to protect a nurse from her violent ex-boyfriend; an acquaintance of Frank's comes forth with a theory regarding the death of an inmate; Jamie and Eddie help deliver a baby.

programme.desc: Kenny feels nostalgic in Koreatown, so he brings along an old friend, which may or may not be a good idea; Brandi and Jarrod sweeten their profit in an unexpected way; Ivy tolerates the big city in an effort to find some name-brand goodies.

programme.title: Cheesy Does It!
programme.desc: Kenny learns about being a not-so-easy rider; Rene and Casey string up a fair amount of hits in their unit full of boxes; Dusty and Lupe lead with their parenting senses, while Lisa's animal instincts lead her to the real cheddar.

programme.title: Sundown Showdown
programme.desc: The buyers hope to land late-night treasures in Huntington Beach, Calif.; Darrell and Brandon look for great lockers on their home turf; Dave seeks a score or a sucker.

programme.title: For a Good Time Call... Ivy
programme.desc: Ivy pranks the competition; Rene and Casey space out; Jarrod and Brandi may have to close their Long Beach store if they can't score a major profit.

programme.title: Santa Ana Surprise
programme.desc: Dave causes trouble for Jarrod and Brandi in Santa Ana, Calif.; Mary tries to end a lengthy losing streak; Rene needs help with a massive score.

programme.title: High Scores in Arcadia
programme.desc: The buyers visit the upper-class city of Arcadia, Calif., Darrell and Brandon are caught pulling shenanigans; Rene is joined by his father in the hunt for collectibles; Ivy gambles on something out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Fears of a Clown
programme.desc: It's a regular father and son shootout in Victorville, Calif., as Ivy and Pops try to prove who among them is the most profitable; Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for, but luckily Kenny is there to brighten her day.

programme.title: That's My Jerry!
programme.desc: The buyers roll into Compton, Calif.; Jarrod gets a new nickname; Mike purchases a locker that Herb doesn't want; Barry is reunited with his old friend Kenny.

programme.title: Game of Groans: Whittier Is Coming
programme.desc: Kenny tries to reclaim the title of King of Whittier but has trouble amassing any shillings; Ivy & Ivy brave the cold to find their fortunes; Lisa finally graduates to full-fledged buyer, finding an unlikely mentor along the way.

programme.desc: The Lord of Lancaster asserts his reign by levying tariffs on the little people; Lisa & Kerri stitch together some antique accoutrements; Dusty & Lupe spot some gold in an immense locker; Kenny finally finds himself some decent profit.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Terrors
programme.desc: Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!

programme.title: Twice Told Tales
programme.desc: Virtuoso of horror Vincent Price ("Tales of Terror") dials up the depravity in this spellbinding trilogy of Nathaniel Hawthorne's chilling classics!

programme.title: The Last Man On Earth
programme.desc: Horror legend Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that turns humans into vampire-like zombies...and his life into an endless nightmare!

programme.title: The Return Of Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula flees Europe and ends up in a small California town. And his ravenous thirst is quickly turning the Golden State into...the ghoulish state!

programme.title: The Vampire
programme.desc: When a physician accidentally swallows experimental bat serum pills, he finds himself saving patients by day...and sucking their blood by night!

programme.title: Rockula
programme.desc: Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he's going to end the curse!

programme.title: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: After being bitten on the neck during a night of passion, an agent is convinced he's a vampire.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Mark wants to go all the way. His girlfriend won't, but he meets a beautiful vampire who will! The problem? He's starting to feel a little batty.

programme.title: Howling II: Your Sister Is A Werewolf
programme.desc: In this cult-classic sequel, when the brother of doomed newscaster Karen White, her co-worker and a mysterious stranger (Christopher Lee) set out to save the world from a werewolf invasion, they must first destroy an immortal werewolf queen!

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: Audrey Rose
programme.desc: Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

programme.title: The Dunwich Horror
programme.desc: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

programme.title: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
programme.desc: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

programme.title: Ghoulies
programme.desc: It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

programme.title: Ghoulies II
programme.desc: The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Motel Hell
programme.desc: In this horror cult-classic, Vincent and his sister own the "Motel Hello," where they sell their delicious smoked meats made fresh on their farm. But something strange is going on over there. Folks are checking in...but no one is checking out!

programme.title: The Burning
programme.desc: Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Five years after the massacre at Camp Arawak, Angela is now working at Camp Rolling Hills. She's still crazy...for camping and good clean fun, that is. But Angela draws the line at bad behavior and she's going to teach some naughty campers a lesson!

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Under inept new management, Camp Rolling Hills is now Camp New Horizons and it's the ideal setting for a notorious psychopath like Angela Baker to do what she does best, eliminating "immoral" teenagers with everything from a knife to a lawnmower.

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: The Town That Dreaded Sundown (2014)
programme.desc: 65 years after a serial killer terrorized the town of Texarkana, the so-called 'moonlight murders' begin again. Is it a copycat or something even more sinister? A lonely high school girl, with dark secrets of her own, may be the key to catching him.

programme.title: The Return Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: On his first day at a medical supply warehouse, Freddy (Thom Mathews) unwittingly releases toxic gas from a secret U.S. military canister. The gas reanimates an army of corpses, who arise from their graves with a ravenous hunger...for human brains!

programme.title: The Video Dead
programme.desc: On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

programme.title: The Blood On Satan's Claw
programme.desc: Horror, suspense, and the occult mix to make this a hair-raising experience even for veteran horror fans.

programme.title: The Conqueror Worm
programme.desc: Under the guise of a witch-hunt, the notorious "witch hunter" Matthew Hopkins and his henchmen ravage and plunder a lawless England. Innocent men and women are tortured and put to death for being witches...but one man is determined to stop them.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.

programme.title: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes

programme.title: Doc

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: Gunslinger

programme.title: The Indian Fighter

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba

programme.title: The Hills Run Red

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun

programme.title: End Time Prophecy of the Popes

In this he foretold the end of the papacy, the destruction of Rome, and the Last Judgment. Is this only one more apocalyptic vision? Another 'end of the world' tale like the one people have imagined in the Mayan calendar? Perhaps not.

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.desc: Some scientists say every major event, major figure in history and even ordinary people appear to be encoded in a mysterious cipher called the Bible Code. Is it possible?

programme.title: Bible Code Foretold 9/11: Did the Bible Code Predict 9/11?
programme.desc: September 11, 2001 is a date etched in world history. One researcher says the Bible Code warned of the attack. Is this possible? Does the Bible provide prophetic information?

programme.title: The Crusades
programme.desc: Host, Seth Udinski, explores the epic clashes between Islam and Christianity that occurred throughout the Medieval Period.

programme.title: Israel, Islam, and Armageddon
programme.desc: With more than 3000 years of history, Jerusalem is mentioned 800 times in the Bible, and prophesied to play a key role in world destiny. Many of these prophecies have already come to pass, with some yet to be fulfilled. This video shows how the current peace process is fraught with peril, why it is impossible for Jerusalem to know true peace in our age, and the Palestinian myth.

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John. Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically based film will inspire viewers.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Romero Collector's Edition
programme.desc: In honor of Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador, the Romero Collector's Edition film has been remastered and chronicles the amazing true transformation of an apolitical, complacent priest to a committed leader, who started a revolution without guns, without an army, without fear.

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Biblical Prophecies
programme.desc: Approximately 2,500 prophecies appear in the Bible and 2,000 have been fulfilled. Did biblical prophets have special abilities that allowed them to foretell the future? Has modern technology actually created the devices for these ancient predictions of impending disasters to come true? Explore the predictions of the prophets, then decide for yourself: Are ancient prophecies today's reality?

programme.title: Biblical Rapture
programme.desc: Since the dawn of the new millennium predictions of the apocalypse have reached a fever pitch. Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Biblical End Times
programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: Moses-Man of God
programme.desc: Two of the world's great religions, Christianity and Judaism, base many of their most important beliefs on declarations made to Moses atop Mt. Sinai. Are the miraculous stories attributed to Moses factual? Did Moses receive the Ten Commandments from God?

programme.title: Biblical Old Testament Mysteries
programme.desc: Did the legendary cities of sin Sodom and Gomorrah really exist? Were they destroyed by fire and brimstone? Did looking at the destruction turn people into pillars of salt? Archaeological discoveries include the findings of bodies encased in salt may answer these questions. Has the Tower of Babel been found? Have the modern sciences of linguistics, sociology and archaeology given us the answer?

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Noah's Ark and the Biblical Flood
programme.desc: Nearly 200 ancient cultures recorded an all-encompassing flood; all with astonishing parallels to the biblical flood account of Noah's Ark. Was there a deluge of such proportion that it covered the entire earth? Was the entire population of the earth wiped out but for a handful of people? Is the artifact on Mt. Ararat really Noah's Ark? Has modern technology finally answered these questions?

programme.title: Early Years of Jesus
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: Lost Biblical Treasures
programme.desc: The legendary Holy Grail, believed to be a relic of the Last Supper of Christ, has eluded searchers for 2,000 years and the quest continues today. Or has it actually been found as some claim and are its legendary powers real? Will scientists ever decipher the Copper Scroll found near the Dead Sea and learn the way to a 2,000 year old treasure?

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Biblical Armageddon
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Biblical Adam and Eve
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. What are archaeologists, paleontologists, biologists and theologians saying today? Is the story fact or fiction? The evidence may shock you. Where was the Garden of Eden? What was it like? Does it still exist, if indeed it ever did? Explore the evidence and journey back to the original birthplace of man.

programme.title: Lily's Star Boarder
programme.desc: The Munsters unknowingly rent their spare bedroom to a policeman.

programme.title: John Doe Munster
programme.desc: Herman develops amnesia when he is hit on the head by a 300-pound safe falling from a building.

programme.title: The Man for Marilyn
programme.desc: A frog becomes Marilyn's beau.

programme.title: Herman's Driving Test
programme.desc: Herman must regain his license to accept a promotion as driver of the hearse at the funeral parlor.

programme.title: Will Success Spoil Herman Munster?
programme.desc: Herman becomes a popular folk-singer.

programme.title: The Treasure of Mockingbird Heights
programme.desc: Herman and Grandpa discover a clue to the pirate treasure hidden in their backyard.

programme.title: Herman's Peace Offensive
programme.desc: Herman is forced to practice what he preaches when he urges Eddie to ignore a schoolyard bully.

programme.title: Herman Picks a Winner
programme.desc: Herman tries to teach Eddie a lesson on the futility of gambling.

programme.title: Just Another Pretty Face
programme.desc: Herman is "disfigured" when he is hit by a bolt of artificial lightning from one of Grandpa's machines.

programme.title: Heap Big Herman
programme.desc: Vacation-bound Herman blunders into a remote American Indian village after he is accidentally left behind.

programme.title: The Most Beautiful Ghoul in the World
programme.desc: A windfall causes disagreement.

programme.title: Grandpa's Lost Wife
programme.desc: Grandpa could be married.

programme.title: The Fregosi Emerald
programme.desc: Grandpa warns Marilyn that the emerald ring Eddie gave her may bring bad luck.

programme.title: Zombo
programme.desc: Herman believes Eddie's affection is being stolen by a children's television idol.

programme.title: Cyrano de Munster
programme.desc: Herman pens himself into trouble when he ghostwrites love letters for a shy co-worker.

programme.title: The Musician
programme.desc: Grandpa concocts a potion to provide instant talent for Eddie when Herman forces him to take up the trumpet.

programme.title: Prehistoric Munster
programme.desc: Two of Marilyn's teachers decide to present Herman to the scientific world as the only living prehistoric man.

programme.title: A Visit From Johann
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein's great-grandson arrives with cousin Johann, who looks exactly like Herman.

programme.title: Eddie's Brother
programme.desc: Grandpa creates a playmate for Eddie.

programme.title: Herman, the Tire-Kicker
programme.desc: A used-car salesman hoodwinks Herman.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: After an argument, Herman draws a line down the center of the house and orders Grandpa to stay on his side.

programme.title: Herman's Sorority Caper
programme.desc: Herman is mistaken for a dummy by a couple of fraternity boys, who cart him off to a sorority house.

programme.title: Herman's Lawsuit
programme.desc: Herman thinks he must pay in a lawsuit.

programme.title: A Visit From the Teacher
programme.desc: Eddie's school essay about his family prompts a visit from the principal.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Policemen Slim (Bud Abbott) and Tubby (Lou Costello) go to London and meet a doctor (Boris Karloff) and his evil alter ego.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. McDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A hotel detective (Bud Abbott) and bellhop (Lou Costello) find dead bodies and a fake swami (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
programme.desc: Two guys stuck in Egypt follow a medallion to the crypt of Klaris.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

programme.title: Bride of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us
programme.desc: Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

programme.title: Curse of the Undead
programme.desc: A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.
