programme.title: Dead Man
programme.desc: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. Expecting the worst, she brings her young daughter to safety and travels to the home of Dan Frost (Joel Edgerton), a boozing ex-lover who may be her only hope. With Dan now on her side, Jane prepares for a showdown with the vengeful John Bishop and his gang of thugs. Looking to settle an old score, Bishop must now contend with the gun-toting Jane and her new partner.

programme.title: Aunt Win Steps In
programme.desc: Aunt Win tries to make Luke jealous.

programme.title: Escape to the Ponderosa
programme.desc: Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

programme.title: Death at Dawn
programme.desc: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

programme.title: Escape to the Ponderosa
programme.desc: Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

programme.title: Showdown
programme.desc: A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

programme.title: Spanish Grant
programme.desc: A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

programme.title: Denver McKee
programme.desc: The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

programme.title: The Town Councilman
programme.desc: George runs for town council.

programme.title: The Fishing Contest
programme.desc: Grandpa vs. George in fishing.

programme.title: Blow the House Down
programme.desc: Little Luke practices the trumpet.

programme.title: New Doctor in Town
programme.desc: Grampa uses home cold remedies.

programme.title: Her Flaming Youth
programme.desc: Old photo of Flora scantily clad.

programme.title: The Handsome Salesman
programme.desc: Kate falls victim to a sales pitch.

programme.title: The Matchmaker
programme.desc: Grandpa fixes a man up with Flora in a trade to get the man's dog.

programme.title: Pepino's Vacation
programme.desc: Grampa sends Pepino on vacation.

programme.title: The Bank Loan
programme.desc: The family needs a bank loan.

programme.title: Gambling Is a Sin
programme.desc: A billboard is placed on the roof.

programme.title: The Perfect Swine
programme.desc: Grampa and George duel over pigs.

programme.title: The Incorruptibles
programme.desc: Grandpa, Luke, and George are judges.

programme.title: The Girl Veterinarian
programme.desc: A woman veterinarian treats a sick cow.

programme.title: A Saint of Travelers
programme.desc: Blue Feather pursues Bishop Lamy and Tom Forbes after his sister converts to Christianity; the bishop helps a man stricken with cholera, giving Tom a lesson on faith.

programme.title: The Fastest Nun in the West
programme.desc: In a brawling frontier town, Sister Blandina tries to stop a hanging.

programme.title: Doc Holiday's Gold Bars
programme.desc: Doc Holliday wants to con a banker.

programme.title: Gold Is Where You Find It
programme.desc: A detective disguises himself as a Mexican to clear himself of a robbery charge.

programme.title: The Rosebush of Tombstone
programme.desc: A woman reforms herself in Tombstone.

programme.title: The King of Uvalde Road
programme.desc: Postal officials ask Harry, a gunman, to find a way to stop King Fisher from blocking mail from arriving in Uvalde; Fisher fears he will lose his power if he opens his road to the post office.

programme.title: The Greatest Scout of All
programme.desc: Sitting Bull's war plans come between scout Frank Grouard and his Sioux bride.

programme.title: The Sinbuster
programme.desc: A man of the cloth finds it difficult to adjust to life in a rugged desert town.

programme.title: Dress for a Desert Girl
programme.desc: A prospector's wife waits for a dress.

programme.title: The Baron of Arizona
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a land baron.

programme.title: A Wrangler's Last Ride
programme.desc: A former cowhand shuns progress.

programme.title: Rough and Ready
programme.desc: Newcomers get little welcome in a gold-mining town, particularly an Easterner who swindled his way in.

programme.title: Green Is the Color of Gold
programme.desc: Aaron's wife Rosie threatens to leave him and their dilapidated homestead until he makes a discovery with the potential to earn them a fortune.

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: Ex-bounty hunter Talion (Robert Lansing) comes home one day to find his house ablaze and his entire family slaughtered. He soon learns that the culprits are a gang led by nasty Ike Slant (Slim Pickens). While tracking the outlaws, Talion meets fellow bounty hunter Benny (Pat Wayne), who's also after Ike. Initially mistrustful of each other, Benny and Talion are forced to work together when, during a shootout with the criminals, the latter is blinded and the former injures his shooting hand.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

programme.title: The Resurrection of Deadwood Dick
programme.desc: The mayor of Deadwood comes up with a manufactured Western hero to lure tourists into his dying town.

programme.title: A Calamity Called Jane
programme.desc: Calamity Jane meets Wild Bill Hickok.

programme.title: The Biggest Little Post Office in the World
programme.desc: Postal inspector Wesley Hull is determined to discover how postmaster Jack Reardon can sell so many stamps in such a small town.

programme.title: Long Night at Fort Lonely
programme.desc: Renegade Natives led by a white man named Clay terrorizes the residents living in a decommissioned fort.

programme.title: The Solid Gold Pie
programme.desc: A town's pie supply is threatened when the loveless lady baker decides to leave.

programme.title: Sense of Justice
programme.desc: A young cowpoke gets into a fight with a local over a girl and faces a harsh prison term.

programme.title: Spring Rendezvous
programme.desc: Kit Carson seeks to wed an Arapaho girl.

programme.title: Shanghai Kelly's Birthday Party
programme.desc: A woman outwits a crooked saloonkeeper.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: After Manning cheats to secure an army freight contract, his competitors Red Eagle and Little Fawn must find a way to turn the situation in their favor.

programme.title: The Other Side of the Mountain
programme.desc: A wagonmaster taking a new route to California leads his party astray and faces a revolt.

programme.title: Amos and the Black Bull
programme.desc: Amos, intent on becoming a landowner so he can marry his love Maggie, searches for a black bull to trade for his friend's property.

programme.title: Lucia Darling And The Ostrich
programme.desc: A teacher new to Montana tries to start a school but faces many challenges, including book theft and accusations of being naive to the ways of the West.

programme.title: Dress for a Desert Girl
programme.desc: A prospector's wife waits for a dress.

programme.title: The Mill
programme.desc: Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

programme.title: The Avenger
programme.desc: A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

programme.title: Escape to the Ponderosa
programme.desc: Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

programme.title: Blood on the Land
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

programme.title: The Abduction
programme.desc: Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

programme.title: Badge Without Honor
programme.desc: A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Leaving
programme.desc: Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.

programme.title: On the Trail
programme.desc: Call (Tommy Lee Jones) and Gus (Robert Duvall) are forced into a confrontation with an old enemy who kidnaps and brutalizes Lorena.

programme.title: The Plains
programme.desc: Jake's (Robert Urich) involvement with the Suggs gang reaches a tragic climax; Gus reunites with an old flame (Anjelica Huston).

programme.title: Return
programme.desc: Gus (Robert Duvall) is injured during an Indian attack; Call (Tommy Lee Jones) has a final run-in with Blue Duck.

programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Episode 109
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Episode 110
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Episode 111
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Episode 112
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

programme.title: Episode 114
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Episode 116
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

programme.title: Episode 117
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Episode 119
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Episode 120
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Episode 121
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Episode 124
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world...and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Episode 125
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Episode 126
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study...from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Episode 128
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home...a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Episode 130
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Episode 131
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Episode 132
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life....including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Episode 201
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Episode 202
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Episode 203
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Episode 204
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit."

programme.title: Episode 205
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Episode 206
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Episode 207
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Episode 208
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Episode 209
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Episode 212
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Episode 213
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Episode 214
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Episode 215
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Episode 216
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Episode 217
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Sandkings (Parts One and Two)
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Valerie 23
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: The Second Soul
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: White Light Fever
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Virtual Future
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Living Hell
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Corner Of The Eye
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Under The Bed
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Dark Matters
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: The Conversion
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Quality Of Mercy
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Caught In The Act
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: The New Breed
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: If These Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Birthright
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: A Country on the Edge
programme.desc: Examining the beginning of Lincoln's presidency and the start of the Civil War; as the former one-term congressman prepares to take office, the South severs itself from the United States and the country faces an unprecedented crisis.

programme.title: A Proclamation
programme.desc: Examining Lincoln's journey to the Emancipation Proclamation; the Union Army struggles as Lincoln wrestles with his own mental health.

programme.title: The Dogs of War
programme.desc: As the Civil War ends, Lincoln delivers the most iconic speech and piece of legislation of his career, but at great cost to his marriage and family.

programme.title: Hope, Tragedy and the New Normal
programme.desc: After Lincoln's murder, an epic manhunt for his killer gets underway; Lincoln's assassination sets the stage for civil rights struggles, from Jim Crow to Black Lives Matter.

programme.title: Sardinia
programme.desc: Tucci visits Puglia, a region famous for its fragrant olive oil, beautiful vegetables, cheeses, and durum wheat; he discovers how the Pugliese own their past and embrace the future on their own terms.

programme.title: Liguria
programme.desc: Tucci visits the Italian Riviera famous for the glamor of Portofino and fishing villages of the Cinque Terre; he tries Genoese pesto and discovers how Ligurians have learned to adapt to life in the difficult landscape.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Stanley explores the city's fascinating food culture due to its aquatic environment, as well as the countless influences from around the world throughout its vast and storied history.

programme.title: Piedmont
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Piedmont which boasts a refined French heritage.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Umbria, nicknamed "The Green Heart of Italy"; with the highest consumption of pork per capita, Umbria is a carnivore's dream; from wild boar hunts to black truffle farms, Stanley explores all Umbria has to offer.

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: A dangerous fire leads investigators to re-examine the cause of an unusual death when evidence points in another direction.

programme.title: On the Rocks
programme.desc: A young woman's naked body is discovered in a remote area leading forensic investigators on a search for clues to her identity and the identity of her killer.

programme.title: Portrait of a Serial Killer
programme.desc: A ruthless serial killer terrorizes the residents of a small Texas town, leaving investigators chasing a main suspect.

programme.title: The Ambush
programme.desc: A mysterious murder in an upscale community is solved by mobile phone forensics, after chasing a main suspect's whereabouts.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: The Girls Are Missing Part 1
programme.desc: Women from the Pacific Northwest begin to disappear without a trace.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: Ted Escapes Part 2
programme.desc: While serving time for aggravated kidnapping in Utah and facing first degree murder charges in Colorado, Ted Bundy escapes not once but twice from authorities.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: The Murder Trials Part 3
programme.desc: Ted Bundy helps prepare his own defense, and his amateurishness may help him beat the rap or send him to the electric chair.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: The Death Row Confessions Part 4
programme.desc: While the clock winds down, Bundy makes death row confessions in a desperate attempt to save his own life.

programme.title: The Platinum Age of Television
programme.desc: Television enters the Platinum Age in the 2000s, as storytellers take the medium to new heights; the creative renaissance in television enjoys groundbreaking shows such as "The Sopranos," "Mad Men," "Breaking Bad," "Lost" and "Survivor."

programme.title: I Want My MP3
programme.desc: New technologies, such as Napster, forever change how we listen to music.

programme.title: Mission Accomplished
programme.desc: President George W. Bush responds to the terrorist attacks on Sept. 11, 2001, and launches a global war on terror.

programme.title: Quagmire: Bush's 2nd Term
programme.desc: Exploring President George W. Bush's desire to end insurgency in Iraq while seeking re-election; he must respond to Hurricane Katrina, a burgeoning financial meltdown and his own plummeting poll numbers.

programme.title: Yes We Can
programme.desc: Barack Obama becomes the first African-American elected as US president.

programme.title: The Financial Crisis
programme.desc: The financial crisis of the late 2000s threatened the global economy.

programme.title: The i Decade
programme.desc: Today, products from tech companies such as Apple are ubiquitous.

programme.title: A Pair of New Horseshoes
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get to work on their 1990 Mustang. They install a new front and rear suspension in Project Fast Lane Fox Body to handle its new engine.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 1
programme.desc: From vision to venom an iconic Ford Foxbody Cobra is transformed into a track ready ground pounder! Marc and Tommy wake up this sleepy snake and convert it into a Mustang with plenty of bite! Hello Project Sydewinder!

programme.title: High Tech Dyno Upgrades
programme.desc: The star of our show, the engine dyno, gets a huge upgrade from SuperFlow. Known as the go-to for high performance dynos, they come into the shop and install new hardware and software upgrades to give us the ultimate way to monitor and analyze our engine data.

programme.title: Stock To Stacked: Bumper, Tire, and Suspension Upgrades To A 2021 Bronco
programme.desc: We pull a brand new 2021 Ford Bronco into the shop and make it better! Better bumpers, wheels & tires, steps, and a lift. You'll get our full review of this popular SUV!

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner is Complete - SEMA Build Part 2
programme.desc: Challenging times are coming as the deadline of Project Rapid Runner comes into view. Chris and Eric's 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X still has a ton of work needed to finish up in time for SEMA. Can they do it?

programme.title: What To Look For In An LS Engine
programme.desc: It's no secret that LS engine swaps are the go-to for adding power to your ride. Tommy and Joel walk you through what to do when looking for an LS and even show you how to start it before it goes in your car.

programme.title: Fabricating a Buick Regal Custom Bumper
programme.desc: We add some GNX body panels to our '85 Buick Regal. We clean up and update a set of old Camaro/Nova wheels with fresh paint and trim pieces.

programme.title: Carcass Off-Road Excursion
programme.desc: The Carcass crew invites a few friends out for a day on the trails. We put our Jeep JK to the test and flex it in the hills of East Tennessee.

programme.title: Stage 2 Ram Wrap-Up
programme.desc: Final top end mods, rear locker & traction bars installed before our 1 ton dually hits the strip.

programme.title: Building A Race-Ready 5.0L Coyote From A Pile Of Parts
programme.desc: Ford's high-revving modern engine gets some racy parts, then it is put to the test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Adding 315HP to a 2016 Mustang GT with a Stage 2 Supercharger
programme.desc: From stock to rock, Tommy and Marc introduce the EBC Brakes Mustang GT Giveaway Car and give it more power!

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 4 Taking Shape
programme.desc: Our Silverado is still in the shop getting a few more modifications. We'll add our fuel and brake lines, plus fabricate our double duty exhaust on our frame. We'll strip down the cab inside and out. Then, we'll work on the truck bed to make way for some custom touches like a roll pan and a DIY bed cover.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Tires and Under Armor
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets brand new tires and some much needed under armor. Plus, our 2001 Tacoma gets a spray-on bed liner.

programme.title: 700 Horsepower '86 Jeep Wagoneer Monster Hits the Track
programme.desc: This is a non-stop, complete thrash as we turn a 1986 Jeep Wagoneer into a 700+ horsepower, two-wheel drive monster and put it to the test at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park.

programme.title: The Perfect Project Car?
programme.desc: Can our budget build rival a new Lexus? For our first project, we're taking a bone stock 2011 Lexus IS 250 and spending as little as possible to make it look and drive like a 2025.

programme.title: How Does a Stock Jeep JL Rubicon Perform?
programme.desc: Our Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon Hits the trails. We find out what the JL needs to survive on the 2019 XOR Adventure.

programme.title: Project Fat Stack: Restoring The 1971 Chevy Caprice Front Grille
programme.desc: Face Value - For their 1971 Chevrolet Caprice, the guys restore a hard-to-find grille and finish the fuel system to fully power the supercharged LS.

programme.title: '69 Camaro Gets a Fresh Interior Look with Overhauled Seats and Carpet
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc finish up the last few details on our '69 SeaFoam Camaro. Plus a mechanics fantasy land we head to California for the Matco Tools Expo to see what new products they have coming out.

programme.title: 1977 F-150 Gets Some Much Needed Upgrades
programme.desc: We open the mailbox and answer some long-awaited viewer questions. We'll also hit the road to rescue a 1977 Ford F150 in need of repair.

programme.title: Mopar Big Block and Transmission Drop
programme.desc: Today, our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, gets a major power upgrade. We also get our brakes lined out and connect all the steering linkage for total control. The icing on the cake, we paint the scooped hood and add our Swinger stripe.

programme.title: Resurrecting A '67 Camaro From Nightmare To Dream Car
programme.desc: We pay it forward helping to resurrect a Camaro that is more than just a car for its owner. And we'll head to Las Vegas to meet some Matco Tools merchants who believe in making a living through giving.

programme.title: Big Bore 363 Small Block Ford Part 2
programme.desc: It's Dyno Day! Our 363 SBF comes full circle as we final assemble this engine and put it through the wringer on our dyno. We'll show you the meticulous steps as it becomes a pump-gas eating monster and get it fired up and dialed in. We'll even show what project this beautiful bullet was built for, as we get it ready for its new home.

programme.title: FErocious Ford Part 1
programme.desc: We bring back our beloved 1965 Ford flatbed shop truck and drop in a naturally aspirated 586 HP FE old-school V8 built by Engine Power.

programme.title: Stripping Down a 2006 Trailblazer SS to Make It Drift-Worthy
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy wear out a pair of tires testing their Trailblazer SS in a drift like fashion. Upgrades are already on their minds as they shed some pounds for a better drifting truck.

programme.title: OBS Chevy C1500 Gets a Cantilevered Rear Suspension
programme.desc: We work on the suspension of a 1989 OBS Chevy C1500 truck. It's an upgrade for the front IFS and a fabricated custom rear suspension to get all that LS Power to the ground.

programme.title: A Little Science + A Little Money = Triple the Power?
programme.desc: Building a 363ci race bullet that can take hours of track punishment, Mike and Pat dial in a small block Ford engine delivering almost triple the power for an endurance race team.

programme.title: Put Up or Shut Up: Does Our Upgraded Duramax GMC Denali Deliver At the Strip?
programme.desc: After months in the shop the Duramax in our Sierra Denali gets fired after the cooling issues are solved. Then on to the dyno for a custom tune before it hits the dragstrip.

programme.title: LS Fest West!
programme.desc: Complete coverage of the second annual LS Fest West from Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

programme.title: Dropping A Supercharged Coyote In The '70 RestoMod Mustang
programme.desc: The EBC Fastback Mustang is transformed from an iconic fastback to a muscle packed stallion.

programme.title: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster
programme.desc: We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: We Wrap Up and Lay Frame!
programme.desc: The final touches are added to our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Truck project. Then we hit the open road and see our LOW-Fi lay frame for the first time. This is a MUST SEE show!

programme.title: Phasing Twin Big Blocks For More Power
programme.desc: We seek more power from our twin-engine dyno setup, by reconfiguring the exhaust and phasing the 496 Big Block Chevy engines. Plus we head to Texas to check out SAM Tech's engine program!

programme.title: C10 Teardown and K1500 Goes Rally Racing
programme.desc: LT and Austin start the teardown process and make some upgrade decisions for Project Lo 'n Slo.

programme.title: The FJ60 Makeover Begins
programme.desc: A new project rolls into the shop-our 1987 FJ60 Land Cruiser, and the plan is simple: turn it into an affordable resto-mod daily driver with modern power, suspension, and comfort upgrades. First, we look back at how it drives now and break down the game plan. Then it's teardown time, followed by getting the axles ready for what's coming next: a refreshed third member with updated gears and lockers, plus full axle rebuilds-knuckles, inners, outers, and new brakes.

programme.title: Top 10 American Muscle Part 1
programme.desc: See if your top ten muscle car list matches ours as we count down our favorite American Muscle Cars.

programme.title: Better Breathing for our Big Block Ford
programme.desc: Our 460 Big Block Ford is back for its final iteration, where we upgrade it with a weight saving, better flowing induction. We're looking to up the naturally aspirated horsepower before this beast finds its new home. As always, we'll test our improvement on the Engine Dyno.

programme.title: LS Fest: Test Sled ET's
programme.desc: There's no better place for the test sled's first pass on the strip than LS Fest in Bowling Green, KY!

programme.title: Power Nationals Muscle

programme.title: The Perfect Fit For The '71 Chevy Caprice Body Panels
programme.desc: A touch of glass - We begin to piece our '71 Caprice Fat Stack back together, installing the front and rear glass as well as the hood, deck lid, and body panels showing you some how-to-hints for favorable fitment.

programme.title: Final 48 Hour Fixes
programme.desc: It's the final weekend push that Brian and Jason have to upgrade their 2011 Lexus IS 250, Project Budget Baller. They've only got 48 hours to install a new head unit, better speakers, and gloss black wheel and tires. Will they finish on time?

programme.title: Increasing the Fun Factor of a C5 Z06
programme.desc: Is the C5 Corvette Z06 the ultimate bang for your buck track and street car, or is there room for improvement?

programme.title: '71 Chevy Caprice Gets Perfectly Polished Chrome

programme.title: Model A Engine Mounted
programme.desc: Old skool muscle is on tap for the hot rod Model A pickup, when a muscle car engine gets a home between the frame rails. Plus square bodies are king at the LMC C10 Nationals in Texas

programme.title: 632ci EFI BBC Part 1

Used as a test bed for several different configurations over the years, this big inch bullet gets torn down for a refresh and an update to get it ready for a very special street rod project! A bump in compression, custom hydraulic roller cam, trick new EFI system, and a make-over are on the to-do list as they start the final iteration of this pump-gas powerplant.

programme.title: Testing 4 Common Engine Building Myths: Which Ones Are True?

programme.title: 1000 Horsepower on a Budget? And Rebuilding a Windsor 351
programme.desc: There's No Replacement for Displacement! The Windsor powerplant is getting stroked, plus can this offroad Big Block Chevy bullet make 1000 Horsepower?

programme.title: 1000 Horsepower on a Budget? Rebuilding a Windsor 351
programme.desc: There's No Replacement for Displacement! We made some good power with this Ford powerplant before, but can this bullet rebuild make 1000 Horsepower?

programme.title: Transforming A '72 Dodge Dart From Lawn Ornament To Pavement Pounder
programme.desc: A '72 Dodge Dart gets a second lease on life after an eight-year outdoor slumber.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle Dreamland: A Museum Full Of Mopars
programme.desc: Tommy heads to Alabama to the Wellborn Musclecar Museum to see one of the most prestigious Mopar collections ever.

programme.title: Camaro Racecar Sheds Weight With Carbon Fiber
programme.desc: To make our '72 Chevy Camaro lighter we'll need to shed some weight. We'll show the step-by-step process on how to make your own custom carbon fiber body panels.

programme.title: Reviving the Mud Wagon's 600HP Monster to the Max
programme.desc: The Carcass team prep the Willys cab for a hefty chassis, and give the undercarriage of their military ambulance a lift with some suspension upgrades.

programme.title: Cruisin' Caprice Wagon
programme.desc: The Carcass builders bring in an old 1984 Chevrolet Land Yacht to give it some custom touches for some family fun. They will tear down and clean up 40 years of dirt, then start replacing worn out suspension parts to get this wagon road worthy.

programme.title: Triple Threat Exhaust
programme.desc: Our split-bumper Camaro receives a hand-crafted exhaust, designed by one of Magnaflow's own.

programme.title: Saddled Up
programme.desc: It's all about the looks as Tommy and Peyton start on the interior changes to their 1990 Fox Body Mustang. Once ready, they'll install a fuel system to make this horse sprint.

programme.title: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis
programme.desc: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis

programme.title: 440ci Motown LS Race Engine: Part II
programme.desc: We finish the assembly of our 440 with a conventional SBC bottom end and LS induction. Then we put it on the dyno and see how many ponies it puts out!

programme.title: Prerunner Protection, Skidplate, Lights, and More
programme.desc: The Prerunner Ranger gets desert protection, lights and wiring toward ignition.

programme.title: Boosted Classic 292 Straight-Six
programme.desc: LT and Austin drop in a boosted 292 six cylinder in the '65 C10 Project Low-n-Slo. Plus, a new 5-speed manual transmission, inner cooler, and brightwork help complete this frame off restoration.

programme.title: A Bit of Plastic Surgery
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton's 1990 Mustang is about to undergo a major transformation with a new widebody kit. By the end of the day, this car will go from a compact pony to a powerful, commanding presence on the road.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Teardown
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller

programme.title: Turn The Volume Up For The AMC Javelin's New Set Of Side Pipes
programme.desc: Javelin gets a new sick sound with a set of side pipes, before hitting the road for a little fun.

programme.title: Upgrading a K1500 5.3 Fuel System
programme.desc: Our '88 K1500 AWD Chevy needs more fuel for the 5.3L, so it's time to feed the beast!

programme.title: Transforming a Honda Civic Hatchback Into The Ultimate Rally Car Part 1
programme.desc: We find a parked Honda Civic and try to get it back on the road. Then take it to the shop and start planning what to build.

programme.title: Spec Miata Hammers Down at the Track
programme.desc: We show you painting tips on how to properly prep your aging clear coat for paint. Then we give our Mazda a fresh look before heading to the track to test those performance parts!

programme.title: SCCA SPEC Mustang Part 2
programme.desc: Our SPEC Mustang Project is back for final touches, as we get it ready to hit the track. After we finish our upgrades, we do just that and head to a Summit Racing Event and put it to the test.

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner Introduction - SEMA Build Part 1
programme.desc: Chris and Eric begin the craziest build of the season: A 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X for the ultimate kayak enthusiast. They're calling it "Rapid Runner" and the plan is simple: build the best kayaking vehicle in the world. The craziest thing of all, they've only got one month to do it.

programme.title: Our Sleeper Granada Gets Four Times The Horsepower!

Project Spartan is getting closer to being a fully functioning machine.

Brandon builds a custom exhaust from scratch, and the guys dive deep into rear suspension: CAD designs, 3D-printed mockups, custom-made parts, and some head-to-head welding to get the leaf springs and rear axle finally under the truck.

programme.title: Tacoma Trail Rig Transformation

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.desc: When flames tore through a Buffalo, New York home in 2018, the investigation revealed a toxic relationship and a hot-tempered arsonist, Frank Bredt, Jr. Now Bredt is talking about his crime from behind bars. In this episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott revisits the fire, the evidence, and the unraveling timeline - exposing a jilted lover hidden behind smoke and destruction and giving viewers an unfiltered look into the chilling death of an innocent mother.

programme.title: The Golden Boy - Tommy Gilbert, Jr.
programme.desc: In his first ever television interview, killer Thomas Gilbert, Jr. discusses the murder that shook New York's elite. The Princeton-educated Gilbert became a tabloid obsession when he shot his father after his $1,000 allowance was cut off. But in this unique installment of Interview With a Killer, Gilbert appears to be a far cry from his once golden upbringing. Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.

programme.title: Overkill - Nicholas 'Pickles' Camfield
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Unmasked - Celeste Beard Johnson
programme.desc: She's one of the most camera-friendly killers in true crime history. A glamorous Texas social climber turned convicted black widow. Celeste Beard Johnson has done many television interviews, flashing a smile as she proclaims her innocence and pleads for sympathy. But she's never been questioned by David Scott. And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.

programme.title: MI v. Vander Ark - Monsters In Plain Sight
programme.desc: In a case that shocked the nation, a mother and son stand trial for the unthinkable; Shanda Vander Ark, once a promising law clerk, now faces murder charges in the death of her own child.

programme.title: VPI: Vinnie Politan Investigates
programme.desc: Lindsay Clancy's ex-mother-in-law testified on her behalf as the defense continued presenting evidence in the case involving the deaths of Lindsay's three children.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. Although the local political establishment, especially crooked Governor Chalk (Norman Beaton), insists that small-time thief Maubee (Robert Townsend) is responsible, Xavier has his doubts. This view is complicated by the police chief's personal history with Maubee: The men have been friends since childhood.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: The Trap
programme.desc: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

programme.title: Denzel Washington: Falling Forward
programme.desc: From humble beginnings to Oscar-winning Hollywood icon, actor Denzel Washington's career spans television, film and Broadway.

programme.title: Number One With a Bullet
programme.desc: Detectives Barzak and Hazeltine are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Cops and Robbers
programme.desc: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Macklin (Alec Baldwin), a hit man with a passion for rare jazz records, accepts what he thinks is a routine job. The hit turns out to be a setup, though, because Pointy (Michael Jai White), an up-and-coming gangster, wants Macklin out of the way. When Macklin realizes who's behind the setup, the two criminals enter into an increasingly deadly cat-and-mouse game. Before long, the feud expands to include tough female cop Petrone (Rebecca De Mornay) and top Mafia bosses.

programme.title: Food Meets Art
programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Cooking for the Crew
programme.desc: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

programme.title: Carne Asada with La Familia
programme.desc: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

programme.title: Legends of the Sonoran Sea
programme.desc: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

programme.title: Welcome to Guadalajara
programme.desc: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

programme.title: Hacienda Ranch Food
programme.desc: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

programme.title: Super Sonoran
programme.desc: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

programme.title: Sonoran Family Favorites
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

programme.title: The Blessing and The Benefit
programme.desc: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

programme.title: Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
programme.desc: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

programme.title: Hermosillo Food Crawl
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

programme.title: The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy

programme.desc: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable.

programme.title: The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
programme.desc: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe.
