programme.title: The Devil's Doorway
programme.desc: Northern Ireland, 1960: Father Thomas Riley and Father John Thornton are dispatched by the Vatican to investigate reports of a miracle, a statue of the Virgin Mary weeping blood, at a remote Catholic asylum for immoral women. Armed with 16mm film cameras to record their findings, the priests instead discover a depraved horror show of sadistic nuns, satanism and demonic possession. Supernatural forces are at work here, but they are not the doing of God.

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: Weapons attached to one arm, four young women must fight like gladiators as a bloodthirsty crowd cheers them on.

programme.title: Pay the Ghost
programme.desc: Haunted by eerie images and unexplainable messages, a man (Nicolas Cage) tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of his son.

programme.title: The Vigil
programme.desc: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

programme.title: American Fable
programme.desc: With her family's livelihood imperiled by the farm crisis during the 1980s, 11-year-old Gitty loses herself in a world of fantasy and make believe. But she stumbles into her own fairy tale when she makes a startling discovery: a well-dressed mystery man being held captive in her family's silo. It's the beginning of a labyrinthine journey that will turn Gitty's world upside down and force her to question her loyalty to her own family.

programme.title: The Houses October Built
programme.desc: Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

programme.title: The Houses October Built 2
programme.desc: Still recovering from the trauma of being kidnapped on the previous Halloween by the Blue Skeleton - a group that takes extreme haunt to another level - five friends decide they must face their fears to move on. Heading back out on the road to visit more haunted house attractions, new terror begins when signs of the Blue Skeleton start appearing again.

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: A girl plays a game with her friends and summons the creature known as the Midnight Man, who uses their worst fears against them.

programme.title: The Dead Room
programme.desc: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

programme.title: Ghost Stories
programme.desc: Professor Phillip Goodman devotes his life to exposing phony psychics and fraudulent supernatural shenanigans. His skepticism soon gets put to the test when he receives news of three chilling and inexplicable cases -- disturbing visions in an abandoned asylum, a car accident deep in the woods and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre stories seems to have a sinister connection to the professor's own life.

programme.title: Wendigo
programme.desc: A blue Volvo makes its way through the fading light this chilly winter evening in upstate New York. Kim (Patricia Clarkson), George (Jake Weber) and their 8-year-old son, Miles (Erik Per Sullivan), are city dwellers stealing a weekend away at a friend's country farmhouse. But a fluke accident sets off a chain of events that alters their lives forever and conjures up the ferocious spirit of the Wendigo, a Native American myth made manifest in Miles' imagination.

programme.title: I Remember You
programme.desc: A young man and woman move to a small, abandoned town in Iceland and begin renovations on an old house. Little by little they learn about the town's dark history.

programme.title: Hellbender
programme.desc: A teen and her mother live simply in a home in the woods, spending their time making metal music. A chance encounter with a fellow teen causes her to uncover a connection between her family and witchcraft, which causes a rift with her mother.

programme.title: Night's End
programme.desc: After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.

programme.title: Pyewacket
programme.desc: A frustrated, angst-ridden teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to evoke a witch to kill her mother.

programme.title: Relic
programme.desc: A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

programme.title: The Pact
programme.desc: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

programme.title: The Pact II
programme.desc: A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.

programme.title: The Dead Room
programme.desc: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

programme.desc: Bill entertains friends who are Japanese. The twins are interested by their culture. At the Japanese New Year celebration, the twins meet the grandfather and they tell him how fascinating he is.

programme.title: The Fish Watchers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill is working extra hours and the twins miss spending time with him. A co-worker suggests buying a fish tank and using that as a way to promote togetherness.

programme.title: The Day Nothing Happened
programme.desc: Bill is looking forward to a vacation, and Cissy is looking forward to her date with someone new. But the weather turns bad, and there is a blizzard. Everyone is kept at home.

programme.title: A House in the Country
programme.desc: Bill thinks living in the city is not good for the children, and considers moving to the country.

programme.title: A Matter of Tonsils
programme.desc: When Buffy has an operation to remove her tonsils, Jody complains of a sore throat, too. Uncle Bill and French think he's simply looking for attention until the doctor looks at them.

programme.title: A Member of the Family
programme.desc: Cissy is taking an art class and has been drawing caricature images of the family members, but not for Mr. French. He is hurt, however, Cissy has his picture and wants to surprise him with it.

programme.title: His and Hers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill & Mr. French attend Buffy & Jody's open night at school to view their latest art and work. At school, Bill meets another single parent with two young children and one teenager.

programme.title: The Thursday Man
programme.desc: For a school project, Cissy wants to write a story about Mr French. She starts following him and finds out what he does every Thursday.

programme.title: Think Deep
programme.desc: Cissy develops an infatuation with her school teacher who teaches philosophy and spouts big ideals that everyone should follow. Bill finds a way to show that the teacher is just a regular man.

programme.title: On Again, Off Again, Lohengrin
programme.desc: The bickering Hubbards and Buells are stunned when their kids return from a night out announcing they're engaged. After arguments about the wedding plans are finally settled.

programme.title: Everybody Goes on a Honeymoon
programme.desc: The Hubbards and the Buells show up at the same resort, and when their honeymooning kids unexpectedly arrive, rained out at their original destination, the in-laws spend a sleepless night together.

programme.title: All Fall Down
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye break their legs skiing and are bedridden in the same room.

programme.title: A Night to Forget
programme.desc: Going to a store to return a duplicate wedding gift for the kids, the mothers are unknowingly getting locked in the store when it closes.

programme.title: The Newlyweds Move In
programme.desc: Checking out the place that the kids have rented, the mothers return their deposit and fix up the Hubbards' garage apartment. Their snooping gets them caught hiding in the kids' shower.

programme.title: The Career Girls
programme.desc: To cut down on their wives' meddling, Herb and Roger suggest that they get jobs. Realizing that all their "suggesting, recommending, and advising" might just be too much, they decide to try it.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Elizabeth Taylor?
programme.desc: When Roger and Herb admit that they would date Liz Taylor if given the chance, their wives console each other at the Buell house, leaving their befuddled husbands to go it alone next door.

programme.title: My Son, the Actor
programme.desc: Jerry decides to major in dramatic arts, giving everyone the showbiz bug. Suzie and all four parents tune up to help him audition for the school musical.

programme.title: How Do You Moonlight a Meatball?
programme.desc: When the kids in a financial bind, Eve and Kaye decide to help pay off Suzie's ring by selling Kaye's famous spaghetti and meatballs on the college campus.

programme.title: I Thought He'd Never Leave
programme.desc: A fugitive bank robber holds everyone at gunpoint at the Hubbards' home, whiling away the time playing gin rummy, and everyone hopes that Kaye's newly acquired karate skills will help.

programme.title: The New Cissy
programme.desc: Cissy thinks the boys do not like her because there is something wrong with her, so Uncle Bill pays to have different people coach her in dress, makeup, talking, walking, and more.

programme.title: The Family Outing
programme.desc: Uncle Bill decides a weekend camping trip would be a great way for everyone to spend time together. Only two people enjoy the trip.

programme.title: Mr. French's Holiday
programme.desc: Mr. French takes a two-week vacation to the west with the others staying home. When Bill is called away to South America for work, the children end up flying out west to be with Mr. French.

programme.title: The Beasley Story
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy accidentally pull off the arm of Mrs. Beasley and it is a traumatic event.

programme.title: The Baby Sitters
programme.desc: Cissy agrees to babysit. Cissy gets a chance to go a concert, so she has a friend take her place. She gets sick, so her mother watches the kids, who then calls her husband...

programme.title: Family Portrait
programme.desc: Bill returns home from a business trip and finds that Cissy's hair style is different, Buffy has a new tooth, and he does not know who Jody's best friend is. Bill decides to become a full-time dad.

programme.title: The Latch Key Kid
programme.desc: Buffy wants more independence. Jody is allowed to go to some places on his own, but Buffy is not allowed the same privilege.

programme.title: By a Whisker
programme.desc: Jody wants to a club with the big boys, but they tell him he is too young. To prove he is old enough, they tell him he has to cut of some of Mr. French's whiskers and bring it to them.

programme.title: A Waltz from Vienna
programme.desc: A teenager from a royal family wants to marry Cissy, and she wants to marry him. She thinks she is a grown up who can make her own decisions, but Uncle Bill knows she just wants something different.

programme.title: Your Friend, Jody
programme.desc: A friend of Bill's confides that he is worried about his son growing up in a home with mostly females. That makes Bill wonder about Jody not having enough time with boys. Bill sends him off to camp.

programme.title: The Substitute Teacher
programme.desc: Jody and Buff's school teacher is out for a few days, and there is a substitute teacher. Jody develops a crush on her.

programme.title: Oliver
programme.desc: Uncle Bill allows Buffy & Jody to have a friend stay over for a few days while the parents are out of town. But then Uncle Bill finds out the friend is a dog, and pets are not allowed in the building.

programme.title: Christmas Came a Little Early
programme.desc: Buffy makes friends with a girl in the building, and finds out the girl may not live too much longer. Buffy asks Uncle Bill to have a Christmas holiday because Eve might not be alive in December.

programme.title: The Unsound of Music
programme.desc: Buffy's class is practicing to perform in a singing program, but Buffy's voice is terrible. Uncle Bill hires a singing coach to help her.

programme.title: Albertine
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy make friends with a new girl at school whose father seems to always be out of town. Jody and Buffy find out the girl's father has really left the family and may never return.

programme.title: A Matter of Choice
programme.desc: Uncle Bill feels that Buffy and Jody would benefit from listening to fairy tales than watching war-based programs on TV, but the fairy tales end up giving them nightmares.

programme.title: Ciao, Uncle Bill
programme.desc: While on a job in Rome, Bill falls in love with a much younger woman whom he plans to marry, until learning that she has no desire to share his life with Cissy, Buffy, and Jody.

programme.title: A Nanny for All Seasons
programme.desc: After Mr. French is ribbed by his gentlemen peers about also being a nanny, he resigns himself to return to his role as a gentlemen's gentleman and starts to shun the children.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Bill breaks his leg skiing and Buffy, Jody, and Cissy give up their free time to take care of him. Bill's girlfriend also wants to help him, but he realizes the children care much more than she does.

programme.title: To Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy is delighted to go with Uncle Bill to Puerto Rico because she gets to have his full attention. However, Bill meets a former girlfriend and it seems like he may divide his time between the two.

programme.title: A Family Group
programme.desc: Cissy is excited to have her friend over, who she envies for her glamorous lifestyle, until her friend reveals that her parents are separated and all she wants is a loving family like Cissy has.

programme.title: A Lesson for Grown-Ups
programme.desc: The kids overhear Bill talking about one of his bridge's collapsing. He goes to the construction site to help. The kids think they are going to lose all their money to help pay for the bridge.

programme.title: Oh, to Be in England
programme.desc: Bill gets a job in England which seems like it might last a year. Everyone plans to move, but then it seems like Bill won't be able to go.

programme.title: A Matter of Privacy
programme.desc: The twins start using a tape recorder to record conversations other people have in private.

programme.title: To the Last Will I Grapple With Thee

programme.title: Angel of Death

programme.title: Badge of Honor

programme.title: Murder on Madison Avenue

programme.title: Murder in Milan

programme.title: Family Secrets

programme.title: The Mole
programme.desc: Officials hesitate to confront Jessica's kidnapper (Ken Howard), a philanthropist who mistook her for a government informant.

programme.title: The Wind Around the Tower

programme.title: The Dead File
programme.desc: Jessica is sued for libel after a comic strip version of her accuses prominent New Yorkers of crimes.

After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: Episode 6

programme.title: Women of Ravensbrück: Inside Nazi Horrors
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: The Reich Underground Part 1
programme.desc: Today, many of the half-built facilities have been long-forgotten. With previously unreleased film material and exclusive interviews, the fascinating and dramatic story of the Underground Reich is reconstructed when the Nazis leaders still hoped that the miracle weapons they produced would bring Germany final victory.

programme.title: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: This program looks at the epic charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood Order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava. It also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

programme.title: The Nazi Machine
programme.desc: By June 1940, Nazi Germany had occupied Paris. France was cut in two. North of the demarcation line was the German-occupied zone and to the south was a zone headed by Marshal Pétain, whose seat of government was in the central spa town of Vichy. The Vichy regime very quickly, and without pressure from the Germans, passed the first Jewish laws.

programme.title: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after the defeat of Kaiser Wilhem the II, the German navy, The Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time through Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain of her naval history and possessed a terrifying weapon that made sure Hitler's visions were realized - The U Boat.

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: First Blood: April-June 1940
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: Britain Under Attack: July-September 1940
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day - The Battle in the Air
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.

programme.title: The Assault on Toulon
programme.desc: Allied troops invade southern France near Toulon in a combined amphibious and airborne assault. A coastal village is occupied after a raging battle between coastal batteries and naval guns. French underground members welcome the allies. Shows Gen. Patch, James Forrestal, and Adm. Hewitt in a landing craft.

programme.title: Establishing the Beachhead
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: Embedded 45 - Shooting War in Germany 2
programme.desc: This second episode covers the last week of March to late April. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: The War In Burma

Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat the Führer and his thirst for power.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler: Volume 1 - The Face of Evil
programme.desc: German produced documentary which chronicles the background, rise to power, rule, and downfall of Adolf Hitler. Includes glimpses of rare documents and extensive interviews with people who served under him. Volume 1 - The Face of Evil explores the path of hitler from insignificance, to World domination, and demonstrates the delusions he had that lead to massive deaths during the War.

programme.title: Valiant Few
programme.desc: Faith conquers fear. Caught behind enemy lines with their Paratroop Battalion, Chaplain Francis Sampson and Medic Fred Banners tend to their wounded unit. But paralyzed by fear of the barrage of shells, Banners is more trouble than help. The Chaplain's faith comes into full force, insisting to remain with the wounded while his unit retreats. Witnessing true faith, the Medic Banners goes to work.

programme.title: Big Picture: Armed Forces Assistance to Korea
programme.desc: For this film presentation in The Big Picture television series, American soldiers are shown as they lend a helping hand to Korea, a country torn apart by war. Americans have traditionally responded to the needs of friends in trouble. Here is a documentary about a gesture which started as an informal assist and has become a giant program for the rehabilitation of certain areas of Korean life.

programme.title: Never So Few
programme.desc: From Pearl Harbor to the Japanese home islands this is the story of the air war in the Pacific. It includes the daring ambush of Yamamota, the remarkable story of Richard Bong and Pappy Boyington as well as the Japanese Kamikazes.

programme.title: Big Slim
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. To any other man, such wounds would have been fatal, but Big Slim was different, toughing it out to lead his unit to victory. Such courage sees the Sergeant remembered even all these years later. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: The U-Boat War

programme.title: Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: This episode chronicles the Battle of The Bulge and how our forces struck back and defeated Hitler's last stand.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: By analyzing different perspectives and narratives, this research aims to contribute to a better understanding of this significant chapter in Soviet and Afghan history. It seeks to shed light on the multifaceted causes that led to the conflict and rectify its 'forgotten' status, ensuring its rightful place in the historical record.

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: The 1st Cavalry Division in Korea - The Big Picture
programme.desc: The Army on horseback that once was the United States Cavalry is no more, for our Army today is a mechanized force. But 'cavalry' is a proud word in military terminology and no one displays that pride more than the men of the 1st Cavalry Division. Today, these men of the division keep alive the cavalry's legendary tradition of bravery by fighting, when they are called upon.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Normandy to the Rhine
programme.desc: In November 1943 at the Tehran Conference, Churchill agreed to an offensive that would once again bring his British forces to full scale combat with the Nazis. Allied Supreme Commander Dwight D. Eisenhower arrived in London in January 1944 for final planning. The obvious route to France was heavily defended and lacked a major port. The only feasible alternative were the beaches of Normandy.

programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. The weeks preceding the end of the conflict would usher in a new world. The Soviets, more powerful than ever, invaded conquered territories and terrorized survivors. The last Nazi soldiers attempted to escape their inevitable fates.

programme.title: Big Picture: Truth is Our Defense
programme.desc: This is the story of the Army's Psychological Warfare activities in the Far East Command, primarily as a tactical weapon in Korea. We augment the effectiveness of our combat forces with the potent weapon of words. Through leaflets, shot by artillery shells or dropped from planes; through radio news and through loudspeakers mounted on tanks and jeeps, we send our messages of truth to the enemy.

programme.title: Episode 6

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. programme.title: Guadalcanal: America's First Offensive
programme.desc: U.S. marines land on the island of Guadalcanal and fight a well dug in Japanese army while also being harassed by Japanese aircraft.

programme.title: Fighting Further Afield: October-December 1940
programme.desc: Worldwide, the conflict continued to escalate as Japan made their presence felt as signatories of the Tripartite Pact, giving Hitler's Axis of Evil more power. Britain stood alone as the nightly bombing raids of the Blitz devastated major cities.

programme.title: On Land in the Air and All at Sea: January-March 1941
programme.desc: The Luftwaffe continued its attempts to bomb Britain into submission, while the German Afrika Korps strengthened its position as Rommel, Hitler's 'Desert Fox', took charge. At sea the naval forces battle each other and the elements.

programme.title: D-Day Anniversary
programme.desc: Replays the drama and battle action of the period of the landing at Normandy and the fierce combat to overcome the wall of 'Fortress Europe' in June 1944.

programme.title: Erwin Rommel
programme.desc: This German Field Marshall had tributes paid to him by both Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler. He was revered by his own troops and respected by those who fought against him. A close adviser to The Fuhrer, and part of an attempt to kill him. Rommel's controversial legacy as both a hero, and a War Criminal is still debated today.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Six months after the fall of France, V. Molotov visited Berlin to discuss how the world was to be divided after victory. He was told Britain was defeated. But Britain wasn't beaten. Just alone.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: After all the joy of the 8th of May 1945, Europe is still in the grip of violence. The Allies are faced with enormous challenges...More than forty million people have been displaced during the conflict and now they all want to go home. Germany is now occupied, and divided into four zones. And people are still hungry. How can a whole devastated continent be rebuilt?

programme.title: The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: Blitzkrieg
programme.desc: Six months have passed with very little action in the Phony War. That is about to end and a new word is added to the vocabulary of warfare - Blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Hitler's Desert War
programme.desc: While the British army puts the Italian forces to rout, Hitler sends the Afrika Korps led by the general Rommel for help. The Desert fox keeps on winning battles until Montgomery, the British commander, sets up a plan to crush his opponent. After the American landing in North Africa the Axis armies have no choice but to surrender and put an end to the Desert War on May the 13rd of 1943.

programme.title: The Superior Force
programme.desc: The second episode starts on the morning of the 22nd of June 1941 when the Germans launched operation Barbarossa, the code name for the invasion of the Soviet Union. 3 million Axis tools faced more than 4.5 million Red Army troops and were outnumbered two to one in tanks, but superior training and strategies gave the Germans the edge.

programme.title: Action T4: A Doctor Under Nazism
programme.desc: This documentary recounts his story and through the man's story, that of the so-called 'Action T4'. Action T4 consisted of eliminating physical and mental disabilities and those people considered by the Nazi regime to be useless or 'asocial'.

programme.title: German Fighters
programme.desc: Hitler acknowledged the existence as the new German air force known as the Luftwaffe on the first of March 1935. The front line fighters of the Luftwaffe during WWII were the Bf-109 and the FW-190. Interviews with pilots who flew these planes and officers who sent them into battle. The film covers German Fighter development and Luftwaffe strategy from the 1930's to the end of World War II.

programme.title: Big Picture: The 2nd Infantry Division in Korea
programme.desc: Here is an exciting film documentary of the famous 'Indianheads,' the men of the U.S. 2nd Infantry Division in Korea. Although the fighting in Korea is over, the deeds of the 2nd Infantry Division will long be remembered. Out of the struggle in Korea have come many accounts of great suffering and even greater heroism, but few of them can match the story as told in this Big Picture program.

programme.title: The War in the China-Burma-India Theatre
programme.desc: In order to get supplies to China, the U.S. must use an overland route through Burma. The Japanese cut off this route when they take control of Burma after the battle of Toungoo. Later, Allied forces push back against the Japanese and found the Ledo route as an alternative route to supply China. Although the Chinese resist the Japanese their efforts to mostly result in a bloody stalemate.

programme.title: Big Picture: United Nations Forces Counterattack
programme.desc: Our allied units throw a powerful counterattack against the Reds, Infantry tanks, artillery, and air all combine to throw the Reds back to the North, The Navy blasts the enemy with rockets. Captain Zimmerman interviews Chaplain Joseph Murphy of Boston, Massachusetts, and Captain John Rock, former company commander with the 1st Cavalry Division in Korea.

programme.title: Concentration Camps Liberated in Germany
programme.desc: In April 1945, just weeks before the war's end, Allied troops advancing on the Western Front uncovered and liberated numerous POW, labor, and concentration camps. It was only when the Americans opened camps like Ohrdruf, Buchenwald, and Dachau in Germany that the world truly grasped the scale of the horrors inflicted by the Nazis, revealing atrocities that had remained hidden until then.

programme.title: Rolling Power
programme.desc: The basic combat formation of the modern land army is the division. Divisions contain all of the elements needed to wage land combat including infantry, armor, artillery and other supporting arms. Divisions are substantial in size from 10,000 to 20,000 troops, nearly 500 armored vehicles and 2000 other vehicles.

programme.title: Part 5 - War of Annihilation
programme.desc: This episode delves into the darkest chapters of the war: the Holocaust and the ideology of racial superiority that fueled Nazi atrocities. It explores the calculated genocide, forced labor camps, and the systematic destruction of entire communities across Europe. The program highlights the resistance movements that fought back, as well as the moral dilemmas faced by the Allied powers.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: Victory in the Atlantic 1943-1945
programme.desc: The U-Boats are ascendant, and their triumphs proclaimed in Germany. But the Allies fight back with new bases in countries bordering the Atlantic Ocean, new anti-submarine techniques and the new escort, or 'jeep', carrier.

programme.title: The Partisan War
programme.desc: By 1943-1944, as the Germans are desperately struggling to hold their ground, they are increasingly hindered by the Soviet partisans, which contain many former Red Army soldiers that had been cut off behind enemy lines. The Germans responded with intensive counter-insurgency campaigns and brutal reprisals against the civilian population.

programme.desc: We conduct a 120mph crash test, pit two Jaguars head to head, and test the Range Rover Evoque.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 2
programme.desc: Tiff tests the two hottest hatches of the year with Mark Higgins, the team test a new Mercedes convertible.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiff drives Lamborghini's Aventador hypercar, Vicki drives Mini's new Coupe, the team test the latest Porsche.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 4
programme.desc: Vicki drives a convertible version of the Ferrari 458, Tiff holds a shootout between two powerful coupes.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 5
programme.desc: Tiff wrestles with the last ever Porsche 911 of its generation, Vicki tests a prototype of Honda's CRZ Hybrid.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 6
programme.desc: Jonny discovers the best driving road in the world. Vicki drives VW's Amarok pick-up on a beach in Portugal.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 7
programme.desc: Tiff drives France's champagne region in a convertible, Vicki holds a race between two cricket stars.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 8
programme.desc: Vicki races in an event that's the first step to becoming a rally champion.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 9
programme.desc: Vicki blast through the Pyrenees in the new BMW M5, Jonny heads to Barcelona to drive SEAT's new city car.

programme.title: Season 20 Episode 10
programme.desc: Vicki learns techniques from police that chauffeur the Royal Family, Tiff races two economical hot hatches.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 1

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 2
programme.desc: Tiff and Jason hold a knock-out tournament to see if the 570hp Mercedes SLS AMG can beat its rivals.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiff conducts a crash test, Vicki is at a motor show where she reveals the latest Pagani hypercar.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 4
programme.desc: Tiff enters the Lamborghini Super Trofeo race series with Lamborghini chief test driver Giorgio Sanna.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 5
programme.desc: Jason is in Iceland being taught how to race a Formula Off-Road buggy up a cliff by a former champion.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 6
programme.desc: Jason is joined by Mika Salon to pit the brand new Mercedes C63 AMG Black Series against its rival from BMW.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 7
programme.desc: Jonny goes to the Isle of Man TT motorbike race and spends the day with 19 times winner John McGuinness.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 8
programme.desc: Vicki is in Denmark experiencing the world of motorbike speedway with triple world champion Nicki Pederson.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 9
programme.desc: Jonny is at the biggest American car show in the world and judges the prestigious best in show competition.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 10
programme.desc: Vicki holds a spectacular race against a jet plane in the ultimate test of the brand new Porsche Boxster. Jonny heads to Norway to test the all new Ford Focus ST hot hatch on an incredible road that every driver should visit in their lifetime

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 11
programme.desc: Jason's in Italy to drive the most talked about hypercar of the year - the 730bhp Pagani Huayra.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 12
programme.desc: Vicki & Jonny pit two four door supercars head to head at the track, Mercedes CLS63AMG v Porsche Panamera GTS.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 13
programme.desc: Tiff and rally star Kris Meeke hold a knockout tournament with four new models to see which is the fastest.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 14
programme.desc: Jonny enters professional drifting in the famous Gatebil show in Norway, driving a specially modified BMW M5.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 15
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is joined by Andreas Mikkelsen for a high octane motoring triathlon.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 16
programme.desc: Vicki is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 17
programme.desc: Vicki goes behind the scenes of designers Pininfarina, the people who shaped Ferrari over the last 50 years.

programme.title: Season 21 Episode 18
programme.desc: Tiff is joined by legend Sabine Schmitz for a head to head battle between of the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 1
programme.desc: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 2
programme.desc: Vicki and Tiff pit the Toyota GT86 against its rival from Renault Sport.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 3
programme.desc: Jonny goes behind the scenes at a crash test performed by EuroNCAP before conducting his own crash test.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 4
programme.desc: Tiff Needell heads to LA to check out the latest car trend to take the USA, restomodding.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 5
programme.desc: Jason and Tiff battle the best cheap hot hatches, The Ford Fiesta ST, RenaultSport Clio and Peugeot 208 GTI.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 6
programme.desc: Tiff is joined by Sabine Schmitz to pit the latest Caterham 7 against its rivals from Morgan and Ariel.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 7

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 8
programme.desc: Jonny tests the Volvo S60 Polestar super saloon against the competition car of Car Champion Fredrick Ekblom.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 9
programme.desc: Vicki enters professional truck racing and goes to Nurburgring where she joins the pit crew of Jochen Hahn.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 11
programme.desc: Vicki goes to the German HQ of the Mini X-Raid team to experience the three toughest jobs in motorsport.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 12
programme.desc: Jonny goes behind-the-scenes at the Indy 500, he hears what makes it so special from winner Dario Franchitti.

programme.title: Season 22 Episode 13
programme.desc: Tiff Needell and Jason Plato hold a track battle between two executive cars with over 1000bhp between them.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: Asesinos de la Montaña
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un matrimonio arreglado para su hija, pero ella se marcha y vuelve con un hombre, mas se arrepiente.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Huevos rancheros
programme.desc: Una mujer le es infiel a su esposo porque ella cree que de esa manera le evitará una muerte sangrienta.

programme.title: La casa que arde de noche
programme.desc: Una prostituta ingresa en un burdel y establece una rivalidad con la dueña del lugar. Luego, trata de arrebatarle el negocio y al amante a la anciana propietaria.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera

programme.title: El caudillo

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: El Quelite
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene una sensación extraña cada vez que escucha la música de una canción.

programme.title: Juan Nadie

programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Sorry to Bother You
programme.desc: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Katie & Michael
programme.desc: Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

programme.title: Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre
programme.desc: Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Carson & Leah
programme.desc: Super-planner Carson has been crashing at her best friend Leah's place. But it's time she found a Nashville pad of her own. Carson knows exactly what she wants, but finding a picture-perfect property that meets her high standards could prove tricky.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Kevin and Shirley
programme.desc: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil
programme.desc: Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Debra & Dan
programme.desc: Along with their three small children, Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo. And though they'd prefer to stay in the heart of the city, it's time to find the sprawling suburban home of their dreams.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Leslie & Tim
programme.desc: Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Emily & Ken
programme.desc: With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

programme.title: Property Brothers - Tom & TJ
programme.desc: Tom and TJ moved to Nashville to pursue a dream job, but they haven't yet put down roots and are cramped into a friend's studio apartment until they do.

programme.title: Property Brothers: George & Jenn
programme.desc: In order to cut down on his monster commute, George and Jenn want to move closer to family and friends. And while that's something they both agree on, they're miles apart when it comes to design.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Marc & Stephanie
programme.desc: Stephanie and Marc are getting frustrated with their house hunt. They've been outbid on a series of properties in the city, and the Property Brothers try to sell them on a radically different approach.

programme.title: Farm to Table
programme.desc: Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

programme.title: D.J.'s Den
programme.desc: Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

programme.title: Family of Five Funhouse
programme.desc: Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

programme.title: Country Supper Club & Coop
programme.desc: Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

programme.title: Inspiring Cake Studio
programme.desc: Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

programme.title: Creative Shipping Container
programme.desc: Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

programme.title: His and Hers Hideaway
programme.desc: Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

programme.title: Outdoor Amphitheater
programme.desc: Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

programme.title: Twins Clubhouse
programme.desc: Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

programme.title: Rustic Barn Rehab
programme.desc: Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

programme.title: Tropical Family Resort
programme.desc: Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

programme.title: Neighborhood Party House
programme.desc: Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

programme.title: 100 Years Newer
programme.desc: After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

programme.title: Paid Off, Styled Up
programme.desc: Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

programme.title: Speakeasy to Me
programme.desc: Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

programme.title: Suite Retreat
programme.desc: Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

programme.title: A Pop of Color
programme.desc: Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

programme.title: New Generation Style
programme.desc: Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

programme.title: A Modern Home and Rental
programme.desc: Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

programme.title: An Elevated Lower Level
programme.desc: Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

programme.title: Two Sisters, One Home
programme.desc: Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

programme.title: Elevated Oasis
programme.desc: With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

programme.title: Every Woman's Dream Home
programme.desc: Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

programme.title: Old Plan to Open Floor Plan
programme.desc: Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

programme.desc: Explore some unique and unusual hotels in the USA, Finland, Canada and Scotland — from a hotel hidden within one of New York's busiest airport runways to a winter wonderland in the Arctic Circle.

programme.desc: Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

programme.desc: Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Karen & Rick
programme.desc: Empty nesters Karen and Rick sold their house the first day it was on the market, and so they've moved into her mom's home until they can find a deluxe retreat where they can hang with their four grandsons in style.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Jessie & Joe
programme.desc: With twin toddlers, ex-marine Joe and Jessie outgrew their cramped Nashville condo before they moved in. And now the search is on for a farmhouse-style home where they'll have plenty of room to grow.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Kyle & Jackie
programme.desc: Kyle and Jackie are living at her mom's until they find a home of their own. And though they've got a healthy budget, they've set their sights on one of the city's priciest neighborhoods.

programme.desc: Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

programme.title: May I Have This Dance?
programme.desc: Mrs Oleson reacts angrily to the news that her 16-year-old son, Willie, is engaged. She tries to prevent the wedding until Willie defies her.

programme.title: Hello and Goodbye
programme.desc: Matthew meets the father who abandoned him; a famous author stays at the Wilder boarding house.

programme.title: Little House: Bless All the Dear Children
programme.desc: Almanzo and Laura Ingalls Wilder's baby girl is kidnapped by a frontier woman whose baby has died.

programme.title: Little House: Look Back to Yesterday
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) stops in Walnut Grove to see the Wilders with his dying son, Albert (Matthew Labyorteaux).

programme.title: Little House: The Last Farewell
programme.desc: Charles and Caroline Ingalls (Michael Landon, Karen Grassle) return to Walnut Grove and lead opposition to a land-grabber.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: The Ingalls family leaves the little house in the Big Woods and heads West.

programme.title: A Harvest of Friends
programme.desc: After promising to fix a store's roof and stack sacks of grain, Charles falls out of a tree.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: Laura and Mary are concerned that other students won't accept them on their first day of school; Nellie Oleson snubs them for their homespun dresses.

programme.title: The 100-Mile Walk
programme.desc: After a hailstorm devastates his crops, Charles learns of blasting work available in a faraway quarry.

programme.title: Mr. Edwards' Homecoming
programme.desc: When Charles brings an old friend home to dinner, Caroline decides the man would be a perfect match for Widow Snider.

programme.title: The Love of Johnny Johnson
programme.desc: Laura becomes enamored by a new student, but he expresses more interest in Mary, which breaks her heart.

programme.title: If I Should Wake Before I Die
programme.desc: Charles helps a woman stage her own wake to ensure her distant children's attendance.

programme.title: Town Party, Country Party
programme.desc: Laura befriends a lonely, crippled girl (Kim Richards) sheltered by her father.

programme.title: Ma's Holiday
programme.desc: Caroline reluctantly leaves the children with a babysitter when Charles invites her on a 6-day trip to Mankato.

programme.title: School Mom
programme.desc: Substitute-teacher Caroline deals with a boy (Dirk Blocker) ridiculed for his limited literacy.

programme.title: The Raccoon
programme.desc: After Laura's pet raccoon bites her and the dog, Charles and Caroline discover it is rabid.

programme.title: The Voice of Tinker Jones
programme.desc: A mute coppersmith (Chuck McCann) plans to end a controversy over a proposed church bell.

programme.title: The Award
programme.desc: Burning the midnight oil preparing for a school contest, Mary causes a fire, and Caroline orders her to withdraw.

programme.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
programme.desc: Feeling rejected, Laura does not pray for the recovery of her sickly newborn brother.

programme.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
programme.desc: A mountain man (Ernest Borgnine) helps Laura deal with guilt over the baby's death.

programme.title: Christmas at Plum Creek
programme.desc: The Ingalls struggle with limited funds as they decide on Christmas gifts.

programme.title: Family Quarrel
programme.desc: The Olesons separate after arguing about the quality of the Ingalls' eggs.

programme.title: Doctor's Lady
programme.desc: Doc Baker falls in love treating Mrs. Oleson's niece for an injured arm.

programme.title: The Circus Man
programme.desc: A traveling showman (Red Buttons) hawks a supposedly medicinal powder from India.

programme.title: Plague
programme.desc: Doc Baker drafts Charles to help townspeople quarantined during a typhus outbreak.

programme.title: Child of Pain
programme.desc: Caroline volunteers Charles to keep a round-the-clock watch on a drunken, abusive father.

programme.title: Money Crop
programme.desc: A school-trained farmer (Alan Fudge) convinces Charles to switch from wheat to a new corn variety.

programme.title: Survival
programme.desc: The Ingalls family, returning from a trip to the city, is stopped by a U.S. marshal looking for a Sioux renegade.

programme.title: To See the World
programme.desc: A farm boy (Mitch Vogel) takes Mr. Edward's tales to heart and heads to the big city.

programme.title: Founder's Day
programme.desc: Founder's Day festivities promise fun and friendly competition for all except aging logger Jim Tyler, who fears losing the log chopping contest to a younger Charles Ingalls.

programme.title: The Richest Man in Walnut Grove
programme.desc: When a company that owes money to Charles becomes bankrupt, Charlies ends up deep in debt and puts a lot of financial strain on the family.

programme.title: Four Eyes
programme.desc: Mary's failing eyes end up causing issues with her schoolwork; when Charles gets her glasses, her class begins to tease her for them.

programme.title: Ebenezer Sprague
programme.desc: Laura Ingalls is stunned to learn that her fishing friend is Walnut Grove's new banker; she gets upset when he accuses her of befriending him to secure a loan.

programme.title: The Big Inning
programme.desc: The town gathers for a baseball match between the Green-Stockings of Sleepy Eye and the men of Walnut Grove.

programme.title: Haunted House
programme.desc: Laura decides to find out for herself if a hermit (John Anderson) is really a maniac.

programme.title: The Spring Dance
programme.desc: Laura and Widow Snider (Bonnie Bartlett) scheme to get dates for the spring dance.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: A dying widow (Patricia Neal) asks the Ingalls to help find homes for her children.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: When it appears the widow's children must be separated, Mr. Edwards makes an announcement.

programme.title: The Camp-Out
programme.desc: Mrs. Oleson complicates the Ingallses' long-awaited camping vacation by deciding that she and her family should go along.

programme.title: At the End of the Rainbow
programme.desc: Laura thinks she has found gold and imagines the glamorous life it can buy.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Laura and Mary's plans to raise money for the pastor's birthday by investing the Sunday-school funds backfire.

programme.title: His Father's Son
programme.desc: Isaiah Edwards attempts to bond with his newly adopted son and buys him a rifle so that the pair can go hunting together; his son, an avid reader, has no interest in hunting.

programme.title: The Talking Machine
programme.desc: A voice-recording device broadcasts Laura's love for a new boy (Eric Shea) all over town.

programme.title: The Pride of Walnut Grove
programme.desc: When Caroline is away with Mary at an arithmetic championship, Laura has a hard time filling her mother's shoes at home.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A deadly infection fells Caroline before she can join her family on a camping trip.

programme.title: The Runaway Caboose
programme.desc: Charles and Mr. Edwards end up racing against time to rescue Mary, Laura and a friend from a runaway caboose.

programme.title: Troublemaker
programme.desc: A strict teacher (Richard Basehart) develops an instant dislike for Laura.

programme.title: The Long Road Home
programme.desc: During a recession, Charles and Mr. Edwards join two others in order to transport the highly explosive liquid dynamite.

programme.title: For My Lady
programme.desc: Rumors fly when Charles performs odd jobs for a widow to get a china set for Caroline.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: A Russian emigrant (Theodore Bikel) objects to cancellation of the centennial party.

programme.title: Soldier's Return
programme.desc: A gentle and sensitive musician returns to Walnut Grove to resume his career as a teacher.

programme.title: Going Home
programme.desc: A tornado that destroys crops convinces a desolate Charles to sell the farm and go back to his old home.

programme.title: The Collection
programme.desc: A man (Johnny Cash) dressed as a cleric and his wife (June Carter Cash) claim to be on a mission of mercy.

programme.title: Bunny
programme.desc: Nellie feigns injury after an argument with Laura, then tries to manipulate others.

programme.title: The Race
programme.desc: After having her horse shod for the annual race, Laura learns that the Olesons have purchased an expensive racehorse for Nellie.

programme.title: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: Carrie falls into a deep mine while chasing a butterfly; a drunken former miner must get his act together to rescue her.

programme.title: The Monster of Walnut Grove
programme.desc: After witnessing a loud argument, Laura is under the impression that Mr. Oleson kills his wife, but no one believes her.

programme.title: Drenda
programme.desc: Drenda's deep desire is to see you experience more of what matters in your life.

programme.title: Love a Child

programme.title: Jewish Voice with Jonathan Bernis

programme.title: Ministry Now

programme.title: Healing Miracles With Pastor Addison Adamu
