programme.title: Una noche de estreno
programme.desc: Plácido acaba de recordar que es su aniversario de bodas con Renata, por lo que le organizará una cena romántica. Martina invita al cine a la familia a ver el estreno de una película.

programme.title: El yerberito llegó
programme.desc: Adolfo pierde el bono huachicolero por bañarse, y con la ayuda de Jacinta se convierte en hierbero. Carlos recibe regalos de un admirador secreto.

programme.title: Renata indiscreta
programme.desc: A Renata le encanta espiar a sus vecinos desde la ventana del dormitorio con el telescopio de Justito para confirmar o desmentir chismes. Justito le da clases de regularización a Victoria.

programme.title: La enfermera
programme.desc: Por unos estornudos de Plácido, la Nena será la enfermera encargada de cuidarlo. Mientras, Gaby se convierte en maquilladora y peinadora.

programme.title: La cereza en el pastel
programme.desc: Doña Chivis aumenta la renta del departamento, y la Nena empieza a vender tartas caseras para poder pagarla. El administrador descubre el agujero que conecta la casa de los López con la del vecino y avisa a la propietaria legítima.

programme.title: Entre el bote y el agujero
programme.desc: Plácido está en la cárcel y Pierre trata de abonar la fianza, pero queda libre Jacinta. Los López tratan de tapar el agujero porque, si no lo hacen, se irán a la calle.

programme.title: El regreso de la Licha viviente
programme.desc: La tía Licha regresa de entre los muertos, donde en realidad nunca estuvo. Plácido la corre de la casa, pero la familia se apiada de ella.

programme.title: El Departa-miento
programme.desc: Los López reordenan la casa cuando descubren que la tía Licha es su nueva vecina porque heredó el departamento contiguo. Plácido encuentra un nuevo empleo, en el que debe lidiar con una milenial déspota.

programme.title: The Spelling Bee Episode
programme.desc: Nick meets a famous actor, who shadows Nick in preparation for a role. Meanwhile, Kevin gears up for a spelling bee.

programme.title: The Wrong Way Episode
programme.desc: Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past. Meanwhile, Lindsey throws a party.

programme.title: The Gold Party Episode
programme.desc: When Marilyn throws a gold party at Nick and Suzanne's, and Nick learns Suzanne's wedding ring isn't real, he sets out to have a real ring made before Suzanne learns the truth.

programme.title: The Father's Day Episode
programme.desc: Frank is an uninvited guest on Nick's Father's Day trip, but the two bond during an elevator stoppage.

programme.title: The Suzanne Gets Arrested Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne's stubborn need to argue her point gets her arrested, she starts to change her ways, but not necessarily for the better.

programme.title: The Insignificant Anniversary Episode
programme.desc: Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his "proposa-versary" with Suzanne, who is none too pleased.

programme.title: The Open Mic Gaffe Episode
programme.desc: When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.

programme.title: The Mother's-in-Law Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne's overprotective mother arrives and causes tension between her and Nick when she questions Nick's abilities as a husband.

programme.title: The Inappropriate Website Episode
programme.desc: When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.

programme.title: The Tit for Tat Episode
programme.desc: When a new woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened; Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.

programme.title: The Identity Theft Episode
programme.desc: Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.

programme.title: The Valentine's Day Episode
programme.desc: Nick lends a hand to Kevin for his Valentine's Day at school, but things take a turn as Kevin ends up being sent home.

programme.title: The Take Your Kids to Work Day Episode
programme.desc: When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother.

programme.title: The Test Taker Episode
programme.desc: Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

programme.title: The Play Date Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, but the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

programme.title: The Nick's Kid Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.

programme.title: The Sex Symbol Episode
programme.desc: After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image; Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.

programme.title: The Bucket List Episode
programme.desc: Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.

programme.title: The Boy Has Style Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay, Nick sets out to prove that he isn't.

programme.title: The Cyrano Episode
programme.desc: Nick helps out a coworker by ghostwriting him love letters for a woman on a dating website who turns out to be Gigi.

programme.title: The Day Off Episode
programme.desc: Nick tries to help his mother forge bonds with Kevin and Lindsey. Meanwhile, Suzanne gets the day off.

programme.title: The Expensive Purse Episode
programme.desc: Against Nick's wishes, Suzanne buys an expensive purse and Nick becomes suspicious about it, so he uses her guilt to his advantage.

programme.title: The Bad Dream Episode
programme.desc: After Kevin watches the horror film "The Sixth Sense," he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

programme.title: The Mr. Himdependent Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance to get rid of Frank's financial support, while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank.

programme.title: The Master of Ceremonies Episode
programme.desc: While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

programme.title: The Hand on a House Episode
programme.desc: Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.

programme.title: The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode
programme.desc: Nick is coerced into hiring an assistant, but the newbie gets too close to Nick's family and friends.

programme.title: The Rat inThe House Episode

programme.title: The My First Job Episode

programme.title: The Pocket Dial Episode
programme.desc: After Nick gets pocket-dialed by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocketing dialling her.

programme.title: The Fight Party Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne's book group and Nick's boxing-match party collide in the family room on the same night, resulting in knock-out clashing.

programme.title: The Cooking Episode
programme.desc: Nick and Suzanne go head to head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is "easy" and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

programme.title: The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode
programme.desc: Nick secretly plans a surprise for Suzanne to help her overcome a traumatic childhood experience.

programme.title: The Career Day Episode

programme.title: The Salsa Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne enlists in a salsa-dancing class with Nick, but her controlling nature soon becomes an issue.

programme.title: The Green Episode
programme.desc: The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

programme.title: The Ghost Dog Episode
programme.desc: Nick, Suzanne, and Kevin pull pranks on each other, but their addiction leads to a near-death experience.

programme.title: Nightmare on Lunch Box Street

programme.title: Slappy Holidays

programme.title: Lanford, Toilet of Sin

programme.title: Smoking Penguins and Santa on Santa Action

programme.title: Throwing a Christian to a Bear

programme.title: Mud Turtles, a Good Steak and One Man in a Tub

programme.title: Live From Lanford
programme.desc: The Conners share their differing takes on why they all think everyone should vote; Louise gets an opportunity that might send her away from Lanford, prompting the family to interfere in Dan's complicated relationship.

programme.title: Brothers, Babies and Breakdowns

programme.title: Bad Dads and Grads
programme.desc: Dan starts to bond with his younger half brother, but he can't get over the fact that their father paid for Ed Jr.'s college education, something he refused to do for Dan; Jackie hits it off with a fun married couple.

programme.title: Beards, Thrupples and Robots
programme.desc: Darlene, desperate for money, gets a job at Price Warehouse; Jackie decides to take her throuple relationship with Ron and Janelle to the next level; Ben shaves his beard in an attempt to appear more clean-cut to potential advertisers.

programme.title: Tats and Tias

programme.title: The Icewoman Cometh
programme.desc: Bev is back from Arizona and realizes she'd like to use her finances to spread happiness; Bev decides to fund Mark's tuition to a prestigious coding camp, but Darlene tries to convince her to give the money to Harris instead.

programme.title: Pilot Lights & Sister Fights
programme.desc: Dan is finally ready to share his feelings with Louise; Darlene realizes how badly she wants a baby; Ben gets caught up playing handyman and babysitter for Becky, which causes him to miss an important meeting.

programme.title: CPAPs, Hickeys and Biscuits
programme.desc: Dan and Louise take their relationship to the next level and come to appreciate the complexities of aging; Darlene spends the night in jail and leaves parenting duties to Ben; Mark and a friend's class experiment leaves them both with hickeys.

programme.title: Bridge Over Troubled Conners
programme.desc: Darlene and Ben go apartment hunting; Jackie and Becky take Beverly Rose on a road trip to Mexico to meet her father for the first time; Dan reluctantly shares his financial troubles with Louise.

programme.title: Keep on Truckin' Six Feet Apart
programme.desc: The Conners are dealing with the pandemic and life's financial troubles; the Lunch Box is closed for everything but takeout and delivery; Becky and Darlene are both forced to search for additional income at the newly reopened Wellman Plastics plant.

programme.title: Halloween and the Election vs. The Pandemic
programme.desc: Mary is devastated that Halloween has been canceled by the city, so Darlene and Becky enlist Jackie and the rest of the family to create an unforgettable experience; Mark goes toe-to-toe with a kid at school who doesn't believe in wearing a mask.

programme.title: Plastics, Trash Talk & Darlene Antoinette
programme.desc: Darlene isolates herself from her co-workers at Wellman Plastics, leaving them with the impression she is an elitist snob; Louise decides to teach Harris an expensive life lesson; Jackie is determined to keep the restaurant running.

programme.title: Birthdays, Babies and Emotional Support Chickens

programme.title: The Lions of Causton
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter sift through old grudges, intimate affairs and artisanal chocolates to find the culprit behind a death at a rugby club.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Barnaby's reluctant presence at Sarah's friend's wedding proves fateful when a murderer targets local brides, sending the investigator on a mission to nab the killer.

programme.title: Send in the Clowns
programme.desc: Barnaby must confront his fears when clown sightings, sinister notes and death accompany Ferraees Circus into town.

programme.title: The Wolf Hunter of Little Worthy
programme.desc: After a local photographer wins an urban myth competition with his creation of The Wolf Hunter, it unexpectedly gains a cult following. However, when a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if this myth has become murderous reality.

programme.title: The Stitcher Society
programme.desc: A local outcast, who was controversially acquitted of murder years earlier, is the latest inductee into a post-operative heart rehab club. Following his arrival, members' dreams of a second chance at life begin to be cut short.

programme.title: Happy Families
programme.desc: As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

programme.title: The Scarecrow Murders
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

programme.title: Death Prepare
programme.desc: The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

programme.title: The Witches of Angel's Rise
programme.desc: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

programme.title: Super Sleuths - Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Murders team opens up about their experience of working on the popular crime drama and provides insight into the overall process of bringing it to the small screen.

programme.title: The Killings at Badger's Drift
programme.desc: The peace of idyllic Badger's Drift is shattered by an inexplicable murder. It falls to DCI Barnaby and Sergeant Troy to hunt down the killer. Their investigation uncovers a web of sinister events, some long buried in the past.

programme.title: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In the tranquil village of Midsomer Worthy, the local writers' circle is eagerly anticipating a visit from a best-selling novelist, but the aspiring authors are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.

programme.title: Death of a Hollow Man
programme.desc: In the quiet rural village of Ferne Basset, an elderly resident is found drowned after a violent attack. Meanwhile, a local amateur dramatic production of `Amadeus' reveals a hitherto unseen world of intrigue and passion.

programme.title: Faithful Unto Death
programme.desc: The village of Morton Fendle seems to be overflowing with community spirit when many of the residents invest in the local craft centre, but DCI Barnaby is called in after the wife of the centre's owner goes missing, and a neighbour is murdered.

programme.title: Death in Disguise
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Barnaby is called in following the death of a cult leader and finds clues that point to a ruthless tycoon searching for his daughter.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

programme.title: Last Man Out
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

programme.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
programme.desc: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

programme.title: The Village That Rose from the Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer in the ghost village of Little Auburn.

programme.title: Death by Persuasion
programme.desc: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: The Curse of the Ninth
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.

programme.title: A Talent for Life
programme.desc: Barnaby and Troy have to solve a double murder when a feisty former socialite and a Casanova are found bludgeoned to death. However, the motives for the murders seem disparate, and there are several people who are suspected of involvement.

programme.title: Death and Dreams
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates a death which looks like suicide. The dead man was a troubled and depressed gambler on a losing streak, but Barnaby's nose tells him to look for a murderer and then recognises someone from his past, in the shape of Dr Jane Moore.

programme.title: Painted in Blood
programme.desc: Barnaby's wife, Joyce, finds a dead body on the Midsomer Florey village green while taking part in a watercolour painting class, recognising it as the elderly Miss Fairfax. Barnaby is given the case, then finds himself taken off it and replaced by a team from the National Intelligence Squad, while he is assigned to deal with a missing handbag.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Hamlets
programme.desc: The death of a young film star at the opening of a 'satanic experience' at his family's ancestral home brings Barnaby and Troy to the feuding villages of Upper and Lower Warden. Here the Smythe-Websters are exploiting the work of celebrated 'House of Satan' author Ellis Bell - but is there more to his legacy?

programme.title: Birds of Prey
programme.desc: When Julian Shepherd is found drowned, it seems as though he committed suicide due to all his money being tied up in Charles Edmonton's latest invention. When another man dies after poaching peregrine eggs from Charles's wife, Barnaby suspects foul play.

programme.title: The Green Man
programme.desc: An accident during the restoration of a canal leads to a particularly difficult case for Barnaby and Troy, which appears to be linked to a group of rowdy teenagers.

programme.title: Bad Tidings
programme.desc: Sergeant Dan Scott arrives to work with Barnaby and is thrown straight into a murder investigation in Midsomer Mallow. A noise heard near the scene of Fiona Thompson's bloodstained body leads police to suspect an odd-job man, but when the murder toll rises, Barnaby becomes concerned for Cully, who is organising a ten-year school reunion.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Womanising landowner Gareth Heldman is killed by a violent blow from a Celtic spear, reawakening memories of a tragic archaeological dig at the ancient mound of Midsomer Barrow.

programme.title: Sins of Commission
programme.desc: When a prize-winning author is murdered on the eve of a literary festival, Barnaby and Scott discover a hotbed of corruption, scandal and financial mismanagement in the community of Midsomer St Michael. Before they can discover who is telling the truth, the death toll begins to rise.

programme.title: Degas Away With It
programme.desc: Ed uses past connections and old-school tactics to track down the thief who stole a priceless work of art from the Montecito, leading to a tense reunion with his former partner (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ed tries to get the Montecito reopened while working for a new boss and trying to lure back his former staff.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: For Sail by Owner
programme.desc: A stunning change of events thwarts a hostile takeover of the Montecito; a thug mugs Mike, who leaves Danny to seek his revenge.

programme.title: Down and Dirty
programme.desc: During a nationally televised poker tournament, Danny and Mike suspect someone is cheating and investigate security footage, despite protests from the show's producer.

programme.title: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Danny and Ed must rely on amateur sex-video footage to help them track down the person who stole diamonds from the Montecito during the taping of a music video.

programme.title: The Bitch Is Back
programme.desc: With great fanfare, the Montecito prepares for the grand opening of Wolfgang Puck's restaurant.

programme.title: And Here's Mike With the Weather
programme.desc: The auditor's report shows a $2.9 million discrepancy when the Montecito staff applies for the annual license renewal; Danny's former Marine sergeant (Dale Dye) visits the hotel, and the two wind up in a bar fight.

programme.title: Urban Legends
programme.desc: NASCAR driver Jimmie Johnson acts as a celebrity judge at the Montecito's car show; Danny and Mike find, in a bathtub full of ice, a man with a kidney missing.

programme.title: Coyote Ugly
programme.desc: When Monica's friend, Norma Pitts (Sarah Ann Morris), finds a finger in the Montecito's new buffet, she has everyone worried that she will sue.

programme.title: Lyle & Substance
programme.desc: Danny apprehends a chip thief who claims he met someone who plans to blow up the Montecito.

programme.title: Like a Virgin
programme.desc: Mary nervously plans a wedding for one of Sam's biggest whales; unusual card-counters plague the casino.

programme.title: Cash Springs Eternal
programme.desc: Danny and Mike divide their time between investigating a string of robberies in the residential suites and posing for a beefcake calendar; Jillian panics when her therapist tells her that her marriage sets a bad example for Delinda.

programme.title: All Quiet on the Montecito Front
programme.desc: Danny and Delinda decide to keep their romance a secret; the department heads go on a paintball retreat.

programme.title: Chaos Theory
programme.desc: Ed and Jillian go on a retreat that proves to be anything but peaceful; Danny and Josh deal with a suspicious character who wants to make bets of $1 million per hand.

programme.title: Fidelity, Security, Delivery
programme.desc: Athlete Sasha Cohen stops by the Montecito; Delinda answers Dr. Derek's marriage proposal; Sam and Woody share a romantic weekend together.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: One of the Montecito ladies is preparing to walk down the aisle; Ed's CIA past puts him in grave danger.

programme.title: Father of the Bride Redux
programme.desc: A gunman attacks Ed; Delinda admits her feelings for Danny; Sam goes to Hawaii to contend with a whale who will not leave the Hawaiian Villas.

programme.title: Died in Plain Sight
programme.desc: Ed returns from his Moroccan trip with shocking news about his past; Danny and Delinda's romance heats up; Mike travels to Hawaii to help Sam with her whale problem.

programme.title: The Story of Owe
programme.desc: Sam finds herself in financial trouble because three clients have stiffed the Montecito; Adam Carolla helps Mary to conquer her biggest fear.

programme.title: A History of Violins
programme.desc: Boston medical examiner Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and police officer Woody Holt (Jerry O'Connell) come to the Montecito hot on the trail of a murder and a missing rare violin.

programme.title: Delinda's Box
programme.desc: Ed and Danny have 12 hours to save Delinda from her kidnappers; Mike and Sam try to figure out whether a Buddhist monk's major winning-streak is a scam.

programme.title: Meatball Montecito
programme.desc: A blacklisted mobster (Vincent Pastore) purchases the Montecito's million-dollar wedding package, including Wayne Newton, for his daughter, but problems arise because Wayne is on bad terms with Ed.

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone reluctantly participates in Ed's Secret Santa gift exchange; Danny's car is stolen on Christmas Eve; Delinda eagerly plans her first Christmas with Danny.

programme.title: Wines and Misdemeanors
programme.desc: Minutes before a rare wine discovered in the Montecito's cellar is auctioned off for $1 million, Mike realizes it is not genuine; a group of retirees checks into the hotel for a Sudoku tournament.

programme.title: Fleeting Cheating Meeting
programme.desc: One of Ed's favorite former employees (Kate Levering) returns with her husband (Judd Nelson) to celebrate her wedding anniversary at the Montecito; Mary and Sam disagree about which guests are most important and fight for OK Go's time.

programme.title: Wagers of Sin
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Mike bet on who can find the most waste at the Montecito; Mary must sell the last residential suite and hopes to entice big money with a performance by John Legend.

programme.title: The Chicken Is Making My Back Hurt
programme.desc: Ed must seek inner peace because one blow-up could put the Montecito's gaming license at risk; Mike hopes to purchase a condo; a basketball player Sam hosts takes an interest in Mary.

programme.title: Pharoah 'Nuff
programme.desc: Ed, Danny, Mike and Delinda must take matters into their own hands when a world-famous mummy is stolen before it reaches a planned exhibit at the Montecito.

programme.title: The Burning Bedouin
programme.desc: Sam's long-lost love awakes from a 20-year coma; Ed goes on a mission to replace his housekeeper (Sandra Bernhard) when his wife is out of town.

programme.title: Bare Chested in the Park
programme.desc: An unexpected death puts a damper on the company picnic; Los Lonely Boys entertain staffers at the picnic; Mary deals with her past and testifies against her father.

programme.title: Junk in the Trunk
programme.desc: Ed discusses the possibility of retirement and buying the Montecito; Danny and Delinda's condo is broken into; Sam learns that she owes millions of dollars in unpaid taxes.

programme.title: Heroes
programme.desc: Mike discovers that Sam has been kidnapped; Danny takes drastic measures to help a friend avoid being deployed to Iraq; Delinda learns life-altering news.

programme.title: A Hero Ain't Nothin' but a Sandwich
programme.desc: A cell-phone video may be a clue to who killed Mary's father; Ed tries to find out who robbed the Montecito; Delinda gets a chance to tell Danny her secret; Sam tries to escape her captors.

programme.title: The Glass Is Always Cleaner
programme.desc: Friendships are at stake when the new casino owner tries to make changes at the Montecito; Danny loses confidence that he will be the new president; Sam continues therapy and decides to befriend the new hotel concierge.

programme.title: Head Games
programme.desc: Cooper secures a beauty pageant for the Montecito, but things go awry when someone sabotages the contestants; Sam thinks she sees a casino guest murdering a woman but has difficulty trying to convince Danny that she is not hallucinating.

programme.title: Run, Cooper, Run
programme.desc: Danny and Mike head to Cooper's suite for a meeting but find themselves in the middle of a crime scene; Piper (Camille Guaty) tries to help the son of one of the casino's big clients learn to be cool.

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemon Bars
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Piper dresses up in various costumes to scare her co-workers; Cooper insists on shadowing Sam.

programme.title: Adventures in the Skin Trade
programme.desc: Danny and Mike see a strip-club owner get physical with a stripper; Delinda advocates for better rights for exotic dancers in the city; Piper enlists Sam's help to find a racy video that she does not want people to see.

programme.title: It's Not Easy Being Green
programme.desc: The casino plays host to an environmentally friendly conference; Danny questions Delinda's plan for a new "green" lifestyle; Sam tries to capitalize on high rollers looking for love; Cooper shows a new side of himself when a mystery woman arrives.

programme.title: My Uncle's a Gas
programme.desc: Danny gets a surprise visit from the fire marshal and his alcoholic uncle; Mike keeps an eye on the casino's Hand on Hard Bodies competition; Cooper forces Sam to help a contestant; thieves break into the casino.

programme.title: The High Price of Gas
programme.desc: The effects of the Montecito robbery reverberate all over Las Vegas; Danny tries to fend off federal agencies' accusations; Delinda wants Cooper and Sam to apologize to each other; Piper and Mike help a widow carry out her husband's last wishes.

programme.title: A Cannon Carol
programme.desc: Mike begins to doubt his place in Las Vegas; Sam invites a client to visit the casino for the holidays; Delinda and Piper plan a Hot Santa contest to win the casino charity competition.

programme.title: I Could Eat a Horse
programme.desc: Danny and Mike head to Wyoming to buy a horse; Delinda looks for a new chef for the casino restaurant; Piper hides from her ex.

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: After a valuable antique is stolen; two sons (Dragon Lee and Carter Wong) swear to avenge their father's death and search of the last man to see him alive, but they are caught in a mystery of betrayal and murder. The brothers use their heads as well as their fists to find out why their father had to die.

programme.title: Blade Of Doom
programme.desc: A roving swordsman known as Snowy White has in his possession the much sort after 13 Moon Sword. Anyone who manages to defeat him in combat may own the sword and take a high position in the martial world.

programme.title: 7 Star Grand Mantis
programme.desc: A village is being oppressed by four villains led by Chow Chung. A beggar comes to town and teaches a young man and woman the 7 Star Grand Mantis style of fighting. They stomp out the gangs businesses and fight them to the finish.

programme.title: Snake Strikes Back
programme.desc: Godfrey Ho directs Elton Chong in a Jackie Chan style action comedy. Sui, plots to take over the Absolute Kung Fu Institute in order to control the secret Book of the Invincible Snake Fist. The only man who can stop him is Lam, the institutes most devoted student. He must train hard with the pot-bellied Beggar Master if he is to acheive his ambition.

programme.title: Bruce - Kung Fu Girls
programme.desc: Five pretty girls go to Hong Kong to stay with their uncle who is a police superintendent. Soon they run into a gang of thieves, which gives them a chance to put their excellent kung fu skills to good use. This Bod Squad will kick your ass!

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 6
programme.desc: How will Tako, Lord, Sengoku, and Okei chan deal with inspectors who ban extravagance and enforce a simple life on everyone?

programme.title: Enter the Invincible Hero
programme.desc: Liu Lung, a martial arts maniac and lone ranger, embarks on a quest to discover the truth behind the death of several villagers, apparently at the hands of ninjas.

programme.title: Offensive Shaolin Longfist aka Deadly Shaolin Longfist
programme.desc: Carrying a secret letter of Lord Kim, the great master Jin Sung-jin and his best disciple Kim Wun-do go to Jung-won region to get money and gold from the noble man Yeom. The evil Paeng Jang-rim gang finds this out and steals the letter. They secretly exhort the money and gold. Yeom is aware of this, so he sends Wang Tae-sa, a secret assassin, to Tae-bin where Paeng Jang-rim lives.

programme.title: 52 Masters: KARATE JUTSU with Vinicio Antony
programme.desc: Will gets back to training with karate master and renowned MMA trainer Vinicio Antony.

programme.title: Grand Passion, The
programme.desc: Two martial art expert siblings safeguard a list of rebels from the ruthless Chin soldiers of the Sung dynasty.

programme.title: Real Kung Fu of Shaolin
programme.desc: Haunted by the memories of his father's violent death, a young boy joins the shaolin temple and masters the skills of martial arts, so he can take one the killers in a bid for revenge. Brilliant Wu Shu action from start to finish. One of the first and one of the best Wu Shu films to come out of Mainland China.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 9
programme.desc: The shogunate keeps tightening its iron grip upon the Daimyos. Lord Izu plans to use a recent scandal to abolish the Kato clan, and they have to rely once more on the Ura-Yagyus to maintain peace in the country.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 6
programme.desc: The lone wolf is gravely injured during an attack by an assassin group sent by The Yagyus and got separated from Daigoro. In the meantime, Daigoro is being held captive by a corrupt official for assaulting his son.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 8
programme.desc: Itto has become the most wanted criminal in Japan. An old ally who is still in love with Itto helps them pass through the village border by disguising them as members of their own troop.

programme.title: Young Hero of Shaolin
programme.desc: Young Hero of Shaolin is about legendary martial artist, Fong Sai Yuk. From an early age, Fong is raised to study martial arts, and trained by his martial artist mother before entering Shaolin Temple. Fong becomes invulnerable.

programme.title: Ninja Hunt
programme.desc: Terrorists are willing to pay any price for the secret formula to Dark 10, which creates the desire to kill, and evil ninja gang leader Dickson is insane enough to go and steal it. The CIA send in the Ninja Hunter, who will guarantee that in this battle between good and evil justice will prevail... Ninja style!

programme.title: Death of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Grandmaster Ron Van Clef teams up with Hong Kong's best martial artists to go after Bruce Lee's killers!

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Rob Moses
programme.desc: The Museum's Biography Series takes a look at the biography of Kung Fu pioneer Rob Moses. Teacher to actor David Carradine (star of television series Kung Fu), founder of the Tai Shan Mantis style and the Golden Harmony 9 Palms system, he is also the inventor of the "PHYSIOSTIK," a unique aerobic flowing movement device.

programme.title: The Furious Avenger
programme.desc: During the war of resistance against invading foreign powers, Wu is captured and most of his family members are brutally murdered. Wu swears to seek revenge and cannot be persuaded otherwise, even by his new love, who begs him to forgive.

programme.title: Kung Fu Zombie
programme.desc: How do you kill something that's already dead? That's the question Billy Chong faces when he goes up against the "Kung Fu Zombie". Billy's father crosses the wrong exorcist, and there's hell to pay. The evil priest unleashes an army of the undead against Chong's family, led by the Mad Korean, Kwan Young Moon.

programme.title: Daggers 8
programme.desc: Chu Chi Chong (Man Yuen Men) is determined to become a kung fu Expert, yet each time he begins to train, his master is mysteriously killed. Killer bah (WIlson Tong) is a professional assassin whose use of the secret daggers makes him an unbeatable killing machine.

programme.title: Return of the Deadly Blade
programme.desc: A famous martial arts master re-emerges on the scene. His presence causes many fighters to become worried. Secrets long buried begin to surface, and this master must be stopped at all costs. But is he really, who he says he is? David Chiang (5 Masters of Death, 7 Blows of the Dragon) heads an all-star Shaw Brothers stable cast in this action-drenched thriller. Return of the Deadly Blade is action in the Shaw tradition.

programme.title: Chinese Boxing
programme.desc: In early Republic of China when Taiwan was still under Japanese occupation, people were oppressed, and their condition was miserable. A Kung Fu coach from China was invited to Taiwan. His name was Wan Chin-san. Mr. Wan established a Kung Fu School in a small village and refused any Japanese to be his student. For this reason, he was assassinated. When his son, Wan Ming-Chieh, heard the terrible news, he came to Taiwan in search of his father.

programme.title: Bruce Lee's Ways of Kung Fu

programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: The Road Home
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: An Affair to Forget
programme.desc: Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man. Jodi's wedding plans go down the drain when Alberto learns about the affair she had while overseas, and Jake tries to help Becky cope with her feelings following Brett's death.

programme.title: Put to the Test
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: The Wedding
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: Gone to the Dogs
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: The Ghost of Things to Come
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.

programme.title: A House of Cards
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: Three Little Words
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: Repeat Offenders
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: Jokers to the Right
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: A Slight Interruption
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: Old Beginnings
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: Perfect Match
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: Let the Best Man Win
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: Majority Rules
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: The Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: One Step at a Time
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: Time Frames
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: Body Language (aka The Bottom Line)
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: My Noon, My Midnight
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: Double Dealing
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: Jack of All Shades
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Game of Chance
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Things We Do For Love
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Iceman: Book One
programme.desc: Known as Iceman, a newly retired organized crime fixer is pulled back deeper than ever.

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: Seed: The Untold Story
programme.desc: In the last century, 94% of our seed varieties have disappeared. As biotech chemical companies control the majority of our seed, farmers and indigenous keepers fight a David and Goliath battle to defend the future of our food.

programme.title: The Earthing Movie
programme.desc: The Earthing Movie is a documentary that reveals the scientific phenomenon of how we can heal our bodies by doing the simplest thing that a person can do- standing barefoot on the earth.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: All Superheroes Must Die
programme.desc: Four Super Heroes find themselves abducted by their Arch Nemesis and are forced to compete in a series of challenges in order to save an abandoned town full of kidnapped innocent civilians.

programme.title: The Box in the Attic
programme.desc: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a sealed box. When she breaks its ancient seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy... and a deadly secret of her own.

programme.title: The Terror of Hallow's Eve
programme.desc: When a fifteen-year-old is beaten up by high school bullies, his intense yearning for revenge unintentionally summons up evil supernatural forces offering to scare his enemies to actual death.

programme.title: A Christmas Love
programme.desc: Struck by bad luck during the holidays, a struggling couple receives the joyful gift of Christmas love when they discover an old letter that sparks the magic of the season.

programme.title: Liyana
programme.desc: Five orphaned children in Eswatini turn past trauma into creative fuel for an original collective fairytale in which they send a young girl on a dangerous quest.

programme.title: The Whole Gritty City
programme.desc: Directors of three New Orleans marching bands prepare students to perform in the Mardi Gras parades. What emerges is a dramatic, music-filled story of children struggling to reach adulthood in one of America's most impoverished and violent cities.

programme.title: The Godfathers of Hardcore
programme.desc: An intimate look at the lives and careers of two of the most respected individuals in the history of hardcore punk music: Roger Miret and Vinnie Stigma of the iconic punk hardcore band Agnostic Front.

programme.title: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Peter Short, the charismatic CEO of a major Australian company, learns that he has only months to live after he is diagnosed with terminal oesophageal cancer. Not wanting to face a painful death, Peter sets out to have voluntary euthanasia legalised.

programme.title: Qwerty
programme.desc: In this heartwarming romantic comedy, Zoe's life is turned upside down when she falls for outcast Marty. Together, they battle a dysfunctional family and self-doubt as Zoe trains for the National Scrabble Championship.

programme.title: Riverfront Romance
programme.desc: After saving up for years, writer Cara Durant finally buys her dream house on the riverbank of her hometown, only to discover a hydro dam being built right in front of it, spearheaded by the handsome and nomadic Riley Evans.

programme.title: Missing Pieces
programme.desc: A heartbroken man kidnaps two strangers in hopes they will fall in love.

programme.title: The Prayer
programme.desc: It is a drama and faith-based film about two ambitious college students. Mark and Tom became good friends despite a rocky beginning at gunpoint that almost cost Mark his life.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Dog Patrol: Operation Santa Paws
programme.desc: When little Samuel's loyal dog, Athena, uncovers clues tied to a mob boss's sinister plot, the duo must band together with friends and Sheriff Jacobs to solve riddles, outsmart the bad guys, and save Christmas.

programme.title: Insectula!
programme.desc: A giant mosquito monster wreaks havoc on the world. After it kills a loved one, government agent Del pursues his own personal vendetta against the creature, while mad scientist Dr. Kempler decides to help it cleanse the world of its human inhabitants.

programme.title: The Penitent Man
programme.desc: When a mysterious client reveals he is from the future, a psychologist heeds the man's warning and sets out to change the course of his life.

programme.title: Favorite Son
programme.desc: When David returns to his childhood hometown, he is still haunted by old secrets. David is the last one the town elders want near the young, troubled Ross, but David might be the only one who can save Ross from an evil haunting the town.

programme.title: Is It Just Me?
programme.desc: A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: The Suppressor
programme.desc: A man seeks brutal revenge against the dangerous criminals who killed his wife.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The President's Staff
programme.desc: The President, his intern, and two technicians discover that the Oval Office has been wired with bombs that prevent them from leaving. With 24 hours until detonation, they must decipher the secret of the devices before the White House is blown sky-high.

programme.title: Obscura
programme.desc: A reclusive young photographer, Andrew Kaleen (Andrew John), incidentally becomes wrapped up in a string of murders delivered through clues in the form of a 35mm film.

programme.title: Patient Seven
programme.desc: Dr. Marcus, a renowned psychiatrist, has selected six severely mentally ill and dangerous patients from the Spring Valley Mental Hospital to interview as part of his research for his new book.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game.

programme.title: True Crime
programme.desc: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager (Israel Broussard) and his gang of fame-obsessed youths (Katie Chang, Taissa Farmiga) use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: The Rage: Carrie 2
programme.desc: When her closest friend commits suicide after being manipulated by the popular crowd, quiet and bookish Rachel Lang (Emily Bergl) decides to get back at the guilty parties. Although Rachel falls for sensitive football player Jesse Ryan (Jason London), she remains determined to punish his callous friends. When Rachel discovers that she has superhuman abilities, it ups the stakes for her revenge, echoing a supernatural incident that occurred decades before.

Leaving family and boyfriend behind to pursue her dreams, fish-out-of-water Holly comes up against fierce competition and elitist attitudes from her classmates. But with the support of her mother, Wanda (Virginia Madsen), and roommate Ditz (Jackie Rosenbaum), Holly overcomes all obstacles in her path to become the next big pop star.

While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.desc: Andy contemplates her future with Sam after learning of heartbreaking news; she meets a teenager in need of protection.

Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg), FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers (Kevin Bacon) and Commissioner Ed Davis (John Goodman) join courageous survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the suspects and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: The Last Stand
programme.desc: Once a narcotics officer in the LAPD, Ray Owens settles into a peaceful life as sheriff of Sommerton Junction, a quiet border town. That peace is shattered when Gabriel Cortez, a vicious crime lord, escapes from FBI custody and speeds toward Ray's town with a band of mercenaries. Federal agents prepare to capture Cortez. Ray is at first reluctant to get involved, but he soon finds he must rally his team and take matters into his own hands.

programme.desc: A cop's (Stephen Dorff) shady past comes back to haunt him as he investigates a series of assaults against women at a strip club.
