In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Fermentation, Preservation and Exploration
programme.desc: The human quest to plan for times of scarcity during times of plenty by preserving food.

programme.title: Pilar Cuban Eatery
programme.desc: Find out how to make the perfect Cuban sandwich at Pilar Cuban Eatery in Brooklyn, meet the fabulous people behind the film Chapter & Verse at the Cove Lounge in Harlem, and celebrate Charles Rangel, a man with deep roots in Harlem.

programme.title: Saddle of Veal
programme.desc: Chocolate truffles inspire Julia to visit a chocolate factory. Today's menu also includes Curried Oysters and Roast Saddle of Veal. With Leslee Reis and Louis Martini.

programme.title: episode 3
programme.desc: Green vegetable soup. Roast leg of lamb and mint relish. Chickpea and coriander puree. Carrots with lemon. A 'plain cake' served with strawberries, crème anglaise and cream.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: Moroccan harrira soup. Roast haddock with roast pepper, olive and basil salsa. Mashed potatoes with courgette, olive oil and marjoram. Romanesco. Chocolate, prune and armagnac puddings with chocolate sauce.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: The Selfish Spread
programme.desc: There may not be any 'I' in 'Team', but there is an 'M' & 'E'... Expert egoist Nadia G praises spoiling ourselves and cooks up: Panko shrimp with strawberry aioli; Thai-Italian spring rolls served with peanut dipping sauce; and Camembert feuilletee with apricot syrup and spiced pistachio.

programme.title: Ginger Jamboree
programme.desc: Chef Dev is joined by his mom, who helps prepare some of their favorite dishes from their travels together around Asia, including Yakisoba Noodles from Japan, Hainanese Chicken Rice from Singapore, and massive Mandu Dumplings from South Korea.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lazy Salmon and Sides
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Lazy Salmon and Sides! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lusk / Sydney, NSW, Australia
programme.desc: Our contributors are Mother and Daughter, Kate and Sarah Swetman. Sarah has been living in Sydney for 2 years now with her partner Aaron. We meet parents Noel and Kate in Lusk at the round tower, Dad Noel was born and raised in Lusk and he shows Catherine the old family home and farm and describes his early life in Lusk.

programme.title: Johnny Gill and Lori Greiner
programme.desc: It's always great to have a little fun in the kitchen and Patti LaBelle gets that and more when singer Johnny Gill stops by to sing for his supper. A voice like that makes Patti whip up her "Oh So Delicious" sauteed jumbo garlic shrimp served with okra, corn and tomato stew over basmati rice. Then Patti has her own lobster fest in the kitchen with the lady known as Little Shark -- Lori Greiner from the million-dollar deal-making show Shark Tank.

programme.title: Ta'Rhonda Jones and Lance Gross
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle has star power in her kitchen today. First, Ta'Rhonda Jones drops by to learn Patti's delicious Pork Chops with Sauteed Cabbage. Then, Patti refreshes her palate with actress Kaitlin Doubleday over a vegan lunch of Sauteed Portobello Mushrooms with Garlic and Butter. Finally, Patti is joined by actor Lance Gross, to help her prepare Pan-Seared Salmon served with Sauteed Green Beans "A La Bella."

programme.title: Brian Austin Green and Sharna Burgess
programme.desc: Curtis Stone and his guests cook up flavorful conversations and foods as they dig into everything from current events to personal stories, to meals that left their mark.

programme.title: Vietnam
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay continues his gastronomic adventure to some of Southeast Asia's most jaw-dropping locations, arriving in Vietnam.

programme.title: Forest
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik put their heads together to design a three-course menu, highlighting the gifts of the forest! Mushrooms, venison, cranberries, and - of course - black forest cake!

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melvyn finds himself in seafood galore as he heads to Xiamen, China this week. He meets two different families- one living in a rustic fishing village and the other, the owner of a famous restaurant chain in Xiamen.

programme.title: French Fries
programme.desc: There is nothing quite as addictive as French fries. While French fries generally refer to batonnet or allumette-cut fried potatoes. They come in all shapes and sizes. But what is it about French fries that makes them so popular? Is it their crispy...crunchy...texture? Their salty taste? Or is it the seemingly endless amounts of dipping sauces a French fry can be dunked in? Whatever the reason-French fries have solidified themselves as a go-to side dish...Or the perfect snack.

programme.title: Burkina Faso
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Tonight Gordon shows London Underground emergency workers how to cook a delicious, low fat breakfast. In the restaurant the diners enjoy a meal of pea soup, chicken stroganoff, and vanilla cheesecake.

programme.title: The Supply Chain
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: Summer Salads
programme.desc: A handsomely decorated chicken salad that can be the center of attraction on a buffet table or the main course for an important luncheon or supper. Julia Child shows you a recipe that can also serve for fish and shellfish and demonstrates the foolproof way to make your own mayonnaise.

programme.title: Skarhult Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale gives a glimpse behind the scenes of the grand parties and dinners of the noble families of today.

programme.title: Scipione Castle
programme.desc: Over the Po Plain, near Parma, lies the "Castello di Scipione". It is home to Count René, Countess Stefania von Holstein and their daughter Elisabeth.

programme.title: Spanish Mackerel
programme.desc: The challenger is a master chef hailing from Kyoto. He has the support of the former Iron Chef Michiba and Dr. Yatori. Can the Iron Chef win this battle?

programme.title: Pen Shell
programme.desc: The challenger is a seafood expert who chooses and masterfully cooks gifts from the sea. He has apprenticed in the top kitchens of Japan. Which competitor will find the soul of the sea?

programme.title: Edinburgh
programme.desc: Michelin starred Chef, Tom Kerridge takes Fred to Edinburgh for a fine dining experience at Kitchin, the Michelin starred restaurant of Chef Tom Kitchin. Kitchin specialises in showcasing Scottish ingredients, sourced from a network of suppliers to ensure that the menu really captures a taste of Scotland.

programme.title: Journey of A Female Comic
programme.desc: The film chronicles the ups and downs of a Hollywood actress/comedian as she struggles to make it in Tinsel Town. It's a comical portrayal of what it takes to achieve success in a town where people confuse Fame with Greatness, with an all-star cast of some of greatest Latino Actors in Hollywood.

programme.title: He'll Never Let Go
programme.desc: Candace's life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with the charismatic Karlton Moore. At first glance, Karlton seems like the epitome of perfection-his looks, charm, and achievements paint an irresistible picture. However, as their relationship deepens, Candace begins to unearth a chilling truth. Karlton harbors a sinister darkness and an overwhelming fear of commitment. What initially appeared as a dreamy romance soon transforms into a harrowing nightmare.

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone's future.

programme.title: Guilty Victim

programme.title: Zoos: The Wild and the Wonderful

When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.title: Betting on the Bride
programme.desc: A womanizer bets that he can get someone to accept his marriage proposal after dating him for just 30 days. What he doesn't know is that the woman he has targeted has some serious commitment issues.

programme.title: Love on the Rock
programme.desc: Retirement gets put on hold when a tough, burned-out former cop finds himself catapulted into a web of high-stakes international espionage.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Bill Williamson is a young man living in small town USA. Bill has become frustrated with the world around him. Global warming, world hunger, over population and senseless consumption fuel his anger. Bill is no activist. He lives with his parents and has a dead-end job, but Bill has a way out. He unleashes his violent plan upon his town, while laying the foundations for a better life for himself.

programme.title: Inalienable
programme.desc: Still guilt-ridden over the accident that took his family's lives, Eric Norris discovers that his body is host to a parasite from another world. Except, it is more than a parasite: it carries his DNA.

programme.title: The Field
programme.desc: To save their marriage, Ben and Lydia risk it all and buy a farmstead in Manitowoc, WI. Lydia is determined to transform the rotting house into a dream home and finally start a family, but Ben's photographs reveal they're not alone... Mysterious figures begin appearing in Ben's photos and Lydia unearths grotesque artifacts in their house. An odd woman called Edith (Veronica Cartwright) is found to be living in a chicken coop on their property.

programme.title: Uncle Peckerhead
programme.desc: When a punk band scores their first tour, life on the road proves tough when they hire a man-eating demon as a roadie.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: Sylvia, a lonely 20-something, goes searching for answers after her friend mysteriously vanishes in Whitehall, NY, an Adirondack town known for its Bigfoot sightings. She sets off with a mysterious, charming young woman, Alex, hellbent on getting to Whitehall for different reasons. Sylvia soon learns that hiding in the woods is an evil more sinister than she could ever imagine.

programme.title: Jo: The Opera
programme.desc: "Jo' takes the audience behind the scenes of Paris' most iconic locations, as we follow St-Clair in his relentless pursuit of justice.

programme.title: Romeo Section 1: A String of Pearls
programme.desc: "The Romeo Section' is a taut thriller about espionage in the Pacific Rim. Set in Vancouver, the show follows seasoned spymaster Professor Wolfgang McGee, an academic who secretly manages a roster of espionage assets and informants. These assets, referred to as Romeo or Juliet spies, use their powers of seduction to extract secrets from state intelligence targets.

programme.title: AWOL-72
programme.desc: An AWOL marine in possession of secret government information, is a wanted man, pursued by Russian special ops, the LAPD, and a dangerous assassin.

programme.title: Murderous Trance
programme.desc: Murderous Trance is a psychological thriller about the astonishing hypnosis murders that took place in Denmark in the 1950s. Inspector Anders Olsen (Pilou Asbæk) begins to solve a case where a bank robber shot two men and ran into the streets of Copenhagen. After his arrest, the robber claims to have committed the crime alone. Some eyewitnesses say he seemed to be in a trance, a fact that makes the case even more complicated and peculiar.

programme.title: Where's Rose
programme.desc: When a little girl is found after going missing, only her older brother recognizes the evil force that has returned in her place.

programme.title: Hidden Killers of the Post-War Home
programme.desc: An examination of the common household hazards of the typical modern residences of 1950s Britain.

programme.title: Ancient Alien Origins
programme.desc: Researchers discover that aliens from another world assisted in the evolution of man and were the genesis of a very real bloodline that remains intact today.

programme.title: Legend Of The Demon Cat
programme.desc: A poet and monk join forces to investigate a demonic cat who has possessed a general's wife and is wreaking havoc on the imperial court. The investigation takes an unexpected twist, leading the pair to unravel a mystery behind a decades old death of a legendary and beautiful courtesan.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Having rescued Nick from near death, Bert Myers nurses him back to health. After hearing that Nick was injured while looking for Korda, Amanda goes to settle the score.

programme.title: Like a Bat Outta Hell
programme.desc: When four young filmmakers are sent into the outback for a new project, they get stranded in the desert while a mysterious flying entity disables their vehicle.

programme.title: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
programme.desc: An internet broadcaster recruits a handful of people to appear on their 'experience the horror' show that will take place at the Gonjiam Mental Hospital, known as one of the world's 7 Horrorific Sites.

programme.title: The Demonologist
programme.desc: A detective investigating a string of murders goes down a dark path of the Occult and discovers beings that are trying to bring forth Hell on Earth.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: Sylvia, a lonely 20-something, goes searching for answers after her friend mysteriously vanishes in Whitehall, NY, an Adirondack town known for its Bigfoot sightings. She sets off with a mysterious, charming young woman, Alex, hellbent on getting to Whitehall for different reasons. Sylvia soon learns that hiding in the woods is an evil more sinister than she could ever imagine.

programme.title: 2010: Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: Alien Arrival
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.title: Cape Wrath S1 EP 2
programme.desc: Danny goes to ask Samantha about Cape Wrath, but she is away visiting her dying father, Professor Campbell. He explains to her the Meadowlands experiment and Samantha learns who she really is.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: Germ Z
programme.desc: When a meteor, host to an alien germ, falls to Earth, a small town is infected. The local deputy and his girlfriend must battle their way through an army of infected townsfolk as they struggle to save themselves and their loved ones.

programme.title: Part 1: The Man in The Blue Car
programme.desc: Criminologist Prof David Wilson conducts a series of interviews with convicted murderer Bert Spencer, the man suspected of - yet never charged with - killing paperboy Carl Bridgewater in 1978.

programme.title: Born In Light: Tesla
programme.desc: Claiming to be in contact with aliens, Nikola Tesla was prevented from pursuing his greatest inventions by a ruling elite concerned he would derail their systems of mass control.

programme.title: Wolf Blood S1 Ep4-Cry Wolf
programme.desc: It's the stress of exam season and Maddy, close to her first transformation, can't control her inner wolf.

programme.title: Dragon Crusaders
programme.desc: A group of fugitive Knights Templar attacks a pirate ship and they are cursed to turn into hideous monsters. To fight the curse and ultimately save the world, they must defeat the wizard-dragon who is determined to destroy it.

programme.title: Kung Fu Traveler
programme.desc: Aliens have overtaken the Earth! Trying to escape defeat, a Chinese General is accidentally sent back in time while trying to devise a way to defeat the alien invaders...

programme.title: Bermuda Tentacles
programme.desc: When Air Force One goes down over the Bermuda Triangle, the Navy sends its best rescue team. But in saving the president, the team awakens a creature that threatens the entire eastern seaboard.

programme.title: Amelia 2.0
programme.desc: When the husband of a dying woman is approached by a corporation pioneering a new program to extend life through robotics, they get caught in a public debate over human's relationship with technology.

programme.title: Beast Mode
programme.desc: A has-been Hollywood producer turns to an ancient elixir, hoping it will save his career; only to unleash bloodthirsty, shape-shifting beasts on LA.

programme.title: Old Strangers
programme.desc: Three friends reconnect in a secluded mountain town after a long quarantine. While out for a hike, the trio stumble upon something dark and terrible in the deep woods.

programme.title: King Cohen
programme.desc: This is the true story of film maverick and exploitation auteur, Larry Cohen. Told through interviews, film clips, the people who helped fulfill his vision, and industry icons such as Martin Scorsese, J.J. Abrams, John Landis and many more.

programme.title: Officer Of The Year

programme.title: Whit's End
programme.desc: The trip puts a strain on group dynamics; Craig attempts to salvage his friendships with Cameran and Whitney; Kathryn breaks the news that the baby is coming ahead of schedule, thwarting Thomas' plans to go away to Los Angeles with the guys.

programme.title: Saint and Sinners
programme.desc: As Thomas and Kathryn prepare to welcome their son into the world, JD questions whether Thomas is actually the father; Craig heads to Los Angeles for a guys' weekend; Landon reveals to Cameran the feelings she harbors for her best friend.

programme.title: From Here to Paternity
programme.desc: After the birth of their son, Thomas and Kathryn take baby steps towards a reconciliation; Landon makes a surprising declaration; Thomas has few reasons to rejoice after shocking revelations and fiery accusations are made during a celebratory dinner.

programme.title: Words of Wisdom
programme.desc: Thomas wants to prove that Kathryn and the children should not be overlooked; Patricia takes Landon under her wing and shows her how to make Shep swoon; Thomas hosts a dinner party during which a toast drives the gang apart.

programme.title: Founder's Brawl
programme.desc: Kathryn appreciates that Thomas finally had her back; JD and Whitney stage an intervention to air their concerns over Thomas' erratic behavior; the gang gets together at the second annual Founder's Ball, where simmering tensions come to a boil.

programme.title: While the Kat's Away...
programme.desc: Thomas rises to the challenge of being a single father; Shep continues to be Charleston's perennial bachelor and has a new wingman, Austen; Cameran is convinced she knows the woman who can reel Shep in; Landon is back with a new boyfriend.

programme.title: Roamin' Holiday
programme.desc: Cameran gets a sneak peek at motherhood; Kathryn's trip to Malibu, Calif., proves to be more than just sunbathing and surfing; Shep confronts Craig about the nature of his legal career; Thomas realizes he needs a stepmother for his children.

programme.title: Step and Release
programme.desc: Craig helps Naomie throw a fundraiser, but the differences in their planning styles threaten to expose the cracks in their relationship; Thomas decides to rekindle his friendship with Landon; Shep and Chelsea share a romantic evening.

programme.title: Shepwrecked
programme.desc: Kathryn struggles to cope with supervised visitation; Craig's life with Naomie starts to fall apart; Whitney confronts Landon about her true feelings for Thomas; Cameran tries to convince Shep it's not too late to win Chelsea back.

programme.title: Craig of All Trades, Master of None
programme.desc: Cameran turns to the supernatural in hopes of finding her life's purpose; Thomas asks Landon out on a date; Shep confronts Austen about his "bro-code" violation; Naomie reaches her boiling point when she learns of Craig's latest endeavor.

programme.title: To Liver and Die in Charleston
programme.desc: Shep receives shocking news about his health; Austen and Chelsea deepen their romantic bond; Thomas and Landon's connection is tested; Jennifer hosts a Sip and See to celebrate her new baby; Craig finally seals the deal on an investment property.

programme.title: Fowl Play
programme.desc: As Kathryn contemplates a reunion with the father of her children, Patricia pushes Landon and Thomas closer together; Craig and Naomie attempt to reconcile; Shep plans a hunting getaway for the group; Chelsea falls for Austen's hunting prowess.

programme.title: Sari, Not Sari...
programme.desc: Craig and Naomie visit a therapist; Austen and Chelsea continue to grow closer; Shep runs into Austen and Landon at a bar; Kathryn writes Thomas a letter; Patricia hosts an Indian-themed dinner and invites an Indian healer who reveals the future.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Lunch
programme.desc: After the chaos of Patricia's dinner, some fortunes begin to come true; Cameran agrees to see if Kathryn has really changed; Austen and Craig discuss whether Shep still has his heart set on Chelsea; Landon prepares to quash a potential relationship.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Thomas and Kathryn end their standoff to celebrate their son's birthday; Cameran begins to rethink motherhood; Craig proves he's finally all grown up when he gets the keys to his new house; Shep decides he needs to move out of downtown.

programme.title: Boys Gone Wild
programme.desc: Thomas agrees to let Kathryn do a photo shoot with Kensie; Craig and Naomie question whether they should continue to be a couple; when Chelsea tells Austen about a late-night encounter with Shep, friendships are pushed to the brink.

programme.title: A Tribe Called Key West
programme.desc: The gang heads to Key West for Cam's birthday trip; Austen questions Chelsea's commitment to their relationship; Craig finds himself on thin ice with Naomie; Kathryn reveals shocking new information about Thomas and Landon's relationship.

programme.title: Ain't No Thang Like a Chicken Wing
programme.desc: Landon and Kathryn's Key West apology sends shock waves through the South; Chelsea and Austen strive to define their relationship; Craig and Naomie decide the fate of their relationship; old tensions reemerge at JD's party.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 1
programme.desc: Cameran prepares for the birth of her baby; Shep confesses to the downfall of his relationship following his quest to find love; Kathryn celebrates her second year of sobriety; Thomas has a new love interest.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 2
programme.desc: Shep hosts his first adult dinner party, where Craig's anxieties over seeing Naomie mount and Austen remains hopeful that he can win Chelsea back; Kathryn finally meets Ashley, the woman determined to be the next Mrs. Ravenel.

programme.title: Groovy Baby
programme.desc: Patricia surprises Cameran by planning a glamorous retro baby shower, where Craig and Naomie fall back into old habits and an unexpected guest turns the event on its head; Thomas considers his future with Ashley.

programme.title: All Talk No Action
programme.desc: Kathryn takes the high road by inviting Thomas' new girlfriend, Ashley, to lunch; as Cameran's due date approaches, her anxieties over becoming a mom subside; Chelsea begins to fear motherhood may never be in her future.

programme.title: Pulp Friction
programme.desc: Patricia encourages Thomas to propose; Austen's parents push him to make some strides professionally; Craig hires a coach to help him get his life on track; Naomie comes face to face with Craig's new crush.

programme.title: Exes on the Half Shell
programme.desc: Naomie prepares to open her family's new restaurant, and finally comes to terms with the fact that she isn't over Craig; Patricia and Craig have a heart-to-heart; Cameran tries an old-fashioned trick to get baby Palmer to make an appearance.

programme.title: Kat's Got Your Tongue
programme.desc: Cameran suspects that she may be experiencing labor pains; Kathryn prepares for her first day of work; Craig helps Austen realize things are over with Chelsea; Patricia tries to make Ashley into the perfect Southern Belle and hosts a dinner party.

programme.title: What da Fuskie
programme.desc: Cameran plays the pregnancy waiting game; the gang prepares for a trip to Shep and Chelsea's hometown; feuding exes, Craig and Naomie, attempt to act civil; Austen decides to rekindle his romance with Victoria, but fears Chelsea's reaction.

programme.title: Hilton Head-ache
programme.desc: Emotions run high during the gang's first night in Hilton Head, S.C., when Ashley confronts Kathryn; after the group is forced to pick sides, everyone walks on eggshells for the rest of the weekend.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: As the Hilton Head trip comes to an end, Shep visits his mom and finally admits some truths about himself; Chelsea takes a trip down memory lane and opens up about her past.

programme.title: Beer and Trembling
programme.desc: Austen prepares to debut his beer to his family and friends; Craig makes progress on his pillows for Patricia; Cameran tries to adjust to her new life with baby Palmer.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: After basking in the glory of his successful beer event, Austen is hit with romantic reality; Craig faces some harsh truths; Thomas and Ashley struggle to resolve their issues.

programme.title: Game Changer
programme.desc: Thomas continues to pressure Ashley to get a job in Charleston, S.C.; Chelsea and Austen come to terms with the state of their friendship; Thomas invites the gang to watch him play in his last polo match at Brookland Plantation.

programme.title: Ho, Ho, Ho
programme.desc: After five years of constant tension, Patricia finally extends an olive branch and invites Kathryn to her Winter Ball; the truce between Craig and Naomie blows up when he brings a date to the ball.

programme.title: RSVPeeved
programme.desc: As Charleston reels over Thomas' arrest, Kathryn deals with conflicting emotions; Cameran struggles to balance motherhood and her career; the friends gather at Patricia's dinner party, during which they are shocked by the revelation of a secret romp.

programme.title: Kat's Out of the Bag
programme.desc: Cameran gives Eliza an earful about her behavior at Patricia's party; Whitney is in the hot seat over rumors about his relationship status; Chelsea hosts a housewarming party; Cameran spills the beans about Whitney and Kathryn's secret liaison.

programme.title: Slide Into Your DMs Like...
programme.desc: Naomie juggles her clothing company and her family's restaurant empire; as Kathryn opens up about her new boyfriend, Craig becomes the town gossip, spreading rumors about Kat's new man and Austen's girlfriend.

programme.title: Barking Up the Wrong Tree House
programme.desc: Austen has second thoughts about breaking up with Madison; Chelsea learns Austen has been badmouthing her around town; a shocking experience gives Eliza a new lease on life; Kathryn pulls another one of her stunts before the girls' trip.

programme.title: In Sew Deep
programme.desc: Kathryn and Danni leave the girls' trip on frosty terms; Cameran realizes she needs to get back to work; Craig decides to host a party to trick his friends into helping him sew pillows; Chelsea lays into Austen for talking behind her back.

programme.title: A Salt and Battery
programme.desc: To get Austen's mind off his ex, the guys rent an RV and head into the great outdoors; Chelsea steps up her hair game; Eliza tries to mend fences; Cam finally asks for help with Palmer; Kathryn and Danni's friendship is at an icy standstill.

programme.title: Dick Moves and Dick Pics
programme.desc: The guys hit the town in Nashville, Tenn., in their attempt to get Austen over Madison; Patricia hosts a female-only dinner party that is even raunchier than the boys' night out, as the women share some secrets of their own.

programme.title: New Craig, Who Dis?
programme.desc: Shep adjusts to life with his new puppy, Little Craig; Chelsea holds Austen's feet to the fire; Kathryn and Naomie get enlightened; when Cameran hosts an oyster roast for her 35th birthday party, she gets "turnt," and Craig the human gets livid.

programme.title: Sorry Not Sorry
programme.desc: The group decides to take a trip to Colorado to help Cameran rediscover her mojo; Naomie refuses to go; Eliza hosts the gang for a day of skeet shooting at her family's plantation and invites a blast from the past, which backfires big time.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain High Part One
programme.desc: Kathryn confronts Whitney about a rumor; Cameran reveals to Shep that she's invited Madison to her birthday ski trip in Colorado; the trip gets off to a rocky start as a frustrated Craig unleashes his pent-up fury.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain High Part Two
programme.desc: Chelsea, Cameran, Eliza, Danni, and Kathryn hit the slopes for their first-ever ski lesson, while Craig, Austen and Madison go snowboarding; Austen and Madison's relationship heats up; tensions arise during a cannabis-infused dinner.

programme.title: Who Put the Mad in Madison?
programme.desc: After a raucous night in Colorado, Cameran and Whitney hightail it back to Charleston, while the others hit the hot springs; Austen and Madison's road to reconciliation is a rocky one; Madison repeats a rumor that throws Shep and Danni under the bus.

programme.title: Outfoxed
programme.desc: Shep's ultimatum to Austen is tested after he and Madison reconcile; Ashley asks for another chance, and Eliza invites her to the fox hunt; Ashley and Kathryn come face to face for the first time in a year, and the gang prepares for a brawl.

programme.title: White Gloves Off
programme.desc: The socialites get ready for another grand event hosted by Miss Patricia; battle lines are drawn when Austen learns that Shep and Craig's dates are the women from his infamous threesome video; Ashley considers crashing the event.

programme.title: The Good Shephard
programme.desc: Austen and Madison's bond is stronger than ever; Kathryn reveals a bit of gossip to Craig; with a new girlfriend and a therapist in tow, Shep's new and improved attitude leaves him determined to keep his nose out of everyone's business.

programme.title: Charleston Whine and Food Festival
programme.desc: Shep continues to spread gossip at his party, upsetting Madison and ultimately affecting his friendship with Austen; Leva comes to Cameran's defense and confronts Kathryn for igniting the rumor mill; Patricia suggests John pursue Madison.

programme.title: A Pair and a Spare
programme.desc: Leva hosts a Persian dinner for the girls; the boys discover John doesn't honor bro-code; Shep and Taylor double-date with Austen and Madison; Kathryn finds out a secret about Thomas.

programme.title: Single and Ready to Pringle
programme.desc: Despite tensions among the guys, they prepare for Patricia's annual dinner party; John follows Patricia's advice and decides to pursue Madison, even though he would be breaking bro-code with Austen; Charleston deals with the onset of coronavirus.

programme.title: Monumental Challenge
programme.desc: Charleston reopens with big changes due to the pandemic and social unrest; everyone comes to grips with the new normal.

programme.title: Love Sick
programme.desc: John cozies up to Madison as she reaches a decision about Austen; after Craig debuts his HSN line, Patricia has an announcement of her own; Shep and his girlfriend struggle with the pressures of quarantine; Leva confronts Kathryn.

programme.title: Low Country Broil
programme.desc: Shep tries to charm his way out of the doghouse with Taylor; after an apology tour, Kathryn continues to face backlash for her exchange on social media; Austen refuses to accept that his relationship with Madison is over.

programme.title: It's My Party and I'll Go If I Want To...
programme.desc: On the heels of their breakup, Madison invites everyone to what was supposed to be Austen's birthday party; Kathryn struggles in her friendships with Danni and Madison Simon.

programme.title: Treehouse of Cards Pt. 1
programme.desc: Pringle and Shep co-host a pool party; Leva finally calls out the boys on their unyielding defense of Kathryn; Austen looks to close the chapter on Madison for good.

programme.title: Treehouse of Cards Pt. 2
programme.desc: Madison learns Austen has been hooking up with another woman; Kathryn finally confronts her DM scandal; fractures in the group threaten friendships.

programme.desc: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

programme.title: Lavell Crawford: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: The comic performs in St. Louis, discussing Christmas as a child, feeling guilty on Mother's Day, Thanksgiving and Disneyland.

programme.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
programme.desc: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

programme.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
programme.desc: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

programme.title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
programme.desc: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

programme.title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
programme.desc: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

programme.title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
programme.desc: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

programme.title: Brendan Fitzgibbons: I Am the Resistance
programme.desc: Comedian Brendan Fitzgibbons makes his stand-up album debut; he digs into the wild world of single life, why dating apps now feel like rescue shelters, the most absurd names he's come across for Mexican restaurants and that unforgettable time he took mushrooms at Disneyland, only to get stopped by Stormtroopers.

programme.title: Cory Kahaney: Antique Joke Show
programme.desc: Cory Kahaney makes all the painstaking aspects of daily life ironic and uproariously funny.

programme.title: Dom Irrera: Live From Las Vegas
programme.desc: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy.

programme.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
programme.desc: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

programme.title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
programme.desc: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

programme.title: The Ten Dollar Ticket
programme.desc: Jeff Garcia aims to give audiences their money's worth with his signature original shows in this 2008 special.

programme.title: Joe Devito: First of All...
programme.desc: Navigating the world of dating over 40 is akin to embarking on a thrift store shopping spree, and Joe DeVito is no stranger to the game; with wit and wisdom, DeVito captures the hilarious truths of dating in this age bracket.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programme.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programme.desc: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programme.desc: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
programme.desc: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

programme.title: Provoking Evil
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: The Well to Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: Grave Awakenings
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: Gateway to Hell
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: The Haunted Cabinet
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: Ghost Inferno
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: Face of Evil
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.

programme.title: Ashes to Evil
programme.desc: Amelia and Calvin Braddy move into a Tennessee apartment, unaware it was once the site of a deadly fire. Amelia senses a presence, believing the spirits of lost children haunt their home. But when the activity turns violent, they realize a darker force is at play-one targeting their family. Desperate for safety, they seek paranormal investigators before it's too late.

programme.title: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn't believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: Ghosts of War
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz discovers his late father's WWII memorabilia, including a Nazi armband, eerie phenomena erupt in his home. A vengeful soldier's spirit seeks havoc, while another tries to stop it. As their home becomes a battleground between good and evil, Dennis and his wife Debbie must find a way to end the terror before it consumes them.

programme.title: Nightmare in the Attic
programme.desc: In 1983, the Fox family moves into a historic Arkansas home, but their daughter Mary quickly becomes the target of an unseen evil. An angry ghost and a demon haunt her dreams and waking life, hinting at the home's dark past. As the attacks intensify, the family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst fear-Mary is in grave danger.

programme.title: House of Nightmares
programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: Nightmare in Bridgeport
programme.desc: When his mother's house is haunted by a demon, Connecticut paranormal investigator Bob Baker calls in colleagues and a Bishop for help. But when they fail to cleanse the home, it's up to Bob to do the job, using experience from his own 'haunted' past.

programme.title: Demon Child
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: Ghost Fury
programme.desc: Alicia and Scott Cain's daughter befriends spirits of two boys who died in a fire, but their presence brings terrifying consequences. When Alicia and her older daughter encounter a blood-soaked apparition, they uncover a brutal murder tied to their home. Paranormal investigators and a priest intervene, but will they be able to free the family from the grip of these vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Where Demons Dwell
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: Haunted Past
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Haunting of Summerwind
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: The Dark Side
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: Sallie's House
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: During renovations, Debbie Guy notices strange activity in her historic Pennsylvania home. After a guest dabbles in black magic, the disturbances turn violent. A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

programme.title: Dark Forest
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting in Connecticut
programme.desc: With the help of a psychic and an exorcist, the Parker family battles evil spirits that have invaded their home... and the lives of their children.

programme.title: A Haunting in Georgia
programme.desc: The parents of four-year-old Heidi Wyrick are terrified to learn that their daughter's 'imaginary playmate' is the ghost of a man who once lived- and died- in their suburban Atlanta neighborhood.

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: The Barn
programme.desc: Something Strange is haunting the remains of a colliery in Cheshire and Ghost Dimension head in to uncover the truth behind the activity!

programme.title: Hotel of Horror
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension head to Halewood and investigate the Wellington Hotel. Believed to be a hive of paranormal activity. Will they uncover what is haunting this public house?

programme.title: Haunted Theme Park - Part 1
programme.desc: What could be haunting an abandoned theme park in Lancashire? Ghost Dimension seek out paranormal activity in Camelot and they are in for a ride!

programme.title: Jack the Ripper
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him? Is he haunting this old police station? These are the questions Ghost Dimension investigate tonight.

programme.title: The Barn
programme.desc: Something Strange is haunting the remains of a colliery in Cheshire and Ghost Dimension head in to uncover the truth behind the activity!

programme.title: WW2 Hospital Haunting
programme.desc: Built in the early 1900's and now used as offices, a former world war 2 hospital has become the new home for something supernatural. Strange voices, eerie footsteps and the sounds of painful screams have all been reported. What will be uncovered tonight?

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension Team are ready for act II at the New Mills Arts Theatre. With so much apparent activity happening at this unassuming theatre the team just couldn't leave when so much more seemed to be promised. And more there was. Has one of the team been singled out as a cry for help from spirit takes hold and has everyone reeling from what they witness?

programme.title: Halloween Special

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1

This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world renowned plays but has a little known secret that it's allegedly Haunted. With unexplained voices coming from the auditorium and shadows witnessed on the stage, The activity will get so intense it will leave the team in a spin!

programme.title: Haunted Secrets of The Carlton
programme.desc: The team explore The Carlton, a location with a dark and mysterious past. As they investigate reports of strange noises, shadowy figures, and unexplained activity, they delve deeper into the eerie history surrounding the building. Will the spirits haunting The Carlton reveal their secrets, or will the team leave with more questions than answers?

programme.title: Loud Ghosts of the Hall
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension continue their investigation into Champness Hall and come face to face with paranormal activity that is caught on camera and seek out the paranormal entities haunting the location.

programme.title: The Haunting of the Forgotten Chapel
programme.desc: In this episode, the team heads to an abandoned chapel, where strange paranormal events have been reported for decades. From eerie knocks on the doors to footsteps echoing around them, the investigators experience chilling encounters as they try to communicate with the spirits that seem to haunt this site.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation at The Station Hotel and it appears his presence is not welcomed by the spirits. This is one experience of the paranormal that leaves a mark in Sean's memory forever.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Ashton-Under-Lyne to investigate poltergeist activity claims in a truly local pub. It's believed that it's not just the locals that return to haunt here. Sean comes face to face with the activity in a night he will never forget.

programme.title: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Middleton, Manchester to investigate claims that a sad cavalier named Edward is haunting this location. Ring O Bells has also been used for druid rituals. Will he be able to summon any spirits tonight?

programme.title: Haunted Escape Room at Moviescape - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to a haunted escape room attraction and although the sets are dressed to scare, something more sinister seems to be lurking here. Will Sean escape unscathed tonight? Items from the Enfield haunting and Amityville haunting reside here, could they be causing havoc?

programme.title: Lock Keepers Haunting at Lock 91
programme.desc: Sean heads to Manchester to investigate a lock keepers cottage that was built in 1804 and it appears that the spirits are still watching over the building and terrifying its customers.

programme.title: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.
