programme.title: Azure Dust: Inside Chernobyl's Exclusion Zone
programme.desc: An up-close look at the vast Exclusion Zone, a Ukrainian area where people are not allowed due to high radioactive contamination caused by the Chernobyl disaster.

programme.title: Drop Zone Everest
programme.desc: Drop Zone Everest follows a team of former U.S. Special Operators as they skydive into Mt. Everest.

programme.title: Blues on Beale
programme.desc: Discovering the people who keep the blues alive on Beale Street in Memphis, Tenn., and the powerful international impact of America's musical gift to the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Diving into the life and work of Dr. John Demartini, who travelled over 19 million miles to help many hundreds of thousands of people create breakthroughs over the past five decades.

programme.title: Eighth Year
programme.desc: Embark on an inspiring journey with Kyle Pugh, conquering an unprecedented 8-year journey in college football. Witness his unwavering dedication, a testament to a young man's extraordinary love for the game.

programme.title: Gentle Giant: The Andre Rodgers Story
programme.desc: Having never seen a game of baseball, Andre Rodgers, a cricketer from the Bahamas, tries out for the San Francisco Giants in 1954.

programme.title: Losing Grip
programme.desc: When a top U.S. gymnast suffers a dangerous fall in competition, his Olympic dreams hang in the balance.

programme.title: Matthew Stafford's Band of Champions
programme.desc: Witnessing an extraordinary group led by Matthew Stafford pursue the top prize in Texas football.

programme.title: The Head in the Closet
programme.desc: On February 28, 2021, a routine call at the Colorado River leads police into a shocking investigation. As officers retrace Warren Barnes' final movements, bodycam footage reveals the evidence, interviews and revelations that expose what happened...

programme.title: UFO Disclosure: What the Government Knows
Capturing Gaddafi: Minute by Minute
programme.desc: As Muammar Gaddafi's 42-year rule collapses, rebel forces close in on his final stronghold. Forced to flee Sirte, Gaddafi's convoy comes under attack, sending him into hiding as opposition fighters search for him. Wounded and surrounded, he is discovered alive and captured, bringing an extraordinary era of Libyan history to a violent end.

programme.title: The Story of Everything
programme.desc: A journey into the origins of humanity and the cosmos, illuminating mankind's most important scientific discoveries and revealing that everything has been created by a designer.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: World-renowned magician and escape artist James "the Amazing" Randi dedicates his life to exposing fake psychics and others who claim paranormal powers.

programme.title: Gaslit
programme.desc: Jane Fonda travels across the oil fields of West Texas' Permian Basin and through the Gulf Coast of Louisiana visiting the communities impacted by oil and gas production.

programme.title: Speak.
programme.desc: Five of the nation's top teenage speech competitors, capturing the euphoria of victory and the devastation of defeat as they craft and perform original oratories throughout a nine-month season.

programme.title: Damned to Extinction
programme.desc: With salmon collapsing, a unique orca population starves. Removing four dams could restore their prey.

programme.title: The Bastard Son
programme.desc: A fatherless man unable to reap the benefits of a functional family turns into a criminal to help his family level the playing field of life.

programme.title: Grizzly Country
programme.desc: A decade in Yellowstone unveils grizzlies' hidden lives, capturing astonishing behavior and iconic bears.

programme.title: Moonless Oasis
programme.desc: In Canada, citizen scientists risk everything to protect prehistoric glass sponge reefs once thought extinct.

programme.title: Seals of Sable
programme.desc: The world's largest breeding colony of grey seals is found on the remote shores of Sable Island, Nova Scotia.

programme.title: Sacred Cod
programme.desc: The story of how the oldest fishery in the United States has been driven to the edge of commercial extinction; includes interviews with fishermen, scientists, advocates, and federal officials.

programme.title: After Antarctica
programme.desc: Explorer Will Steger embarked on the first-ever coast-to-coast expedition across Antarctica in 1989. Now he returns to Antarctica 30 years later, witnessing the effects of climate change.

programme.title: Nostradamus: The Truth
programme.desc: An examination of the astrologer's predictions reveals myths and events that surrounded the life of the legendary figure who lived 500 years ago.

programme.title: Behind the Lines
programme.desc: Lt. Siegfried Sassoon (James Wilby), a poet and war veteran, is facing court-martial for publicly decrying British conduct in World War I. His poet friend Robert Graves (Dougray Scott) pulls strings to get Sassoon placed in a psychiatric war hospital in Scotland, where soldiers are to be swiftly rehabilitated and sent back into battle. There, Sassoon meets a sympathetic doctor (Jonathan Pryce) and also Wilfred Owen (Stuart Bunce), whom he encourages to pursue poetry as a form of wartime therapy.

programme.title: A Cursed Man
programme.desc: In this dangerous, dark social experiment, a documentary filmmaker seeks out some of the world's most powerful dark magic practitioners and asks them to put a curse on him.

programme.desc: On her first solo trip, Steph Custance braves one of the longest ice crossings on the map; Darrell Ward attempts a triple delivery in a single day; an engine fire stops Lisa Kelly in her tracks; Todd Dewey celebrates his birthday stuck on a road.

programme.title: Hell Nino
programme.desc: Todd Dewey must fix his truck or find himself stranded a hundred miles from the nearest town; Alex Debogorski confronts a creek in the middle of the road; Art Burke receives bad news; Lisa Kelly battles an ice crossing unlike any she's seen.

programme.title: Once Upon a Crime
programme.desc: On their way to Monte Carlo, Monaco, Marilyn (Cybill Shepherd) and her husband, Neil (James Belushi), meet several other married couples, including Julian (Richard Lewis) and Phoebe (Sean Young), who are traveling with a lost dog they plan to return to its wealthy owner for a large reward. But, when the dog's mistress is murdered, the travelers become the prime suspects, and Inspector Bonnard (Giancarlo Giannini) is determined to track them all down.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Crooks (Jackie Chan, Louis Koo) grow attached to the baby they kidnapped.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Nostalgia, Construction, and Comedy Challenges
programme.desc: Nostalgia, lazy construction crews, bizarre riddles, and a desperate assistant take over.

programme.title: Bandit
programme.desc: A taxidermist is sued over a pet job; a man sues a pet boarding company claiming his mastiff's demeanor changed.

programme.title: Please Buy My Violets
programme.desc: Uncle Joe goes into cologne business.

programme.title: The Ringer
programme.desc: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

programme.title: Kate's Recipe for Hot Rhubarb
programme.desc: Kate decides it is time for Betty Jo to put down the books and set out to find a significant other.

programme.title: The Rivals
programme.desc: After Opie is struck with puppy love, Barney tries to show him how to handle women.

programme.title: A Wife for Andy
programme.desc: Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.

programme.title: Dogs, Dogs, Dogs
programme.desc: A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

programme.title: Mountain Wedding
programme.desc: The Darling family returns to Mayberry and asks Andy for help in dealing with Ernest T. Bass, a mountain man who keeps pursuing Briscoe's married daughter Charlene.

programme.title: Elly's First Date
programme.desc: Elly May's first date in Beverly Hills ends in a riot of confusion before it even starts.

programme.title: Pygmalion and Elly
programme.desc: Sonny tries to court Elly May, as he determines that she needs to change from a hillbilly into an upper-class lady; Granny offers the use of her love charms to spice up their affair.

programme.title: The Big House
programme.desc: Barney and Gomer are responsible for watching over two thieves who are temporarily jailed in Mayberry. Between the two of them, the criminals manage to escape three times.

programme.title: High Noon in Mayberry
programme.desc: Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.

programme.title: The Loaded Goat
programme.desc: Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: When French drug kingpin Philippe Douvier (Robert Webber) learns that he's losing the respect of New York mob bosses, he decides to murder Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Peter Sellers) to regain his reputation. After a case of mistaken identity, Clouseau is declared dead, much to the delight of his former boss, Charles Dreyfus (Herbert Lom). When Clouseau reemerges, he teams up with Douvier's ex-lover, Simone LeGree (Dyan Cannon), to break up the drug trafficking operation.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: Rescue From Gilligan's Island
programme.desc: A massive tidal wave hits the island, bringing stranded Gilligan, Skipper and the rest of the gang back to civilization.

programme.title: Wagons East!
programme.desc: When a group of dissatisfied settlers decides they've had enough of the Wild West, they hire James Harlow, an alcoholic wagon master, to take them back East. The eclectic but happy bunch includes Dr. Phil, prostitute Belle and openly gay man Julian. But the railroad investors don't want it getting out that the West isn't a nice place, so they do everything they can to make sure the group never makes it to their destination.

programme.title: Lazer Team
programme.desc: After stumbling across a crash site, four misfits must use an extraterrestrial battle suit to save mankind.

programme.title: D.L. Hughley: Clear
programme.desc: The comic performs in San Francisco, discussing current affairs and nosy neighbors at the Regency Theater.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Return to Green Acres
programme.desc: Cast members from the original TV series are reunited when Oliver tries to save Hooterville from greedy developers.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Grace is a single mom who is often too busy juggling her job, bills and two love interests to pay much attention to her daughter, Ansiedad. Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

programme.title: Medieval Mishaps and Sports Showdowns
programme.desc: Football chaos, medieval romance, never-ending news, and one reluctant diver.

programme.title: Moon Missions and Mobsters
programme.desc: A moon mission, ATV mishaps, endless news taping, and mobster surprises.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programme.desc: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Fluffy and the crew head to Las Vegas where they eat at the Heart Attack Grill and then twirl on the stripper pole.

programme.title: Midland
programme.desc: In Texas, Fluffy and friends scare up huge steaks at a haunted steakhouse; a post-apocalyptic zombie workout.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Elly Races Jethrine
programme.desc: The Clampetts try to get Sonny to propose to Elly before Cousin Pearl can get her daughter Jethrine married to him.

programme.title: The Great Feud
programme.desc: The Clampetts load their shootin' irons for a match with the Drysdales when Sonny jilts and infuriates Elly May.

programme.title: Rafe Hollister Sings
programme.desc: Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

programme.title: Opie and the Spoiled Kid
programme.desc: Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

programme.title: The Great Filling Station Robbery
programme.desc: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

programme.title: Andy Discovers America
programme.desc: Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

programme.title: Aunt Bee's Medicine Man
programme.desc: Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

programme.title: Good Boy!
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, dogs arrived on planet Earth from a faraway star with plans to take over the world. Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection.

programme.desc: Two polar-opposite families find themselves sharing a cabin for a week away at camp. With the highly coveted camp trophy at stake, dads Tommy and Eddie end up lost in the woods.

programme.desc: Jay Blades and Will Kirk restore a piano stool that's been damaged by a dog; Clock restoration expert Steve is called to work on a vintage telephone; Antique projector specialist Richard Rigby restores a collector's item.

programme.title: Dalek, Silver Travel Clock, Davenport Desk
programme.desc: Furniture restorers Jay Blades and Will Kirk take delivery of a highly prized Davenport desk, damaged by burglars and in need of some serious surgery; Vintage electronics expert Neil Fairly battles some aging Doctor Who baddies; The Repair Shop's very own time lord, Steve Fletcher, tackles a tricky time-traveling conundrum of his own.

programme.title: Gnome, Smoker's Music Box, Fireman's Helmet
programme.desc: Ceramics conservator Kirstin Ramsay restores a Victorian garden gnome; Firefighting historian Stuart Black restores an antique helmet; Music box expert Stephen Kember brings a treasured family piece back to life before its owner finds out.

programme.title: Lion Chair, Lurcat Vase, Bird Box
programme.desc: Today in the repair shop, a precious 19th-century Italian chair tests Jay Blades's soft and hard furnishing skills. Resident ceramicist Kirsten Ramsey painstakingly puts the broken bits of a shattered piece by Jean Lurcat, a contemporary of Picasso's, back together again. And furniture restorer Will Kirk sets to work on a very special jewellery box.

programme.title: Jewelry Chest, House Painting, Ceramic Plaque
programme.desc: Art conservator Lucia Scalisi rescues a painting; Ceramicist Kirsten Ramsay reunites the broken pieces of a plaque that was shattered over forty-five years ago; Furniture restorers Will Kirk and Jay Blades fix a Japanese lacquered jewelry box.

programme.title: Royal Worcester Vase, Village Clock, Hay Press
programme.desc: Two royal Worcester vases from the early 1900s; Horologist Steven Fletcher and expert metalworker Dominic Chinea fix a titanic timepiece - the Cirencester village clock; The team mends a piece of farming history, a nineteenth-century hay press.

programme.title: Toy Monkey, Jukebox, Treasure Box
programme.desc: Clock specialist Steven Fletcher employs his skills to fix a clapping monkey; Ceramicist Kirsten Ramsay and furniture restorer Will Kirk restore a Victorian traveling box; A 1950s Wurlitzer jukebox arrives to test the skills of Laurence Richardson.

programme.title: Pink Ted, Brannon Pot, Grandfather Clock
programme.desc: Horologist Steve Fletcher and furniture restorer Will Kirk restore a grandfather clock that has been in a family for four generations.

programme.title: Bulldog, Rocking Chair, Mother of Pearl Shell
programme.desc: Furniture restorers Jay Blades and Will Kirk work on a hundred-year-old Nordic rocking chair that owner Nina Tucknott's grandparents were given on their wedding day.

programme.title: Cuckoo Clock, Captain's Chest, Brown Fruit Bowl
programme.desc: Horologist Steven Fletcher gets a Victorian cuckoo clock singing again; ceramics conservator Kirsten Ramsay attempts a seamless repair on a seventies bowl; furniture restorer Will Kirk navigates a 200-year-old sea chest.

programme.title: Bargeware Teapot, Appleyard Painting, Granny's Cabinet
programme.desc: Lucia Scalisi is presented with a perforated painting by Fred Appleyard; Will Kirk has a homemade riddle with over 100 pieces; a family heirloom with huge sentimental value needs the prowess of ceramicist Kirsten Ramsay.

programme.title: Smuggler's Sign, Toy Car, One-Eyed Ted
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea has to future-proof an old Cornish museum sign; Steven Fletcher has to steer an old clunker back onto the road; Julie and Amanda start treatment on George, a very special teddy who has lost one of his eyes and his growl.

programme.title: Oars, Pinball Machine, Barometer
programme.desc: A customer has a knotty nautical problem that leaves furniture restorer Will Kirk all at sea. Jay Blades and Tim Weeks get a vintage gramophone looking and sounding like new. Soft toy specialists Amanda and Julie take on a young lady suffering the effects of years of love and affection.

programme.title: Gramophone, Lucy Doll, Sailboat
programme.desc: A customer has a knotty nautical problem for furniture restorer Will Kirk; Jay Blades and Tim Weeks get a gramophone looking and sounding like new; soft-toy specialists Amanda and Julie work on a lady suffering the effects of years of affection.

programme.title: Violin, Plate Camera and Alvar Aalto Screen
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.

programme.title: Les Arc Chairs, Boat Stained Glass Window and Toy Steamroller
programme.desc: Clock restorer Steve Fletcher tries to fix up a toy steam roller from the 1930s that hasn't been used in forty years.

programme.title: Porcelain Hand Mirror, Thames Painting and Bracket Clock
programme.desc: A broken hand mirror containing the portrait of a mysterious French lady; a murky painting of fog on the River Thames; a prestigious eighteenth-century timepiece that has suffered a supernatural accident.

programme.title: Blitz Music Box, Fire Tongs and Lamb Soft Toy
programme.desc: Musical box expert Stephen Kember and furniture restorer Will Kirk join forces to tackle a very special music box damaged by a bomb during the Blitz.

programme.title: Gramophone, Blue Pitcher and Meerschaum Pipe
programme.desc: Clockmaker Steve Fletcher turns his talents to restoring an ornate antique pipe; Gramophone guru Tim Weeks takes on the restoration of an early twentieth-century record player and radio.

programme.title: Battleship, Panda and Rosewood Table
programme.desc: Furniture restorer Will Kirk takes on a rickety, water-damaged rosewood table; resident clockmaker Steve Fletcher turns his hand to getting an antique French steamboat shipshape again after it was found buried on a beach over fifty years ago.

programme.title: Fire Engine, Imari Bowl and Village Sign
programme.desc: Former firefighter Steve Fletcher jumps at the opportunity to restore a toy replica of a Dennis fire engine, while ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay tries to rescue a beautiful Japanese Imari bowl.

programme.title: Theater Stained Glass Window, Propeller Clock and Shoe Stretcher
programme.desc: Stained-glass expert Matthew Nickels tries to recreate a window; horologist Steve Fletcher works on restoring a clock fashioned from the propeller of a World War I plane downed in France; a shoe stretcher loosens up.

programme.title: Georgian Desk, Boulle Clock and Elephant on Wheels
programme.desc: Clockmaker Steve gets busy restoring an intricate Boulle-work clock that hasn't ticked for 15 years, while soft toy repairers Julie and Amanda attempt to bring a threadbare elephant back to life.

programme.title: Treasure Chest, Life Guard Helmet and Rabbit Toy
programme.desc: Matthew Boultwood attempts to restore a piece of British military history; a ceremonial helmet hailing from the Life Guards' regiment.

programme.title: Peter Pan Gramophone, Child's Rocking Chair and Cash Register
programme.desc: Gramophone expert Tim Weeks works on restoring a portable Peter Pan gramophone; Sonnaz and Will work in a child's rocking chair; Steve tries to fix a broken vintage cash register that has been in a family business for generations.

programme.title: Big Ted and Little Ted, Victorian Lamp Post and Steam Car
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea has to future-proof an old Cornish museum sign; Steven Fletcher has to steer an old clunker back onto the road; Julie and Amanda start treatment on George, a very special teddy who has lost one of his eyes and his growl.

programme.title: Caputo Painting, Tricycle and Barometer Clock
programme.desc: Steven Fletcher and William Kirk combine their expert knowledge of clocks and woodwork to repair a broken barometer.

programme.title: Planes en grande
programme.desc: Ramiro consigue que Aurelio apoye sus planes con Omar para ponerle la mano al poder político, y le revela que Terán y Mónica son primos. Luzma se escapa con el Chef y llegan a casa de Cristina.

programme.title: De la madriguera
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: Un presidente
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: Los 34
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: Pago con sangre
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: Leonor muere
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: Bajo ataque
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: Ojo por ojo
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: Sin control
programme.desc: Aurelio encuentra a Luzma drogada y bebiendo sin control. Ella lo culpa, le dice que consume la droga que él vende. Alba le dice a Víctor y Rutila que enviará a Carlitos a Colombia con su tía.

programme.title: La señora
programme.desc: Leonor acepta la propuesta de Omar de convertirse en la señora Terán. Rivero no cree que el agente de la DEA asesinó a Andrews, mientras Morán le dice a Tim que él y los Casillas lo mataron.

programme.title: De una vez
programme.desc: Doña Alba amenaza con un arma a Aurelio, y él le pide que lo mate de una vez. Ella no dispara y llama a Feyo para decirle que se cuide. Omar miente, le asegura a Leonor que no conoce a Mónica.

programme.title: Choque de trenes
programme.desc: Feyo y Aurelio llegan a Cancún listos para matar. Rutila le confiesa a Rivero que el Chema es el padre de su hijo, y le pide que lo asesine. Begoña consigue drogas en el cuarto de Luciana.

programme.title: Fue su tío
programme.desc: Mónica le revela a Víctor que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel y sus hijos, pero él desespera y no quiere creerlo. Feyo acusa a Casillas de soplón, pero dejan su enfrentamiento para luego.

programme.title: A golpes
programme.desc: Víctor culpa a Aurelio de la muerte de Chabela y se van a los golpes: le dice a su tío que está con Mónica, que no se atreva a hacerle daño. Feyo y el Chema se asocian y van contra Casillas.

programme.title: Lavado de dinero
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: Pago con sangre
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: Leonor muere
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: Bajo ataque
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: Un riñón
programme.desc: Aurelio y Esperanza le ofrecen dinero a Amparo por el riñón de Carlitos, pero ella se niega. Mónica busca a Víctor y le dice a Casillas que está embarazada. Omar necesita saber quién mató a Leonor.

programme.title: El oficial
programme.desc: Con ayuda del Oficial, Feyo se propone matar a Casillas y descubrir quiénes son sus aliados. Aurelio y Esperanza quieren seducir a Amparo. Omar pide a Ignacio averiguar quién le disparó a Leo.

programme.title: De la selva
programme.desc: Mónica tiene un mal presentimiento y pide a Javi que la ayude a sacar a Víctor de la selva. El Oficial se propone matar al Chema, mientras Ernestina informa a Ramiro que Aurelio está enfermo.

programme.title: La lista
programme.desc: El Oficial y el Reyecito atacan con bazucas al Chema, quien jura venganza tras escapar. Furioso llama a Feyo y le dice que es el primero en su lista. Rutila llega con su hijo a casa de Rivero.

programme.title: La era
programme.desc: El Ingeniero le dice a Torito que la era del Chema terminó, mientras Eleazar habla con Venegas para eliminar al Oficial, el Reyecito y Tijeras. Ramiro, interesado en Amparo, le ofrece trabajo.

programme.title: De exportación
programme.desc: Aurelio advierte a Ramiro que los colombianos han exportado su guerra a México, le pide incluir a García en un operativo de la DEA. Bajo amenaza del Chema, Toro confiesa su traición.

programme.title: Perdido
programme.desc: El Chema y Toro escapan del Ingeniero, quien se adueña de sus rutas y negocia con Eleazar. Garnica propone que Ignacio culpe a Marcado del asesinato de Leo. Esperanza negocia con el petróleo.

programme.title: El trofeo
programme.desc: Omar anuncia el fin de la guerra contra el narco para pacificar México. El Chema descubre que Aurelio está detrás de esto y se ofrece como trofeo, mientras García queda bajo el mando de Tim.

programme.title: La caída
programme.desc: El Chema se entrega en el operativo comandado por García y Tim. Aurelio lo borra de su lista de enemigos, le garantiza seguridad y que cuidará a Rutila y su hijo. La salud de Casillas empeora.

programme.title: Los hilos
programme.desc: Para conseguirle el riñón a Aurelio, Ramiro engaña a García, quien buscará a sus posibles hijos para atraparlo. Rivero renuncia por sus dudas sobre la detención del Chema, ahora corre peligro.

programme.title: Un nuevo negocio
programme.desc: Esperanza invita a Armando a casa de Aurelio para negociar el petróleo, el encuentro comienza mal. Con sed de venganza, Feyo se asocia con el Oficial y el Ingeniero para matar a los Casillas.

programme.title: En la mira
programme.desc: Para que no funcione la paz en México, el Oficial y Tijeras deciden matar a Rivero, engañan a Feyo e incluyen a Rutila. Armando le dice a Aurelio que Salazar y Abel Terán saben del negocio.

programme.title: El diablo soy yo
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Víctor que maneja el poder en México y negocia con inversionistas del mundo, porque él es el diablo. Mexicanos y colombianos listos para matar a Rivero, llegan Tim y Rutila.

programme.title: Rutila sobrevive al atentado
programme.desc: Rutila sobrevive al atentado y enfrenta a sus enemigos. Los colombianos y Don Feyo intentan eliminar a la hija de El Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: Aurelio conoce a su hijo Ismael
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas conoce a Ismael, su hijo, y le reclama a la Tata por haberlo mantenido en secreto. Abel piensa que la gente de Marco está manipulando a Omar y le pide ayuda a Mónica.

programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas le dice a Ismael que es su padre y presenta a su hijo y a la Tata a toda la familia.

programme.desc: Aurelio busca al Feyo para matarlo. Casillas intenta cobrarle al viejo Aguilera meterse con su hija Rutila.

programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas no puede cumplir con su promesa de acabar con el Feyo. Aurelio le pide a Tim que haga desaparecer al alférez García, como muestra de su fidelidad.

programme.desc: Aurelio se acuesta con la Tata Guerra. Aurelio Casillas seduce a la madre de Ismael para que le ayude con el riñón.

programme.title: Mónica en una encrucijada
programme.desc: Mónica tiene que decidir entre la vida de su hijo o la suya propia. Robles no quiere perder al hijo de Víctor Casillas.

programme.title: Misión para Esperanza
programme.desc: Aurelio le ordena a Esperanza matar al Feyo. Casillas le dice a su amante que debe eliminar a su peor enemigo.

programme.title: Mónica pierde el bebé
programme.desc: Mónica Robles sufre un aborto. Aurelio llama a Víctor para reclamarle que acuda al lado de Mónica porque ella está muy mal.

programme.title: Aurelio reprende a Víctor
programme.desc: Aurelio reclama a Víctor dejar sola a Mónica. El Señor de los Cielos le deja claro a su sobrino que el que manda en el negocio es él.

programme.title: Aurelio tortura al Chatarrero
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas tortura al Chatarrero para que termine traicionando al Feyo y le cuente sobre sus negocios.

programme.title: Amenaza de La Tata
programme.desc: La Tata amenaza de muerte a Aurelio. La madre de Ismael le dice a Casillas que deje a su hijo en paz o lo matará.

programme.title: Amparo desea a Aurelio
programme.desc: Amparo sueña que Aurelio la besa. La Tata y Aurelio determinan que ella debe regresar junto con su hijo a Tijuana.

programme.title: Víctor elimina a Eleazar
programme.desc: Víctor y Javier eliminan a Eleazar. El hijo de Chacorta le cobra a Eleazar su oración por meterse con los colombianos.

programme.title: Elisa y Monteverde secuestrados
programme.desc: Aurelio ordena secuestrar a Elisa y a Monteverde. Casillas planea torturar a los que traicionaron su confianza.

programme.title: Aurelio le pide perdón a Rutila
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide perdón a Rutila. La hija de El Señor de los Cielos le dice a su padre que está muy dolida.

programme.desc: Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire. Shona performs an emergency Caesarean to try and save a cow and her calf. Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Will it be a love affair when Elaine is paired with fellow single girl Hayley the blue Staffy? Plus, a family have the pick of two dogs, Rusty the kelpie and Lightning the Australian terrier cross.

programme.title: Mountain Babies
programme.desc: This day is spent high in the mountains of the world. Rock climbing goats and mountain lions are among the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter rushes to save a newborn calf who's going downhill fast. Julian visits Tazmin the huge eagle. Peter's old friend, Bison, the much-loved boxer, has hormone problems. Can Julian get a poorly ewe well enough to have lambs? Zoe's language skills are put to the test. Dexter the Ferret returns. He's known to nip, so will Julian keep his fingers intact?

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian battles to save a young cow who's prolapsed her uterus giving birth. Peter rushes to help a choking lamb and also meets Jemima - a little duck with a big attitude. Katy and Julian join forces to try to save a desperately ill, 6-month-old puppy.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian must treat a pregnant heifer with a pelvis that may be too small to give birth, while a cat that lost a leg after being run over by a car suffers another injury in a road accident, but this time, no treatment may be possible.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton treats a cow with a rare and complex problem. The cow's stomach has become displaced and moved to the wrong side of her body, causing pain and stopping her eating. Meanwhile in Thirsk, a baby roe deer is brought into the practice as it has stopped taking milk, and a dog has a large tumour removed in a tricky operation.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Inspector Helen Smith saves Turner and Hooch, two Dogue de Bordeauxs found abandoned in a garden. Inspector Becky Bedson tracks down a dog that was spotted stranded in a flood relief channel. It's a freezing day so she needs to act fast. Shih Tzu Olive was found on a building site, heavily matted and in pain. And meet Pepper, the Dalmatian stealing hearts across Merseyside.

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the Malawi Special, we follow Anthony and vet Riaz Rhemu as they rescue a roadside stray and go undercover to investigate the illegal puppy trade. They also help out at an open-air surgery on World Spay Day and vaccinate an astounding number of dogs against rabies.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Southeast Asia
programme.desc: Get set to monkey around with a bunch of baby Orangutans, hanging out comes naturally. Asian Elephant calves are keen to have some good clean fun in the mud, while a rare Red Shanked Douc is ready to ride the branches and show off its tree surfing skills.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter meets his most tricky client yet, Possum the uber-angry pussycat. Nykee the alpaca may have a life-threatening and excruciatingly painful condition. Can Julian save both mum and baby? Peter meets much-loved ram, Diamond, who has eye problems. Working sheep dog, Flynn, has a suspected broken leg. Will Julian be able to get him back to running with his flock?

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: In North Yorkshire Inspector Clare Wilson responds to a call from a member of the public reporting a house full of dogs, apparently in need of help. When she arrives she finds 5 Yorkshire terriers all living in one room, and one needs her urgent attention.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. Julian introduces us to their rabbit Luna, but she has to learn to share as they take in a new stray Boris. In order to welcome him into the family Boris will need to be castrated.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Grey nomads Warren and Jan are on the hunt for a four-legged companion. Mum Karen and daughter Edie meet Parmigiana, a gentle and energetic border collie.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, farmer Richard Todd brings one of his much-loved semi-feral moggies into the practice. But 'Pretty Tom' isn't living up to his name. Peter believes the lump on Tom's face could be a life threatening tumour. To be safe, the mass must be removed urgently but Peter knows it will be extremely difficult surgery. Against all odds can Peter, with the help of Vet Helen, save Pretty Tom?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian gets a panic-stricken call from Alpaca farmer, Jackie Barlow. Two of her alpacas, Gavroche and Francesca, have sneaked into the barn and gorged themselves on the food stash. They're struggling to breathe, foaming at the mouth and choking. At Skeldale, Julian faces one of his toughest challenges to date - Bertram the Bloodhound has a nasty tumour, as big as an egg, above his eye.

programme.title: Jungle Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in some of the jungles of the world. Chimpanzees, orangutans and elephants feature.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Are two dogs too many when the Prestia family meet a bonded pair? Will retired nuns Margaret and Antoinette find their final doggy companion? Can Justin the magician handle large puppy Oreo's tricks?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian races over to the llama trekking centre in the Dales, after one of the youngsters breaks his jaw in a freak accident. A goat with a painful foot condition is brought in to Peter. A bulldog is rushed in after eating some chewing gum.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian decides to conduct a fertility test on an unproductive ram. Peter tends to a spaniel that needs major surgery after being hit by a car. Julian has to travel to Thirsk to tend to the wounded following a battle between two terrapins.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt rushes to a local cattle farm to help Tilly the cow give birth. Mike and Rebecca have an amorous pony, who needs an appointment with Peter and Julian operates on a young girl's poorly guinea pig, but he is shocked by what he finds.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: In the first of this 2 part special, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor gets down and dirty as she rescues 4 dogs from a squalid house. Three of the poor dogs are shut into separate rooms and living in their own waste. One is so traumatized that it has a seizure.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The student RSPCA Inspectors are now entering the last and toughest stage of their year-long training. They're investigating cases by themselves for the first time ever. If they make it through these final few months, they'll be offered a full-time position, but for now they're on probation with no guarantee of success.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: The largest abscess Julian's ever seen is on a bull's backside - a waterfall of pus is coming! Peter meets Thor the giant rabbit as well as North Yorkshire's best dressed dog. And, just a few hours old, a lamb is rushed into surgery.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Amrita is willing to give a troubled soul a home but gets more trouble than she bargained for with Jack Russell cross Oreo in the meeting pen.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The Trainee RSPCA Inspectors have reached the halfway point in their extraordinary year of teaching, testing and on-the-job assessment. If they make it to the end, the students will become fully-fledge Inspectors, but should they fail at any point, they'll be off the course. The group face their toughest challenge of their year so far.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: What do comedy icon Denise Scott, Australian Survivor champion Mark Wales and his Survivor wife Sam, and tennis legend Mark Philippoussis have in common? They're all looking for the perfect pooch.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: A pet pig is brought to the practice to see Julian. Peter heads to see goat brothers because all isn't rosy in their garden. A German short-haired pointer requires surgery. A pregnant cow requires an emergency C-section.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian visits house pig Pigley Scott, who has had a horse tread on his trotter. Father and son farmers are worried about Roger, their prize bull, who has a large lump on his neck that may be a tumour.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter battles to deliver lambs who are jumbled up and stuck inside their mum, and he is shocked by what he finds. Julian has to contend with an angry parrot that has escaped in the surgery. A rescue dog is attacked by another dog.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter's called out to a cow with stomach problems, he calls in reinforcements from his new Grace Lane Practice. Julian has a surprise examining a pregnant dog. A frisky Shetland Pony and a lizard with a dead tail end are also treated.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hunky Tom Rigby meets his match in Keira the kelpie. And will this be it for serial dater Lily the pug when she meets human Lily and her family in the meeting pen?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter is struggling to find his feet in his new practice. But when a farmer rushes in with a heavily pregnant sheep who's struggling to give birth, instinct takes over as Peter deals with the emergency.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian is called out to a poorly three day old calf who's collapsed and looking very sorry for itself. Julian suspects a bacterial infection and warns farmer Stuart Robinson that the calf could be contagious. But, if Farmer Stuart's family don't practice good hygiene our vet warns 'they could all be shitting like mad.' Unlucky Terrier Holly has been brought into the surgery after falling off a bed.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Asia
programme.desc: We head on an adventure through Asia, prowl around with some cheeky Amur Leopard cubs, go underwater to catch a baby Spinner Dolphin practice it's loops, plus watch some rare Giant Panda cubs grow up right before your eyes, via a den cam.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the series, following Yorkshire vet Julian Norton, his partner Peter Wright and their team.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: It's a distressing day for Inspector Anthony Joynes after he's called to investigate the case of Harvey, a Border Collie so thin it had to be put to sleep on humane grounds. But there's more upset in store when Anthony turns up at Harvey's registered address and finds another dog just days away from death.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Julian faces a massive challenge trying to save one of the biggest calves he's ever had to deliver. And farmer Rob, who lost a newborn two days ago, is fearing the worst.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter's under extra pressure when he heads out to see Charlie the horse - he belongs to his niece Jess. She's always loved horses and rides them competitively, so Charlie needs his wolf teeth removing so they don't interfere with the bit.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode Peter braves the elements and heads out to pregnancy test a small herd of young cows. But the farm is on high ground and with heavy snow settling on Yorkshire's hills will winter's icy grip prevent him from getting there?

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Even More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We return to the zoos to meet up with more babies, wild cat kittens, chimpanzees, and panda cubs are featured.

programme.title: Desert Babies
programme.desc: Today we visit some of the deserts and dry areas of the world. Coyote pups, meerkats, and baby bison are some of the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Shih Tzu crosses Alfonso and Lorenzo are the last of the five dogs who came into the shelter after their owner died. Their mother and siblings have found love, so it's finally their turn when they meet Carol.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: What do comedy icon Denise Scott, Australian Survivor champion Mark Wales and his Survivor wife Sam, and tennis legend Mark Philippoussis have in common? They're all looking for the perfect pooch.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Pulfer gets a report of a starving dog in need of his help, but he gets a nasty sense of Déjà vu when he arrives at the address. A year earlier, Anthony had visited the property to investigate a complaint about a Staffie that wasn't being properly cared for...

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian is at Jackie's alpaca farm to see one of his favourite girls, Cinderella. After delivering her baby a few years ago, recently he performed a c-section when she was struggling again.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes Walter the shih-tzu into surgery after the dog has broken its jaw in a freak accident. Peter operates on a horse called Sammy. Matt needs to take drastic action to help a dairy cow. Shona and Matt meet the vets of tomorrow.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire. Shona performs an emergency Caesarean to try and save a cow and her calf. Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A pregnant ewe is rushed to the animal hospital from Cannon Hall Farm. David determines she needs an emergency c-section. Young vet Rohin gains valuable experience on the farm. Julian rushes a cat into surgery and enjoys some alpaca yoga.

programme.desc: On this episode of Pastor wants A wife, things get heated when both pastors confront their ladies about gossip and other things. According to Mpho, pastor Aaron still beats around the bush.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 10
programme.desc: At this stage of the season, things get more interesting as the two pastors get a chance to visit the ladies' families. Pastor Lincoln visits Anelisa's family and pastor Aaron visits Kelebogile's family

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 11
programme.desc: It is yet another beautiful day where Pastor Lincoln takes a visit into Sivuyile's family home. Anelisa confronts pastor Lincoln regarding his son. Pastor Aaron is visited by his brother is law.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 12
programme.desc: On the twelfth episode of Pastor Wants A Wife, we recap on the first season of Pastor Wants a Wife with a presenter Lerato Mvelase.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 13
programme.desc: On the last episode of Pastor Wants A Wife, the two pastors get the opportunity to choose who they would like to spend their lives with.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 1
programme.desc: In the first episode of Pastor Want a Wife, we meet the pastors, Aaron, and Lincoln. We also introduce the twelve ladies who will be vying for their attention. In a surprise twist, one of the ladies will be eliminated based on first impressions.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 2
programme.desc: On the second episode of pastor wants a Wife, the pastors will meet the ladies for one date. They will be eliminating one lady each, based purely on first impressions.

programme.title: Hamilton: One Shot to Broadway
programme.desc: The remarkable story of how a group of inspired mavericks made an unlikely marriage of hip-hop and history the biggest musical show in America...and are getting ready to conquer the world.

programme.title: Prince! Behind The Symbol
programme.desc: This is an all-access pass to the first night of Prince's Welcome to America Tour at The Forum in Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Rise
programme.desc: The first chapter analyses the origins of Afrobeat and its musical evolution. We dig into the history of its creation with Fela Kuti but also with the other music genres related to recent Afrobeats, such as the Nigerian Highlife of the 70s and 80s.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Afrobeats continues to grow whilst having a huge influence on pop culture. African superstars now regularly sell out concerts overseas and receive airplay on platforms around the world.

programme.title: Brammfontein
programme.desc: Janez and Amanda check out Braamfontein this week to see what's on offer from coffee shops to bakeries and the famous Wits art museum

programme.title: Rock And Roll
programme.desc: Janez and Amanda go on a rock and roll tour of Johannesburg in which Janez gets a tattoo in honor of his newborn son, they head to Craft in Parkhurst for milkshakes then Hell's Kitchen in Melville followed by The Potato Shed in Newtown.

programme.title: Gauteng
programme.desc: We are meeting up with two food enthusiasts from blogger, Jo Best to explore the best Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner spots in Gauteng. We go to the three best BLD places based on the tastiest menus, value for money and of course, Jozi vibe!

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A riveting episode of how Lower Zambezi, came into being, and a relentless quest to protect this unique and fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Along the banks of the Mighty Zambezi River, lies The Lower Zambezi National Park. A poignant tale emerges, as ecologist David Ngwenyama goes on a mission to preserve this wild haven from the biggest threat in its history.

programme.title: Edwin Okong'o
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. Check out a day in the life of Kenya funny man Edwin Okong'o.

programme.title: Michael Blackson
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. See Ghana's Michael Blackson as you've never experienced him before.

programme.title: The Rapids Of Hazyview
programme.desc: It's no smooth ride for our avid roadies, as they get caught up in the rapids of Hazyview, and Bridget impresses the chief of Shangana Village.

programme.title: Mozambique
programme.desc: Bridget is introduced to Dene's world of surfing in her home country of Mozambique.

programme.title: Master Bedroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their fourth challenge, decorating the master bedroom. They collaborate with local designers and meet with their mentors.

programme.title: Bathroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their third challenge, a double room challenge they must decorate both bathrooms. They meet with their mentors to discuss their ideas. Breaking down walls seems to be the trend for this challenge.

programme.title: Bathroom Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the double bathroom challenge, Will the designers manage to finish this mammoth task in time? One duo's bathroom is seen as very controversial. Who will be crowned as the winners of challenge three by our panel of judges?

programme.title: Spare Room Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the second spare room challenge, and things are tense. Will all three duos finish in time? Stay tuned to find out who will be crowned as the winners of challenge two by our panel of judges

programme.title: Atlanta
programme.desc: From its historical ashes of slavery, to being a major power in the Civil Rights movement, Atlanta bustles with the energy of African and Caribbean immigrants. From it's Red Velvet cake to a serving of Eggusi soup, the future shines brightly here.

programme.title: Houston
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to the southern US city of Houston, Texas where we follow WNBA star Chiney Ogwumike as her Nigerian family celebrates the meaning of success, friendship and representing a new generation of Nigerian-Americans.

programme.title: A Family's Nightmare Begins: The Leigh Matthews Story Part 1
programme.desc: On the eve of her 21st birthday, Leigh Matthews is kidnapped from her college campus and held for ransom by an unknown assailant. After an excruciating two-week wait, her lifeless body is found dumped in an open field.

programme.title: A Web of Lies: The Leigh Matthews Story Part 2
programme.desc: The heart-rending story of the kidnapping and murder of Leigh Matthews continues. Crimes Uncovered delves deeper into the psyche of the assailant, his greed and subsequent capture.

programme.title: Yemen
programme.desc: May Yacoubi conduz seu público através de uma experiência culinária internacional de diferentes alimentos do Norte da África, do Golfo Pérsico, da Turquia e muito mais, apresentando a singularidade de cada prato e seus sabores distintos por meio de suas receitas incríveis.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Case 1: The plaintiff paid a caution fee and wants a refund, but the landlord claims in damages. Case 2: Mr. David owes back rent and has been given a one-month ultimatum to pay or face eviction due to his poor payment record and conduct.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Case 1: Ex-BET Naija worker owes debt after breaking betting rules; boss demands repayment. Case 2: Man sues after clothes left for dry cleaning in 2019 were stolen and allegedly sold.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Case 1: Mike paid for the rent as agreed with Jude, who was supposed to handle cooking but failed to do so, so Mike is requesting a refund. Case 2: Leke and Joseph swapped phones, but when Leke asked for his phone back, Joseph claimed it was stolen

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Case 1: The plaintiff paid the defendant for materials to make outfits, but after delays, he demands a refund. Case 2: The plaintiff claims the defendant owes for beverages for a church event, while the defendant argues the church should pay.

programme.title: Jason's Letter
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy is still grieving from the loss of his best friend, the most recent of many unarmed shooting victims in his small community. After realizing the marches and protests have done nothing, he decides to take matters into his own hands.
